author: Unknown
title: Çetin Arkaş joins youth gathering in Cologne
content:
Young people from Kurdistan living in Europe will gather in Cologne today to demand the physical freedom of Abdullah Öcalan.


Organisers said the march, which will bring together Kurdish and internationalist young people, will be more than an act of solidarity. They described it as a powerful initiative for freedom that will demonstrate the organised will of young people, their determination to struggle and their commitment to a free future.


At the Cologne march, young people will raise the message, “Öcalan’s freedom is our freedom.” The march will also be held in memory of the recently announced martyrs of the Kurdistan revolution.


A major youth gathering will be held in Cologne on 3 September, one day before the march. Çetin Arkaş, a member of the Imrali Secretariat, will address the young people via a live link.


The programme will include a video presentation featuring protests, events and organising activities carried out by young people from Kurdistan living across Europe. The presentation will highlight their history of struggle and solidarity in Europe, as well as their pursuit of freedom.


Artists Hozan Diyar and Talat Yeşil will also take part in the event, lending their music to the young people’s demand for freedom.


Three-day programme


Young people met on Thursday, 3 September, and today they will march through the streets of Cologne demanding the physical freedom of Abdullah Öcalan. The program will conclude tomorrow, 5 September, with the participation in the 34th Kurdistan Culture Festival in Dortmund.


The three-day program will bring young people together around the demand for Abdullah Öcalan’s physical freedom, commitment to the legacy of the martyrs of the Kurdistan revolution and the building of a free future. Kurdish and internationalist young people living in different European countries have been called on to join the march and strengthen the struggle for freedom.

author: Unknown
title: Bayık: How you treat a people’s Leader reflects how you treat the people
content:
KCK Executive Council Co-Chair Cemil Bayık answered ANF’s questions about the process.


The Kurdish people have recently been commemorating their martyrs everywhere, particularly in the cities of Bakurê Kurdistan. Memorial gatherings and condolences are being held in many cities. Thousands of people are attending these gatherings and messages are being expressed. On this occasion, what message would you like to convey to Kurdish people, particularly the families of the martyrs?


I extend my condolences to the families of our fallen comrades and to the entire Kurdish people. In particular, commemorations are being held for our martyrs whose deaths were not made public during the intense warfare of recent years. Holding commemorations for the fallen guerrillas during the Peace and Democratic Society Process was necessary for the healthy conduct of the subsequent stages of the process. Because if the process moved forward, the guerrillas’ return to Turkey would become an issue. These commemorations were therefore held to prevent room for different debates and speculation later on. Tens of thousands of our people have participated in these commemorations. They have demonstrated in a very striking way the meaning and value our people attach to the martyrs. At the same time, this expresses the Kurdish people’s commitment to the goals for which these martyrs sacrificed their lives.


Our people are deeply conscious that whatever has been achieved in the name of existence, freedom and democracy has been achieved through the struggle of these self-sacrificing people. The guerrillas waged this struggle and risked their lives on the basis of their commitment to Leader Apo. [Abdullah Öcalan]. For this reason, posters of Leader Apo were carried at the commemorations, and the slogan “Long live Leader Apo” was repeatedly chanted. This stance also represents strong support for the Peace and Democratic Society Process being pursued through Leader Apo’s initiative. Indeed, in every speech, the families of the martyrs have emphasized that the Peace and Democratic Society Process is the result of the martyrs’ struggle. If today Leader Apo is negotiating with the Turkish state for peace and a democratic society, and if the Kurdish question has been brought from the gallows to the negotiating table, it is the struggle of our martyrs that made this possible.


If our martyrs had not made the ultimate sacrifice, our struggle would have been eliminated and would have met the fate of previous Kurdish uprisings. In this respect, it is very important to view the Peace and Democratic Society Process as a process created by the martyrs. The stance of the martyrs’ families is very meaningful. Their stance also has a determining influence on the stance of the Kurdish people. If the Kurdish Freedom Movement has left such a mark on Kurdish life socially and historically, the stance of the martyrs’ families has played a major role in this. The stance of the martyrs’ families and the strong participation of our people in commemorations have demonstrated that the Kurdish people will undoubtedly attain a free and democratic life.


Our martyrs undoubtedly also place a responsibility on the families of the martyrs. This means remaining committed to the goals for which the martyrs gave their lives. If the families of the martyrs properly represent these values, these values will inevitably become concrete in the free and democratic life of the Kurdish people. When the entire Kurdish people remain committed to the values for which our martyrs gave their lives, the future of the Kurdish people will inevitably be free. No force will be able to deprive this people of existence, freedom and democratic life.


How should the legacy of the martyrs be approached? How will commitment to their memory, the values that led them to sacrifice their lives, and their aspirations be kept alive from now on?


Keeping the legacy of the martyrs alive means struggling for the values they sought to achieve. The existence of the Kurdish people has been strongly established. Now this existence must attain a free and democratic life. For this, we must first make the struggle for peace and a democratic society successful. 


This is possible by creating an organized democratic society based on communes. The values created through the martyrs’ struggle can only be protected and developed through an organized society. In this respect, it is necessary to resist the consumerism of …

author: Unknown
title: Öcalan’s views from Imrali would strengthen public support
content:
The adoption of the framework law marked the beginning of the second phase. The board headed by the Vice President also decided to establish four additional committees. Abdullah Öcalan is expected to play an active role in the committee to be established as part of this process, because disarmament cannot take place without such a role. Those who carry arms say: “We will not return unless our leadership plays an active role in this process and guides us not only in going to Turkey, but also in our transition to political life in Turkey.”


Disarmament also directly concerns the leadership of the armed organisation. It will therefore be difficult for the process to proceed and develop in a healthy manner unless the movement’s leadership plays a role and maintains contact with Imrali and the state throughout this period.


It is equally important for Öcalan’s views to be conveyed to the public in Turkey through journalists and intellectuals and for the process to gain broader social support. State officials have indicated, either explicitly or indirectly, that journalists and intellectuals would be allowed to visit Imrali. This had been particularly expected with the beginning of the second phase. Many journalists and intellectuals have applied to interview and meet Öcalan on Imrali, but these requests have still not been granted. There is considerable expectation that such meetings will take place. Without them, it will not be possible to dispel the speculation surrounding the process among various sections of society.


Certain reports have recently appeared on digital media platforms claiming to reveal the content of meetings held on Imrali. It is noteworthy that the platforms publishing these claims are opposed to Abdullah Öcalan and the Kurdish Freedom Movement. Indeed, the fact that individuals presenting themselves as Kurds began making accusations against Öcalan and the Freedom Movement following this digital media provocation has once again demonstrated why these platforms resort to such tactics.


The Justice and Development Party (AKP) government, however, is creating the conditions for such speculation and provocations by failing to take steps that would allow Abdullah Öcalan’s views to reach the public through journalists and intellectuals. Those responsible for such provocations should, of course, be criticised and condemned. But steps must also be taken to prevent them from carrying out such provocations. This means ensuring that Öcalan’s views are presented openly to the public. Some may criticise what he says in these interviews and meetings. Those criticisms or attempts at defamation can then be answered accordingly. In this way, deliberately constructed narratives and distortions can be prevented.


If journalists and intellectuals are not allowed to meet Öcalan on Imrali, provocations and attempts at sabotage carried out through digital media may come to be seen as something the government itself wants. The government has the power to prevent this. Otherwise, arguments over who leaked the information or where it came from become meaningless. It must be stressed once again that the Kurdish people, the wider public in Turkey and democratic forces want to hear directly from Abdullah Öcalan about his views.


Commemorations held for guerrillas in Kurdish provinces have shown that the Kurdish people fully support the Peace and Democratic Society Process. Mothers and fathers who have lost their children say, “We, too, are part of this country. Let peace and democracy come.” They speak of fraternity with the Turkish people. They also want peace to be honourable and just. The peace being sought must not be “a peace that puts an end to peace.”


The Kurdish people no longer want war, conflict or death. They do not want soldiers, police officers or guerrillas to die. The Peace Mothers say, “Let us join mothers of soldiers and police officers in leading the way towards peace and strengthening Turkish-Kurdish fraternity.” Mothers and fathers with such an outlook, and a people with such aspirations, represent an opportunity for Turkey. It is Abdullah Öcalan who has created this opportunity. If the Turkish people are able to hear Öcalan’s views, they will undoubtedly support the political project he has put forward. Until now, however, these views have been prevented from reaching the people of Turkey. Hopefully, this will no longer be the case.

En souvenir de Flore

FARAGGI

, agressée dans la nuit du 20 au 21 août 1944, vers 1h30, par un groupe d'inconnus de 6 à 8 hommes vêtus d'uniformes de Waffen-

Elle fut conduite sur le pont suspendu au-dessus de l'Isère, qui relie le centre ville au quartier Saint Laurent, exécutée d'une balle dans la tête, et son corps jeté dans l'Isère. Son fils Jack, son père et sa mère connurent le même sort.


Ces meurtriers sont des membres de la Milice française et du Parti Populaire Français qui en profitèrent pour piller son logement et son commerce.

Il y a d'un côté les résultats électoraux du Rassemblement nationalou de Reconquête, très inquiétant lors des élections européennes ou législatives, et plus nettement en retrait lors des élections municipales. Nous avons aussi largement insisté sur les réseaux des catholiques intégristes, leurs diverses associations, leur volonté d'imposer leurs visions rétrogrades et leurs tentatives de contrôler la jeunesse.


Plusieurs groupes activistes et agressifs ont tenté de se constituer sur la métropole. Ils s'inscrivent dans un courant suprémaciste qui fait de la violence le fondement de leur projet. Pour l'instant, aucun de ces groupuscules n'a réussi à s'imposer.


Alimentant cette extrême-droite, plusieurs structures développent des discours complotistes et conspirationnistes. La crise du Covid a été un accélérateur : nombre des théories fumeuses et dangereuses ont proliféré et elles imprègnent largement la fachosphère.


L'objectif de ce travail est de faire un état de l'extrême-droite sur Grenoble et de souligner les pratiques locales de ces groupes. Une cartographie permet d'identifier les réseaux et de proposer une grille de lecture. Au centre de ce livret, une cartographie a été réalisée pour une meilleure compréhension spatiale de notre propos

author: Author and Editors
title: Artificial Intelligence in the Hands of the People: The Rongjiang Experiment
content:
A small county folded into the mountains of south-west Guizhou, Rongjiang was among the last counties in China to be

lifted

 out of extreme poverty, crossing the line only on 23 November 2020, and as late as 2022 its

per-capita output

 stood at about a third of the national average. ‘Eight parts mountain, one part water, one part field’ is how an old upland saying counted the land in Guizhou — the only province in China without a plain. Its valleys are terraced and narrow, its villages strung along the rivers and ridgelines beneath Moon Mountain. There was never much land here to produce wealth, and no easy road to carry the little produce out.


The Red Army crossed these mountains in 1934, on the march that would take it north. Football arrived a decade later,

brought

 by students of Guangxi University, evacuated to Rongjiang to escape Japanese aggression. Villagers have organised their own matches nearly every year in the eight decades since.


In May 2023, that tradition found a new expression in

Cun Chao

, the Village Super League: a competition organised by villagers, played by villagers, and watched by villagers. Within weeks of its launch, the stadium’s stands were filled to the brim, and footage carried by the short-video platforms drew the eyes of the whole country and then of the world. None of it ran itself. Packing a stadium every weekend, keeping order, feeding the broadcast — all of that took an organisational capacity the county had not required before.


This organisational capacity became an engine for real economic outcomes. Tourism revenue

rose

 from 8.4 billion yuan in 2023 to 10.8 billion in 2024, and the county’s gross domestic product reached 10.496 billion yuan in 2024, a rise of 9.5 per cent. The league

brought

 more than 2,700 new market entities into being, over thirty per cent of the whole prefecture’s new total, and village collective income

climbed

 from 58.9 million yuan in 2022 to 121 million in 2024.


It also opened a door to something else entirely. Since 2023 the county has set itself a less likely task: to put artificial intelligence (AI) into the hands of the villagers. It has built no large language model, no data centre, and no semiconductor plant. What it has built instead is its own people, organised across government offices, villages, and enterprises, so that residents who had never written a line of code, among them elderly farmers and village cadres, now use AI in their everyday work.


Building the Institutional and Material Conditions


The experiment was made possible by conditions built at multiple levels.


Cun Chao

 was no technology project but a feat of organisation, and the organisational structure was standing before the first ball was kicked. In October 2021, a year and a half before that match, the county set up a leading small group for new media and rural e-commerce, headed jointly by the county Party secretary and the county governor. In a Chinese county the Party committee leads and the government departments administer, and those departments — agriculture, commerce, culture and tourism — each holds responsibility for part of any new undertaking; a leading small group is how a Party committee concentrates the efforts of different departments on a common task. Here the two highest officials in the county took the headship themselves, one from the Party and one from the government, which put new media at the top of the agenda.


Beneath the group the county

placed

 a working team at the county level, a new-media service centre in every township, and a new-media service station in every village, and it set up a new-media company besides, a county state enterprise holding shares with private partners. The result was a single organisational chain linking three different but complementary capacities: Party leadership, grassroots mobilisation, and market activity. The Party committee provided political leadership; grassroots cadres reached every household; private firms and traders connected production to the market. When

Cun Chao

 began in May 2023, the county set a dedicated

Cun Chao

 Office on top of that standing structure, to mobilise cadres, coordinate security, and keep the media channels fed across all three levels at once.


When the county later turned toward AI, the mechanism had already put thirty-five thousand person-times — a tally of training instances, not unique individuals — through new-media

training

 and built more …

title: Daniela Klette: Knastkundgebung in Vechta am 19. September 2026 um 14 Uhr
content:
Solidarität mit Daniela Info Nr. 56/2.9.2026


„Die Solidarität lässt für sie, so sagt Daniela, die Sonne aufgehen“


Hallo, wir rufen zu einer weiteren Kundgebung am Samstag, d. 19. September 2026 um 14 Uhr vor dem Frauenknast in Vechta auf. Daniela ist weiterhin in der JVA Vechta, wie lange sie noch dort sein und wann sie nach Frankfurt verlegt wird, wissen wir nicht.


Es hängt von einer Entscheidung des Oberlandesgerichts (OLG) Frankfurt, 8. Strafsenat, wann die Anklageschrift, die Ende März von der Bundesanwaltschaft an das OLG ergangen ist, für einen weiteren Prozess in Frankfurt zugelassen wird.


Wer einen Redebeitrag auf der Kundgebung halten möchte, sagt uns bitte rechtzeitig Bescheid.


Gruppe: Solidarität mit Daniela


solidarisch-mit-daniela@t-online.de / www.solidarisch-mit-Daniela.de


Solidarität mit Daniela


Kundgebung am 19. September 2026 um 14 Uhr


Vechta, Franziskanerplatz/Kleine Kirchstraße


Daniela Klette, die weit über 30 Jahre in der Illegalität lebte, wurde nach ihrer Verhaftung Ende Februar 2024 in Berlin in die JVA Vechta gebracht. Dort war sie in den ersten sieben Wochen in Einzelisolation gewesen, dies bedeutete: 24 Stunden wurde die Zelle videoüberwacht, eine Metallblende war vor dem Fenster angebracht, so dass kein Sonnenlicht in die Zelle drang, Einzelhofgang, keinen Kontakt zu anderen gefangenen Frauen. Dies ist Folter! Nur durch Öffentlichkeitsarbeit wie z. B. die ersten beiden Kundgebungen im März und April 2024 wurden die Haftbedingungen für Daniela gelockert. Seitdem hat sie „normale“ Haftbedingungen.


Am 27. Mai 2026 ist Daniela vom Landgericht Verden – im ersten Prozess wegen acht Geldbeschaffungsaktionen – zu 13 Jahren verurteilt worden. Die Verteidiger von Daniela und auch die Staatsanwaltschaft haben Revision eingelegt. Ein zweiter Prozess gegen Daniela wird vor dem Oberlandesgericht Frankfurt/M stattfinden. Die Anklageschrift der Bundesanwaltschaft (BAW) u.a. wegen zwei Aktionen der Roten Armee Fraktion (RAF) in 1991 und 1993 sowie einer dritten einer Kämpfenden Einheit in 1990, an denen laut BAW Daniela mutmaßlich beteiligt gewesen sein soll, wird in den nächsten Monaten vom OLG zugelassen werden. Wann der Prozess beginnen wird, ist zur Zeit noch nicht absehbar. Auf jedem Fall wird dann Daniela vor Prozessbeginn nach Frankfurt verlegt. Im Frauenknast Frankfurt-Preungesheim sind die Haftbedingungen schlechter als in Vechta, z. B. hier hat sie 4x im Monat Besuch, in Frankfurt nur 2x.


V.i.S.d.P. und Kontakt: solidarisch-mit-daniela@t-online.de / www.solidarisch-mit-daniela.de


passiert am 19.09,2026

title: Film Ruina – über ein besetzes Woh- Projekt in Venezuela
content:
Sonntag, 5. September, 21 Uhr


Wagenplatz


Laster und Hänger


Revaler- Ecke Modersohnstr.


10245 Berlin


Was passiert, wenn eine Bank scheitert? Zum Beispiel wird es von 3000 Menschen besetzt und in ein Wohnprojekt umgewandelt. Die Innenstadt von Caracas, eine 200 Meter hohe Wolkenkratzer-Ruine, ragt bis zum karibischen Himmel empor und dient als Unterschlupf für 750 Familien. Von der Stadtverwaltung ignoriert und von der Nachbarschaft gefürchtet, bauen die Bewohner von Torre Confinanzas ihr eigenes Modell einer sozialistischen Mikrogesellschaft in ihrer vertikalen Stadt auf. Ruina erzählt von Schwierigkeiten und Erfolgen, indem es aus einer Masse von Menschen eine soziale Gemeinschaft aufbaut.


Der Film soll auch wieder einmal den Blick auf Venezuela richten, ein Land, das vor 20 Jahren für mancheLinke ein Vorbild war.

author: capulcu
title: Solidarität und Gegenangriff – Zur Einstufung von Autistici/Inventati als „Globale Terroristen“
content:
Die Sanktionen der US-Regierung gegen das Tech-Kollektiv Autistici/Inventati aus Italien sind ein direkter Angriff auf unsere Strukturen. Unterstützen wir die Betroffenen und verteidigen wir unsere Kommunikationsplattformen!


Einstufung als „Globale Terroristen“


Am 26. August 2026 hat die US-Regierung das linke italienische Tech-Kollektiv Autistici/Inventati mit Sanktionen belegt und als „Globale Terroristen“ eingestuft. Das Amt zur Kontrolle von Auslandsvermögen (OFAC) behauptet, dass es mit der Maßnahme „der wachsenden Bedrohung durch gewalttätige linksradikale Terrorgruppen“ entgegenwirken würde. Die Trump-Regierung begründet die Sanktionen damit, dass das Kollektiv angeblich „spezielle digitale Architektur, Tools und Dienstleistungen für Antifa-Zellen und andere gewalttätige linksradikale Extremisten bereitstellt“. US-Außenminister Marco Rubio erklärte auf X:


Far-left terrorism poses a profound threat to the United States and the broader West. Today, the United States sanctioned several transnational far-left terrorist networks, including Autistici/Inventati – a major far-left tech collective whose services are used by the most active and violent Antifa cells in the United States and across the world. There will be no refuge for violent extremists who wage war on our civilization and plot to undermine law and order, destroy critical infrastructure, assault political opponents, or conspire to conceal their crimes from authorities. We will use all the tools and authorities at our disposal to fight terrorism and protect our way of life from terrorist coercion.


Erklärung von Autistici/Inventati


Das Tech-Kollektiv Autistici/Inventati entstand 2001 im Rahmen des G8-Gipfels in Genua und ist u.a. bekannt durch die WordPress-Blogplattfrom noblogs.org auf der auch der Blog https://capulcu.noblogs.org gehostet ist. Daneben stellt das Kollektiv weitere Kommunikationsinfrastruktur in Form von Webseiten, E-Mail, Mailinglisten, Chats, Newsletter etc. für Einzelpersonen und emanzipatorische Gruppen zur Verfügung. In einer ersten Erklärung hat Autistici/Inventati die Vorwürfe zurückgewiesen:


Wir bekräftigen nachdrücklich unser Engagement, eine Plattform mit Werkzeugen zur digitalen Selbstverteidigung bereitzustellen, die dem Bedürfnis nach freier Kommunikation von Aktivist:innen sowie anderen Einzelpersonen, Gruppen und Vereinigungen gerecht wird.


Wir werden nicht nachgeben. Wir werden weiterhin das tun, was wir all die Jahre getan haben. Und wir werden alles in unserer Macht Stehende tun, um den falschen Anschuldigungen einer politisch verzweifelten Regierung entgegenzuwirken. Deren einzige Absicht besteht darin, die Aufmerksamkeit der Menschen und der Medien von ihrer eigenen Gewalt und Kriegstreiberei abzulenken.


Antifaschismus und Antikapitalismus sind kein Terrorismus. Protestieren ist kein Terrorismus. Und jeder hat das Recht, seine Meinung zu äußern und für die Menschlichkeit zu kämpfen.


Kampf gegen „Links“


Die Maßnahme der ultra-rechten US-Regierung ist Teil des (Kultur-)kampfs gegen „die Linke“. Sie knüpft nahtlos an frühere Maßnahmen an wie die Einstufung der „Antifa Ost“ als Terrororganisation im November 2025. In Folge der damaligen Sanktionen kündigte die GLS Bank u.a. der Roten Hilfe und ABC Dresden ihre Konten. Ähnliche Konsequenzen sind nun auch für Autistici/Inventati in Italien zu erwarten. Dazu kommen mögliche weitere wie der Verlust von Domains oder des Zugangs zu Rechenzentren. Erst im Juli hatte US-Außenminister Marco Rubio auf der Ministerkonferenz zum Wiederaufleben des politischen Terrorismus weitere Einstufungen von ausländischen Gruppen als Terrorist:innen angekündigt. Dabei verwies er auch auf den Stromausfall in Berlin und kündigte eine Fortsetzung der Konferenz durch die deutsche Bundesregierung an. Die nun erfolgte Sanktionierung von Autistici/Inventati richtet sich nicht nur gegen das Kollektiv selbst, sondern fügt sich als Puzzleteil ein in einen größeren Angriffs auf soziale Bewegungen, Strukturen und Einzelpersonen weltweit.


Neben dem Versuch der gesellschaftlichen Isolation und Diffamierung linker Strukturen als „gewalttätige Terroristen“ durch die ultra-rechte US-Regierung sehen wir eine weitere Dimension: immer mehr Kommunikation der sozialen Bewegungen hat sich in den letzten Jahren auf die Plattformen großer Tech-Unternehmen verlagert. Ein mutmaßliches Ziel der Maßnahme der US-Regierung ist es, diese Entwicklung weiter voranzutreiben und alternative …

author: CNT Aranjuez
title: AlTajo 86 Septiembre 2026
content:
AlTajo-86-septiembre-2026

Descarga


Salud compas! Llega la revista nº 86 correspondiente al mes de septiembre de 2026, una revista que es el órgano de expresión de la CNT de Aranjuez con la colaboración de personas y colectivos afines.


Nuestra portada es para el Encuentro de Cine Libertario, el ENCILI, que, en su décima edición dedica una parte de la programación a la historia del pueblo gazatí, además de tocar aspectos laborales.


En nuestra sección A voces de este ALTAJO recogemos gran parte de la actividad del sindicato durante el verano para hablar de Autogestión, arte, solidaridad, ocio… Es viernes y el cuerpo lo sabe.


En Sindicalismo, Yanis Merinakis nos comparte una reflexión sobre la asunción de responsabilidades como motor de la revolución, y hablamos de la huelga de Educación Infantil que comienza su sexto mes, desde que comenzó el 7 de abril, y que ahora a inicios de curso escolar necesita toda la solidaridad y el apoyo para sostener ánimos, presión y pagar facturas. Para ello, desde CNT Aranjuez y con la colaboración de La Corrala-Patio Feminista, La Asociación La Casa Negra, la Red Solidaria el Zerrillo, os convocamos a una jornada reivindicativa y solidaria el próximo 12 de septiembre.


La Cultura Libre de este nº86 de la revista ALTAJO viene cargada de propuestas con el anuncio del Octubre Negro. También tenemos un artículo de Xoan Vázquez sobre las Panteras Negras, una nueva entrega de Los Archiveros del Real Sitio de Lizania, una reseña sobre la presentación de 19 de julio, España en la FAL, y un nuevo relato traducido de Sotiris Dimitriu.


En nuestra sección Pienso, Luego existo compartimos dos nuevos textos teatrales de Dinamita Sindical para que os animéis a representar, difundir y disfrutar este humor combativo que tanto nos ha amenizado en las tardes de los viernes durante los asfixiantes meses de calor. Además, como en cada número, contamos también con dos reseñas de libros que nos prepara Domingo Martínez, y para cerrar Próximas convocatorias para el mes de septiembre.


¡Os deseamos disfrutéis de la lectura!


Salud y apoyo mutuo.

Projection du film «

 

Aguirre

 

» puis discussion le 20/09 à 16h à la librairie Publico, à l'invitation du Groupe libertaire d'Ivry.


“Le pouvoir est maudit, c'est pour ça que je suis anarchiste.” (Louise Michel)


Projection de "Aguirre. La colère de dieu" de Werner Herzog avec Klaus Kinski (1972, 1h30,

VF

)


Pérou, 1560. Une troupe de conquistadors part à la recherche de l'Eldorado. Un des lieutenants, Lope de Aguirre, manœuvre habilement pour prendre la tête de l'expédition. La descente du fleuve se change rapidement en descente aux enfers…


Le chef-d'œuvre de Werner Herzog pose de nombreuses questions essentielles à propos de toutes les formes de pouvoir. Aguirre est indéniablement une ordure assoiffée de pouvoir

 

; mais est-il vraiment plus cruel et plus "fou" que les autres conquistadors

 

? Est‐ce qu'on ne juge pas Aguirre surtout sur les apparences : Klaus Kinski grimaçant, hurlant, gesticulant est‐il réellement plus "fou" et plus cruel que, par exemple, le moine qui constate mollement que les Indiens "meurent les uns après les autres" et collabore sans broncher à toutes les violences

 

?


Le film évoque également la situation des femmes, en particulier de la fille d'Aguirre, totalement passive et soumise, embarquée de force dans cette aventure mortifère.

author: Sarah Raymundo
title: Blood Rush | An anti-requiem for Gloria Steinem, a Cold War icon
content:
Her pro-imperialist ideology gave feminist cover to U.S. soft power, making Western liberal democracy look progressive while its economic structures continued to siphon labor and resources from women in Latin America, Africa, and Asia.

As the media machine prepares to unleash a flood of fawning tributes, the usual suspects will inevitably honor Gloria Steinem—a spectacle revealing little about liberation and everything about their own bankrupt politics, brazen opportunism, willful blindness to historical fact, and the hackneyed claims to “complexity” and “nuance” held so dear by these intellectual mercenaries.

How does one assess a life after it ends? Those who benefit and are in a good position in this system will honor Gloria Steinem for contributing to stabilizing a system oppressive to many and dis-aligning them from revolutionary ideas—this is not what women want and need. Enough!

The death of Gloria Steinem will undoubtedly unleash an avalanche of sanitized obituaries, performative tributes, and ruling-class hagiography. Western media will mourn her as a “groundbreaking icon” and a pioneer for gender equality. But for the global majority—the millions of women across the Third World and the working-class masses who remain crushed beneath the boot of imperialist exploitation—her passing marks the end of a legacy that fundamentally weaponized feminist rhetoric to protect the empire.

Steinem did not liberate women; she weaponized women’s liberation to serve the interests of American hegemony. The foundational sin of her career was never a mere footnote: her early leadership of the CIA-backed Independent Research Service in the late 1950s and 1960s was explicitly designed to undermine anti-imperialist, socialist, and communist youth movements at international youth festivals. When exposed, Steinem didn’t apologize; she defended the covert arm of the U.S. imperialism, describing its operatives as “liberal and honorable.” This was not an innocent blunder of youth, but the blueprint for her entire career.

Through Ms. magazine and her manufactured status as the singular, polished face of “second-wave feminism,” Steinem pioneered a dangerous model of liberal counter-insurgency. As radical feminists, Black panthers, and anti-capitalist women were rising up to demand the dismantling of the triad of imperialism, white supremacy, and capitalism, Steinem offered a palatable alternative: bourgeois, reformist faux feminism.

This imperial feminism detached gender oppression from its economic and geopolitical roots. It told American women that liberation meant climbing corporate ladders, breaking glass ceilings inside warmongering state institutions, and achieving parity within an exploitative system—all while the very empire housing them carpet-bombed, starved, and destabilized nations across the Global South. By framing patriarchy as an abstract cultural enemy separate from class struggle and US military domination, her brand of activism effectively depoliticized the feminist movement and severed its solidarity with anti-imperialist struggles worldwide.

It was precisely this co-optation that radical groups like Redstockings rightly called out in 1975. They recognized Ms. magazine and Steinem’s elevated media stature as a parallel organization meant to channel radical anger into benign electoral politics. When challenged on her intelligence connections and corporate backing, her apparatus used legal threats and publishing pressure to suppress internal dissent, silencing the very radical women whose ideas she had watered down and monetized.

For the global majority, Steinem’s legacy is not one of freedom, but of co-optation. Her pro-imperialist ideology gave feminist cover to U.S. soft power, making Western liberal democracy look progressive while its economic structures continued to siphon labor and resources from women in Latin America, Africa, and Asia. She normalized a brand of identity politics that allows female CEOs, drone operators, and politicians to be celebrated as triumphs for “womanhood,” even as their actions inflict violence on millions of impoverished women globally.

We must refuse the myth-making that surrounds her death. True liberation for women will never come from the handshakes of CIA handlers, corporate sponsors, or ruling-class media elites. It will come from the destruction of the imperialist, capitalist structures that Steinem worked so tirelessly to legitimize. Her death should serve as a stark …

title: Lêpirsîna Gulistan Dokuyê: Du kesên din hatin girtin
content:
Li Dêrsimê xwendekara Zanîngeha Mûnzûrê Gulîstan Dokû ji 5ê Kanûna Paşiya 2020an ve wenda ye. Di çarçoveya lêpirsîna Dokuyê de 2 kesên din hatin girtin.


Di dosyeya lêpirsînê de vekolînên teknîkî yên nû hatin kirin.


Li gorî tomarên Sîstema Nasîna Pilaqeyan, wesayîta ku tê nirxandin Alî Kahraman û hevjîna wî Burçîn Hizli Kahraman bi kar aniye, 5ê Kanûna Paşîn a 2020î di wan saetên ku Doku herî dawî hatiye dîtin de li ser rêya Pira Sari Saltukê bûye.


Tomarên kamerayê 


Li gorî tomarên kamerayan, wesayîta ku diyar bûye ji bo Burçîn Hizli Kahramanê hatiye dabînkirin û Alî Kahraman diajot, 5ê Kanûna Paşîn a 2020î derdora saet 12:25an di Sîstema Nasîna Pilaqeyan ya FEDAŞê re û nêzîkî 3 xulekan pişt re jî di Sîstema Nasîna Pilaqeyan ya Zanîngehê re ber bi aliyê Xarpêtê ve çûye.


Di hejmartinan de hat nirxandin ku wesayît derdora saet 12:27an di ser Pira Sari Saltukê re derbas bûye.


Diyar bû ku di heman demê de ji telefona ku Burçîn Hizli Kahramanê bi kar dianî, saet 12:27:51ê de bi xeta ku hevjîna waliyê wê demê yê Dêrsimê Tuncay Sonel, Handan Sonelê bi kar dianî re axaftina telefonê hatiye kirin.


Di qeydên HTSyê de hat diyarkirin ku di nava rojê de di navbera van her du xetan de gelek pêwendî hatine kirin.


Alî Kahraman û hevjîna wî Burçîn Hizli Kahraman piştî van bipêşketinan di çarçoveya lêpirsînê de hatibûn desteserkirin.


Piştî kar û barên fermî, her du gumanbar bi daxwaza girtinê sewqî dadgeriya cezê û aştiyê ya nobedar hatin kirin û dadgeriyê biryara girtina wan da.


Lêpirsîna Gulistan Dokuyê: Kesekî din jî hat girtin


31 Tebax 2026


Di çarçoveya operasyona 29ê Tebaxê de 10 kes hatibûn desteserkirin. Alî Kahraman û hevjîna wî Burçîn Hizli Kahraman di nav wan kesan de bûn.


Çi bûbû?


Gulîstan Dokû, xwendekara zanîngeha roja 5ê Kanûna Paşiya 2020an venagere wargeha ku lê dimîne.


Hevalên Dokûyê yên wargehê piştî nikarin têkiliyê bi Dokûyê re daynîn serî li Rêvebiriya Emniyeta Dersîmê didin û malbata wê agahdar dikin.


Malbata Dokûyê tên bajêr û di 6ê Kanûna Paşiyê de serî li Rêvebiriya Emniyeta Dersîmê didin ku keça wan wenda bûye.


Polîsan ji bo Gulistan bê dîtin bi hevalên wê re hevdîtin dike, sînyalên telefona wê dişopîne û qeydên MOBESEyê yên bajêr lêdikol in.


Di lêkolînan de diyar dibe ku Dokû di saet 11.29an de li wêstgeha wesayîtan ya Kolana Ataturkê li wesayita ku diçe zanîngehê sûwar dibe.


Piştre îfadeya seyaqê wesayîtê tê girtin ku seyaq dibêje ew nizan e Dokû li kîderê li wesayîtê peya bûye.


Piştî îfadeya seyaq hatiye pêşbînîkirin ku Dokû li ser Pireya Sari Saltûk peya bûye ku li wir jî kamera tune ye.


Jinan û malbata Dokûyê ji bo ku Gulistan bê dîtin têkoşiyan e. li ser vê yekê biryara valakirina bendavê hatiye girtin.


Di 17ê Hezîrana 2020an de ji bo ku Zeynal A. weke gumanbar were girtin daxwazname ji bo Serdozgeriya Komarî a Dersîmê hatiye dayîn.


Piştî 6 salan di çarçoveya lêpirsînê de di 13ê Nîsana 2026an de 13 kes hatin desteserkirin.


Kesên hatin desteserkirin ev in:


"Zeinal Abakarov, Engin Yucer (zirbavê Zeinal ku polîsê berê ye), Cemîle Yucer (dayika Zeinal), Ugurcan Açikgoz (hevalê Mûstafa Turkay Sonel), Erdogan Elaldi (Wê demê xebatkarê Îdareya Taybet a Bajar bû), Mûstafa Turkay Sonel, Gokhan Ertok (polîsê berê bû ku hatibû îxrackirin, di pêvajoya lêpirsîna der heqê walî û parastvanê wî de eleqeya wî hebû;), Savaş Gulturk (Kesê ji kamerayên Zanîngeha Munzurê berpirsyar), Suleyman Onal (kesê li Zanîngeha Munzurê ji kamerayan berpirsyar), Celal Altaş, Nûrşen Arikan, Şukru Eroglû (Parastvanê walî Tuncay Sonel).”


Her weha di çarçoveya lêpirsînê de di 21ê Tîrmehê de di serdegirtinên malan de 3 bijîşk, hemşîreyek, peywîrdarek karên agahiyan, 5 personelên berhevkirina daneyan, Handan Sonel, hevjîna waliyê berê yê Tunceliyê Tuncay Sonel, xwediyê şîrketek teknolojiyê ku tê gotin mudaxileyî telefona Dokuyê kiriye, karsazek û 2 cerdevan jî di nav de 15 kes hatin desteserkirin.


Di 27ê Tîrmehê Wezîrê Dadê Akin Gurlek daxuyanî dabû û gotibû ku “Di çarçoveya lêpirsîna Gulistan Dokuyê de, bi kordînasyona Serdozgeriya me ya Komarî ya Erzîromê û ji aliyê Fermandariya Cendermeyan a Bajarê Erzeromê ve li 15 bajaran bi awayekî hemwext li dijî 19 gumanbaran operasyon hat kirin. Li 21 navnîşanan lêgerîn hatine kirin û 18 gumanbar hatine desteserkirin.”


Di 29ê Tebaxê de di pêla 5emîn a operasyona lêpirsînê de 10 gumanbar hatibûn desteserkirin. Ji wan heta niha 4 kes hatine girtin.

title: 13 yaşındaki fındık işçisi Yusuf Kesen çalışırken yaşamını yitirdi
content:
Fotoğraf: İSİG Meclisi X hesabı

Mardin’den ailesiyle birlikte fındık toplamak için Sakarya’ya giden 13 yaşındaki Yusuf Kesen, traktörden düşmesinin ardından bir aracın çarpması sonucu ağır yaralandı. Kesen, tedavi gördüğü hastanede hayatını kaybetti. İSİG Meclisinin verilerine göre Kesen, bu yıl hayatını kaybeden 58’inci çocuk işçi oldu.

Mardin’in Kızıltepe ilçesinden ailesiyle birlikte mevsimlik tarım işçisi olarak fındık toplamaya Sakarya’ya giden 13 yaşındaki Yusuf Kesen hayatını kaybetti.

Kesen, 20 Ağustos’ta seyir halindeki traktörden dengesini kaybederek yola düştü. Bu sırada yoldan geçen başka bir aracın çarptığı Kesen ağır yaralandı. Hastaneye kaldırılan Kesen, 12 gündür sürdürdüğü yaşam mücadelesini kaybetti.

Kesen’in cenazesinin memleketi Mardin’in Kızıltepe ilçesinde toprağa verileceği öğrenildi.

İşçi Sağlığı ve İş Güvenliği (İSİG) Meclisi de Kesen’in ölümünün ardından yaptığı açıklamada, bu yıl tespit edebildikleri çocuk işçi ölümlerinin 58’e ulaştığını bildirdi.

İSİG Meclisi açıklamasında, “Bu yıl tespit edebildiğimiz 58. çocuk işçi ölümü... Yusuf Kesen... 13 yaşında, mevsimlik tarım (fındık) işçisi... Sakarya'da hareket halindeki bir traktörden düşüp yolda bir aracın çarpması sonucu yaralandı... 12 gündür tedavi gördüğü hastanede hayatını kaybetti” ifadelerini kullandı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Yargıtay'dan emsal boşanma kararı: Sürekli mahremiyet ihlali ve dedikodu tam kusur sayıldı
content:
Yargıtay 2'nci Hukuk Dairesi, "aile mahremiyeti"ni ısrarlı bir şekilde ihlal eden, akrabalarıyla evli olduğu kadının dedikodusunu yapan ve evin ihtiyaçlarını karşılamayarak ekonomik ihmalde bulunan erkeği boşanma davasında tam kusurlu buldu. Yüksek Mahkeme, istinafın "Birlikte yaşamaya devam ettiler, af sayılır" yorumunu reddederek, kadının nafaka hakkını güvenceye aldı.

Türkiye gazetesinden Gamze Erdoğan'ın haberine göre, Gümüşhane Kelkit Aile Mahkemesinde görülen davada; erkeğin özel hayatı üçüncü kişilere aktarması, hakaret etmesi ve evin ihtiyaçlarını ihmal etmesi gerekçesiyle erkek ağır, eşini eve almayan kadın ise az kusurlu bulunmuştu.

Kararı inceleyen Trabzon Bölge Adliye Mahkemesi, tarafların olaylardan sonra aynı evde yaşamayı sürdürmesini "affetme" sayarak, kadını tam kusurlu ilan etmiş ve kararı erkek lehine çevirmişti. Kadının başvurusuyla dosyayı inceleyen Yargıtay 2'nci Hukuk Dairesi ise istinafın bu değerlendirmesini hatalı buldu. Mahremiyet ihlali ve hakaretin süreklilik arz ettiğini, dolayısıyla af kapsamında görülemeyeceğini belirten Yargıtay, erkeğin davasının reddine, kadının davasının kabulüne ve erkeğin tam kusurlu sayılarak nafaka ödemesine hükmetti.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Impunidad para el espionaje ilegal de Macri: sobreseyeron a los exjefes de la AFI
content:
El juez Martínez de Giorgi consideró que las tareas de inteligencia sobre periodistas, activistas y organizaciones sociales en el contexto de la Conferencia Ministerial de la OMC de 2017 y de la cumbre del G20 de 2018 estaban justificadas por necesidades de seguridad. “La decisión consolida un criterio preocupante que amplía los márgenes para la vigilancia de la actividad política y social”, denunciaron desde el CELS, y anunciaron que van a apelar.


Compartimos el comunicado del CELS:


Cumbres de la OMC y el G20: sobreseyeron a los exjefes de la AFI por espionaje


El Juzgado Criminal y Correccional Federal N° 8 sobreseyó a Gustavo Arribas, Silvia Majdalani, Martín Coste y Carlos Tonelli Banfi en la causa que investigaba tareas de inteligencia ilegal realizadas por la AFI sobre periodistas, académicos, activistas y organizaciones sociales en el contexto de la Conferencia Ministerial de la OMC de 2017 y de la cumbre del G20 del 2018. La investigación, sin embargo, se inició en 2020 cuando se encontraron en dependencias de la AFI cientos de fichas con información sobre opiniones políticas, publicaciones en redes sociales, pertenencia a organizaciones, vínculos y otros datos personales.


Gustavo Arribas, el jefe de los espías de Macri.


El juez Martínez de Giorgi consideró que esas tareas estaban justificadas por razones de seguridad vinculadas con la realización de las cumbres. También, que la información no fue recolectada por las opiniones políticas o la pertenencia partidaria, social o sindical de las personas investigadas y que, por lo tanto, no se habría violado la Ley de Inteligencia. Esta interpretación es especialmente preocupante: convierte el contexto de un evento internacional y sus necesidades de seguridad en justificación suficiente para relevar y sistematizar información sobre opiniones y actividades políticas y sociales.


Desde el CELS, en diciembre de 2017, reclamamos al Estado información sobre la exclusión de 65 integrantes de organizaciones de la sociedad civil de la conferencia de la OMC y advertimos que la decisión podía haberse basado en prácticas ilegales de espionaje. La documentación encontrada años después en la AFI confirmó que existían fichas sobre las personas que habían solicitado acreditarse y que se habían registrado, entre otros datos, sus posiciones políticas, organizaciones de pertenencia y actividad en redes sociales.


Este sobreseimiento se suma a otras decisiones que en los últimos años fueron cerrando investigaciones sobre prácticas ilegales de inteligencia. En 2025, la Corte Suprema dejó firme el sobreseimiento de Mauricio Macri, Gustavo Arribas y Silvia Majdalani en la causa por la vigilancia a familiares de los tripulantes del ARA San Juan. Ese criterio comenzó a proyectarse sobre otras investigaciones: en junio de este año, la fiscalía pidió el sobreseimiento de Arribas y otros 27 imputados en la causa conocida como Proyecto AMBA, que investigaba el despliegue de bases de la AFI en distintos puntos de la provincia de Buenos Aires, y utilizó como fundamento precisamente el fallo sobre el ARA San Juan. Se consolida así un criterio que corre los límites de la democracia: la apelación a la seguridad nacional no puede ser una habilitación absoluta a que los organismos de inteligencia recolecten información sobre las opiniones y actividades políticas, sociales o periodísticas de las personas.


Vamos a apelar esta resolución. Frente al funcionamiento ilegal de los servicios de inteligencia urge investigar estas prácticas, establecer responsabilidades y sostener la prohibición de que el aparato de inteligencia sea usado para vigilar la participación política y social.


La entrada

Impunidad para el espionaje ilegal de Macri: sobreseyeron a los exjefes de la AFI

Indymedia Argentina Centro de Medios Independientes (( i ))

.

author: CMI Argentina
title: La causa de las valijas tuvo como destino el archivo
content:
Se trata de los 15 bolsos de Laura Arrieta, organizadora de la cumbre de la Conferencia Política de Acción Conservadora (CPAC), que ingresaron al país sin control aduanero. El juez Yadarola concluyó que no se determinó que fuera un caso de contrabando y cuestionó el rol de los agentes de Aduanas.


Por Irina Hauser


En sus últimas horas previas a asumir en la Cámara Federal, Pablo Yadorala firmó el archivo de la causa en la que se investigaban las valijas y bultos que Laura Arrieta ingresó al país sin pasar por controles tras llegar a Aeroparque en un avión privado del influyente empresario Leonardo Scatturice, de fuertes vínculos con el gobierno libertario. En su papel aún de juez penal económico, después de un año y medio de trámite del expediente, concluyó que no es posible hablar de contrabando no solo porque el equipaje no pasó por el escáner y no se sabe qué había adentro, sino porque el análisis de las imágenes y algunos testimonios lo llevaron a concluir que parecían “equipaje, efectos personales y elementos propios de desplazamiento internacional”. En cambio, decidió enviar a sorteo para que algún juzgado de Comodoro Py investigue el posible incumplimiento de deberes de los funcionarios/as que debieron controlar.


La resolución aclara que el archivo podría no ser definitivo y que la causa debería reabrirse si Estados Unidos contesta los oficios que el juez envió varias veces, donde pedía a las autoridades que precisaran datos sobre el vuelo –que había salido del aeropuerto Opa-Locka, en Miami-, la ruta, los pasajeros, el equipaje, la mercadería declarada y registros de control al momento de la partida. Parece improbable que esa información llegue, al menos por ahora. Se le atribuye, de hecho, oficiar como nexo entre las administraciones de Javier Milei y Donald Trump, entre otras cosas a través de un contrato de una de las empresas ligadas a él, Tactic Global LLC, con la SIDE.


El vuelo privado con matrícula N18RU llegó al Aeroparque Jorge Newbery el 26 de febrero de 2025 a las ocho de la mañana. La tripulación estaba conformada por José Luis Bresciano y Juan Pablo Pinto más Arrieta, todos consignados como empleados de OCP TECH, una de las empresas del grupo encabezado por Scatturice. Según declaró el principal de la Policía de Seguridad Aeroportuaria (PSA) José Flores Herbas, Arrieta bajó de la aeronave con un celular en la mano y se lo pasó a la guarda de la Oficina de Control de Pista de la Dirección General de Aduanas (DGA), Cintia Cali, quien estaba esperando y le hizo un ademán con la cabeza, después de lo cual llevaron a la pasajera al sector de arribos internacionales, donde se dirigieron también Bresciano y Pinto. La pesquisa no obtuvo precisiones sobre esa llamada, que parecía guardar relación con el trato particular recibido. La reconstrucción se hizo en base a imágenes (que, según la resolución, son de baja calidad e incompletas) y relatos de testigos.


Guiados por Cali y Silvia Abalsamo, responsable interina de la División Aeroparque Metropolitano (vicejefa de Aduana), los tres atravesaron un circuito que no tenía ningún tipo de control. En ese momento el escáner estaba disponible, no había nadie. Ingresaron 15 bultos en total, la mayoría de los cuales habría pertenecido a Arrieta. Un registro escrito consignaba solo cinco. Luego, inmediatamente, ingresaron otros pasajeros que sí fueron revisados. El avión de Scatturice estuvo en el hangar de la empresa Royal Class hasta el 5 de marzo. Según los tripulantes, habían quedado dos valijas adentro, una de Arrieta y otra de Víctor Germán Du Plooy. Pero la inspección previa a que partiera hacia París, arrojó que no había nada adentro. Un misterio.


La investigación comenzó el 17 de marzo del año pasado, con una denuncia del Servicio Aduanero, después de que Carlos Pagni revelara la historia del vuelo en La Nación. El tiempo transcurrido desde el arribo del avión hasta ese entonces es otro de los argumentos por los que Yadarola dice que hay detalles que no se pueden recuperar y que son esenciales en una causa de contrabando. En cuanto a las comunicaciones, consignó que se pudo establecer que hubo flujo de datos, pero no se sabe si hubo una llamada de WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Twitter, Instagram o alguna otra aplicación. No se esclareció de dónde vino la instrucción para evitar el control. Como es habitual, el Gobierno en su momento mintió: el exvocero Manuel Adorni dijo que Arrieta había pasado los controles y que solo llevaba un carry-on y una …

author: nico
title: Wem gehört das Wasser?
content:
„Guter Grund“ versteht sich als eine Bewegung an der Schnittstelle von planetaren Grenzen, Wasser und Landwirtschaft. Gemeinsam mit lokalen Bürgerinitiativen, Landwirtschaft und Engagierten mischen sich die Klimagerechtigkeitsaktivist:innen in die Verteilungskämpfe ums Wasser ein und setzen sich, während einer anhaltenden Dürre, bundesweit für Wasser als Gemeingut ein. Ein Bericht von Aimée van Baalen. (GWR-Red.)

Ich steige in Baruth, knapp vierzig Minuten von Berlin entfernt, aus dem Zug. Rund 4.000 Menschen leben hier, umgeben von viel Wald und Feldern. Gleich treffe ich mich mit weiteren Wasser-schützer:innen von Guter Grund, gemeinsam besuchen wir die lokale Bürgerinitiative „Ressourcenbündnis Baruth“, welche sich gegen den Bau der größten Dosenfabrik Europas durch Red Bull einsetzt. Mit weiteren Mitstreiterinnen gründete ich vor zwei Jahren Guter Grund, um der Klimakatastrophe auf neuen Wegen etwas entgegenzusetzen.

Heute sind wir in Baruth, weil wir als Bewegung an der Schnittstelle von planetaren Grenzen, Wasser und Landwirtschaft arbeiten. Dabei versuchen wir, auf die breiten Zusammenhänge aufmerksam zu machen, denn sieben von neun planetaren Grenzen sind überschritten. Wasser ist dabei die Ressource, an der diese Überlastung für jeden spürbar wird. Deshalb mischen wir uns mit strategischen Plänen in lokale Konflikte ein und erobern zusammen mit den Betroffenen Wasser als Gemeingut zurück. Vor allem aber bringen wir Organizing-Erfahrung mit und nutzen diese für Haustürgespräche, Marktstände und Vernetzung. Denn Menschen vor Ort wissen am besten, wie vorzugehen ist. Auf der anderen Seite bringen die Bürgerinitiativen viel Wissen und ein gutes Gespür für die Region mit, sodass die Zusammenarbeit sich hervorragend ergänzt.

So auch in Baruth: Hier plant Red Bull auf 17 Hektar bis zu 3,3 Mrd. Dosen pro Jahr zu produzieren und zu exportieren. Der Konzern hat sich für 22 Jahre lang die Rechte gesichert, bis zu 2,35 Milliarden Liter Grundwasser pro Jahr zu entnehmen. Das sind 92 Prozent des städtischen Wasserpensums, nur die übrigen acht Prozent bleiben für die Bevölkerung. Grundlage dieser Genehmigung ist ein Gutachten aus dem Jahr 2006, welches teils Daten aus der DDR-Zeit verwendet. Zudem wird auch unter Verschluss gehalten, wie viel Red Bull für das Wasser zahlt, nach eigenen Berechnungen müssen Bürger:innen jedoch mindestens mit dem Dreifachen für dieselbe Menge rechnen. Die Initiative vor Ort hat deshalb konkrete Anliegen, darunter keine neuen Genehmigungen vor Klärung der kommunalen Versorgung, unabhängige Gutachten statt veralteter Daten, faire Bepreisung und volle Transparenz bei Verträgen.

Auch deutschlandweit setzt Guter Grund sich für diese wichtigen Veränderungen ein, denn der Umgang mit dem Wasser in Baruth ist kein Einzelfall. Genau dieselben Vorgänge konnten wir bereits ein Jahr zuvor bei unserer Arbeit in Treuchtlingen beobachten. Für Aldi Nord bezieht der Konzern Altmühltaler das gesamte dortige Wasservorkommen. 650 Millionen Liter im Jahr, davon 250 Millionen aus dem Tiefengrundwasser.

Dieses wird deutschlandweit in Flaschen verkauft. Die Bevölkerung vor Ort zahlt derweil mehr für das Wasser, welches über Fernleitungen herangebracht wird und aus einer dürrebedrohten Region herangepumpt wird. Auch hier pumpen Konzerne ab und wir zahlen den Preis.

Als ich in der Unterkunft ankomme, in der wir die kommenden Monate immer wieder einkehren werden, treffe ich auf Petra und ihren Mann. Sie erzählen mir, dass beide seit über 20 Jahren in Baruth leben und die brandenburgische Trockenheit von Jahr zu Jahr deutlicher spüren. Als immer mehr Brunnen trocken gefallen sind, war das für Petra ein Grund, sich der Bürgerinitiative anzuschließen. Brandenburg zählt zu den trockensten Regionen Deutschlands, beispielsweise trocknet der Seddiner See so stark aus, dass bereits große Uferbereiche freifallen. Wie das Wassermanagement zukünftig bei zunehmender Dürre aussehen soll, bleibt genauso geheim wie die Verträge selbst. Dabei ist die Frage, ob in Krisenzeiten Industrie und Konzerne oder An-wohner:innen priorisiert werden, von zentraler Wichtigkeit für Leben und Gesundheit.

Dass Red Bull ausgerechnet hier baut, liegt nämlich auch daran, dass viele Kommunen vom Bund nicht genug unterstützt werden und dann vermeintlich auf das Geld angewiesen sind. Tatsache ist jedoch, dass durch günstige Grundstückspreise, Ressourcen fast zum Null-Tarif und niedrige Gewerbesteuern Konzerne profitieren und Kosten ausgelagert …

author: Unknown
title: PYD in South Kurdistan: We do not accept the Education Ministry’s decision
content:
The Representation of the Democratic Union Party (PYD) in Başûrê Kurdistan issued a statement regarding the decision by the Education Ministry of the Syrian Interim Government to reduce the number of Kurdish-language classes to three hours per week in Rojavayê Kurdistan.


The statement said that the recommendations and decisions of the Ministry of Education and Teaching regarding the reduction of Kurdish-language classes to three hours per week were being closely monitored, adding that this step represented a regression from the current education model and undermined the continuation of progress achieved in the field of education in recent years.


Recalling that extensive scientific and practical experience had been accumulated in Rojava over the past 12 years, the statement said: “Within this framework, Kurdish has been used at every stage of education as a language of instruction and research, and a comprehensive education system has been established. The use of the mother tongue is not limited to literature and humanities departments; it is also applied across all scientific, medical and applied sciences, and all courses are taught in accordance with the approved scientific curriculum and advanced academic standards.


“Limiting Kurdish in education to three classes per week and treating it merely as an auxiliary language rather than the primary medium for teaching scientific subjects has a negative impact both educationally and academically. We maintain that the best solution is not to subordinate one language to another, but to implement a bilingual education model. This is a scientific model applied in many countries around the world, allowing core sciences and subjects to be taught in both Kurdish and Arabic, thereby safeguarding students’ linguistic and cultural rights.”


The statement continued: “We do not accept this decision and categorically and unconditionally reject it. This decision is incompatible with the principles of justice, equality, and linguistic and cultural rights. We also reject limiting the Kurdish language to three classes per week or treating it as an elective subject, because this directly or indirectly leads to Kurdish being regarded as an ordinary, auxiliary or second language.


“The Kurdish language is not an additional subject that students can choose or abandon, nor is it a foreign language in their own country. Kurdish is the mother tongue, identity, history, culture and social memory of the Kurdish people. Any education policy that ignores this reality or downgrades the status of the Kurdish language cannot be considered a step toward building a new Syria. On the contrary, it represents a new form of the policies of destruction and denial that the Kurdish people have faced for decades.


“Based on these realities, we call on the relevant parties to reconsider these decisions restricting the scope of Kurdish-language education and to take the necessary steps to preserve and develop the academic standards and comprehensive scientific curricula that have been delivered in Kurdish for the past 12 years. This right must be legally guaranteed for future generations so that the quality of the education system can be preserved and further developed in a future Syrian constitution.”


The statement stressed that the new Syria cannot be built on the old mentality and new policies of denial, and called for this shortcoming to be addressed in order to safeguard the rights of the Kurdish people and the principles of justice and equality.

author: Unknown
title: TÜİK, AİHM’lik oldu: Türkiye'de yargı sürecinden sonuç alınamamıştı
content:
Fotoğraf: TÜİK/Wikimedia Commons Public domain

Kübra Kırımlı [email protected]

Emekli Danıştay Hakimi Önder Tekin, TÜİK’in son 5 yıldır gerçek enflasyon rakamlarını açıklamadığını, bunun siyasi iktidarın bir politikası olduğunu belirterek, Türkiye’de tükenen iç hukuk yolları üzerine Avrupa İnsan Hakları Mahkemesine (AİHM) bireysel başvuru yaptı. Tekin, “Bu işi yıllarca yapan bir idare hukukçusu olarak bilirkişi incelemesiyle gerçeğin ortaya çıkacağına inanarak yola çıktım. Türkiye’de çok açık bir şekilde böyle de hukuksuz karar verileceğine inanmıyordum. Yani mümkün değildi çünkü yargının geldiği noktada dahi böyle bir karar çıkmayacaktı ama Türkiye’de maalesef o kararı alamadık. Avrupa İnsan Hakları Mahkemesinden tüm hak ihlalini sonlandıracak emeklilerin ve memurların yoksullaştırılmasını önleyecek bir karar çıkmasını bekliyorum” diye konuştu.

TÜİK’in açıkladığı enflasyon rakamlarının gerçek olmadığı, milyonlarca memur ve emeklinin yoksulluğuna neden olduğu gerekçesiyle Türkiye’de başlattığı dava sürecinden bir sonuç alamayınca AİHM’ye başvurduğunu anlatan Emekli Danıştay Hakimi Önder Tekin, neden hukuki süreci başlattığına dair anlattı:

“Son 5-6 yıldır TÜİK gerçek enflasyon rakamlarını açıklamıyor. Bu bir siyasi iktidarın politikası yani Türkiye’de gayrisafi yurt içi hasıladan memurların emeklilerin yoksulların işçilerin aldıkları paylar sürekli olarak azaltıldı. Biliyorsunuz memurların, kamu görevlilerinin ve emeklilerin aylıklarında yapılan artışlar enflasyon oranının altında kalırsa enflasyon farkı ödemesi yapılıyor 6 ayda bir. Bu kanun hükmü yani kanunla emekli aylıklarında memur aylıklarında yapılacak artışlar toplu sözleşmeyle belirlenir demekte. Toplu sözleşmeye konulan hükümlerle de eğer yapılan artışların üzerinde bir enflasyon artışı gerçekleşirse bunu da daha sonra 6 aylık dönemden sonra aylıklara artış olarak yapılıyor. Fakat gerçek enflasyon rakamları düşük olarak açıklandığı için tüketici fiyatı düzeyi dediğimiz enflasyon rakamları bu kez memurların, emeklilerin, işçilerin alım güçleri eriyor. Yani gerçek olmadığı için alım güçleri eriyor. Gerçek olsa zaten alım güçleri erimeyecek. Tabii bu bir hak kaybına yol açıyor” diye açıkladı.

Ocak 2022’de, 20 milyon memur ve emekli adına hak arama mücadelesine başladığını ifade eden Emekli Danıştay Hakimi Önder Tekin, “İlk olarak 2021 yılının ikinci 6 aylık enflasyon rakamlarının TÜİK tarafından açıklanan enflasyon rakamlarının gerçeği yansıtmadığı, alım gücümü erittiği, bizleri yoksullaştırdığı için, Danıştayda dava açtım. Çünkü ben Danıştaydan emekli bir hakimim. Danıştay, kendinde görülmesi gerektiği halde davayı görevden reddetti ve ‘Ben görevli değilim, Ankara İdare Mahkemesi görevli’ dedi. Ankara İdare Mahkemesi de hiç olmayacak bir şey gördü; son derece hukuka aykırı bir gerekçeyle benim aylığıma TÜİK enflasyon rakamlarının doğrudan bir etkisinin bulunmadığı gerekçesiyle başvurumu kesin ve yürütülmesi zorunlu işlem yok diye reddetti. Kanun belirlemiş, kanun yazmış bunu ve toplu sözleşmeye konulan hükümlerle de TÜİK enflasyon rakamlarının gerçeğinin yüksek çıkması durumunda, maaş artışlarından aylıklara enflasyon farkı olarak yansıtılacağı öngörülmüş ama İdare Mahkemesi bunların tamamını görmezden geldi ve davayı usulden reddetti. İşin esasına girmedi, çünkü ben dava dilekçemde dedim ki benim alım gücüm eriyor. Bunu ne ben ne de mahkeme belirler. Çünkü onlar da uzman değiller. Bunun için bir bilirkişi heyeti oluşturulmalı ki gerçek rakamlar ortaya çıksın. Ortaya çıksın ki böylece 20 milyon memur ve emeklinin yoksullaştırılma süreci durdurulsun.”

Bu da kabul edilmeyince Bölge İdare Mahkemesine giderek istinaf kanun yolu başvurusunda bulunduğunu anlatan Tekin, “Bölge İdare Mahkemesi de başvurumu gerekçesiz olarak reddetti. İdare Mahkemesi kararını hukuka uygun buldu. Bunun üzerine ben de 2023 yılında Anayasa Mahkemesine bireysel başvuruda bulundum. Bireysel başvurumu 1000 gün beklettiler. Yani 3 yıl. author: Unknown
title: MAN işçisi eylül zammına ek refah payı bekliyor
content:
Merhaba sevgili evrensel okurları. Fabrika yönetimi iki haftalık duruş öncesinde bütün işçileriyle fabrika içerisinde bir toplantı düzenledi. Bu toplantı da bizlere “iyi bir tatil” diledikten sonra üretim ve kalitede yaşanan düşüşten bahsedildi. Prim alamadık, haklarımızda sürekli gerileme mevcutken sendikanın daha önce “Prim alamadık ama primden daha iyi bir hediyemiz olacak” sözünün ne olduğunu yapılan toplantıda açıklarlar diye bekledik. Bu konuda da açıklamaları “Tatil dönüşünde Almanya’dan gelen yöneticiye açıklatacağız” oldu. Tatilden dönülmesine rağmen hâlâ bir açıklama olmadı. Eylül ayında açıklanacağı söylendi.

Toplantıda işçilere sürekli “Biz bir aileyiz” diyen sendika ve yönetim var. Ancak MAN işçisi vergilerin ağırlığından geçinemez bir hale geldi. Vergilerden ve enflasyon karşısında borçlanıp tatile giderek veya tatil planı yapmayarak izinlerimizin iki haftasını geçirebildik. Bu işçiler için iyi bir tatil mi oluyor?

Şimdi hepimiz altı aylık enflasyon farkını bekliyoruz. Beklentimiz, aldığımız farkın en azından vergilere gitmemesi. Böylece en azından maaşımız elimizde kalsın. Madem geçinmekte zorlanırken bizlere “Biz bir aileyiz” diyorlarsa eşya veya çek vermek yerine en temel ihtiyacımız olan refah payı bu enflasyon farkıyla yüksek bir zam oranıyla verilsin. Önümüzde daha dört ay varken refah payı verilmesi yaşantımızı bir nebze daha rahatlatabilir diye düşünüyorum.

author: Unknown
title: Emperyalist rekabette BRICS, dünü ve bugünü-2| Doların karşısında BRICS
content:
Çin Devlet Başkanı Şi Cinping ve Güney Afrika Devlet Başkanı Cyril Ramaphosa | Fotoğraf: BRICS

BRICS denildiğinde tartışmanın en fazla gündeme gelen başlıklarından biri doların geleceği oluyor. “BRICS ortak para çıkaracak, doların egemenliği sona erecek” türünden yorumlar son dönemde sıkça karşımıza çıkıyor. Ancak mevcut tablo bundan daha farklı ve daha somut bir dönüşüme işaret ediyor.

BRICS ülkelerinin önceliği bugün için ortak bir para yaratmaktan çok, ülkelerin birbirleriyle ticaret yaparken dolara olan bağımlılığını azaltmak. Yerel para birimleriyle ticaret, alternatif ödeme sistemleri ve merkez bankalarının dijital para birimlerinin birbirine bağlanması için yürütülen çalışmalar bu arayışın en somut örnekleri. Dolayısıyla tartışılması gereken yalnızca “BRICS yeni bir para çıkaracak mı?” sorusu değil, dolar merkezli uluslararası finans sisteminin karşısına nasıl bir alternatif kurulmaya çalışıldığı.

Uluslararası ticarette doların ağırlığı yalnızca ABD ekonomisinin büyüklüğünden kaynaklanmıyor. Dolar, ticaretin, rezervlerin, borçlanmanın ve uluslararası ödemelerin temel araçlarından biri. Bu nedenle ABD’nin ekonomik yaptırımları yalnızca kendi pazarını kapatmak anlamına gelmiyor. Dolar sistemi üzerinden başka ülkelerin uluslararası finansmana erişimini de sınırlayabiliyor. Rusya’ya yönelik yaptırımlar bunun en açık örneklerinden biri oldu.

BRICS ülkeleri ticarette ulusal para birimlerinin kullanımını artırmaya çalışıyor. Yeni Kalkınma Bankası da finansman tarafında yerel para kullanımını genişletiyor. Bankanın stratejisinde yerel para cinsinden finansmanın artırılması önemli bir başlık olarak yer alıyor. Bu, doların bir anda uluslararası ticaretten çıkması anlamına gelmiyor. Ancak ülkelerin ticaret yaparken her işlemde dolara ihtiyaç duymasını azaltıyor. Örneğin Çin ile Brezilya arasında yuan ve real üzerinden yapılan ticaret, iki ülkenin işlemlerinin dolar üzerinden gerçekleştirilmesine duyulan ihtiyacı azaltıyor. Rusya açısından ise yerel para kullanımı yaptırımlar nedeniyle daha doğrudan bir zorunluluk haline geldi. Rusya’nın Çin, Hindistan ve diğer ticaret ortaklarıyla dolar ve avro dışındaki para birimleri üzerinden yaptığı işlemler genişledi. Böylece yaptırımların etkisini azaltmak için yeni finansal kanallar ortaya çıktı.

Şimdi tartışma yalnızca hangi para biriminin kullanılacağıyla sınırlı değil. BRICS ülkeleri hızlı ödeme sistemlerinin ve merkez bankası dijital para birimlerinin birbirine bağlanması konusunda da çalışmalar yürütüyor. Çünkü para birimi ile ödeme altyapısı birbirinden farklı meseleler.

Bir ülke kendi para birimiyle ticaret yapmak istese bile karşı tarafla ödeme yapabileceği güvenli ve hızlı bir finansal altyapıya ihtiyaç duyuyor. BRICS’in önündeki mesele tam olarak burada. Eğer üye ülkelerin ödeme sistemleri birbirine bağlanabilirse, uluslararası ticaretin bir bölümünün Batı merkezli finansal altyapıya bağımlılığı azaltılabilir. Bu nedenle BRICS’in “dolar karşıtı” hamlesini yalnızca yeni bir para birimi arayışı üzerinden okumak yanlış. Asıl mesele alternatif bir finansal altyapının kurulup kurulamayacağı.

Dolar hâlâ dünya ekonomisinin merkezindeki para birimi. BRICS ülkelerinin kendi aralarında yerel para kullanması, küresel finans sisteminin bir anda dolar dışına çıkacağı anlamına gelmiyor. Üstelik BRICS ülkelerinin ekonomik çıkarları da aynı değil. Hindistan’ın Çin ile ticaret dengesi sorunları var. Brezilya’nın farklı ekonomik öncelikleri bulunuyor. Körfez ülkeleri hem BRICS ülkeleriyle hem ABD ve Avrupa ile yoğun ilişkilerini sürdürüyor. Dolayısıyla ortak para gibi bütün ülkeleri aynı ekonomik politika etrafında birleştirecek bir mekanizmanın önünde ciddi engeller bulunuyor. Fakat başka bir şey oluyor: Doların alternatifsizliği sorgulanıyor.

Dünyanın farklı bölgelerinde ülkeler artık uluslararası ticarette tek bir para birimine bağımlı kalmadan işlem yapabilecekleri mekanizmalar arıyor.

Doların egemenliğinin zayıflaması, işçilerin yaşam koşullarını kendiliğinden değiştirmeyecek. Uluslararası para sisteminin yeniden düzenlenmesi, sermaye gruplarının daha fazla hareket alanı kazanması için de kullanılabilir. Dolayısıyla BRICS’in alternatif finans arayışının gerçek anlamı yalnızca doların karşısına hangi para biriminin konulacağıyla ölçülemez. Asıl mesele, uluslararası finans sisteminin kimin çıkarlarına göre yeniden kurulacağıdır. Dolar merkezli düzenin gerilemesi bir olanak yaratıyor.

author: Chris Walker
title: Trump Worries GOP Insiders as They Await Help From His Super PAC for Midterms
content:
Sources close to the president have said that he doesn’t want to spend much of his PAC’s $400 million this year.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

Some Republicans are reportedly worried that President Donald Trump is waiting far too long to use funds from his super PAC “war chest” to help them in the midterms — that is, if he decides to help them much at all.

Trump has stated that he intends to aid Republicans in this year’s congressional races, with the aim of helping them retain control of Congress and defeat Democrats at the polls in November. But his comments suggest that he may wait too long to get involved — and that if he does get involved, he may not focus on the races so much as on himself.

“I’m going to take the final 30 days, and maybe a little bit more than that, because it’s all about 35 races. I’m going to go to every one of those 35 places, and we’re going to see if we can get everyone elected,” Trump said at a recent White House dinner.

But waiting until the final month of the campaign is a huge political gamble. Indeed, in the 2018 midterms, 63 percent of voters said they had already made up their minds on which party they planned to support more than 30 days out from the election, a CNN exit poll from that election year demonstrated, while in the 2022 midterms, 68 percent said they made their picks by that point.

Traditionally, Labor Day is considered the unofficial start of the general election season for midterms. But Securing American Greatness, the nonprofit arm of Trump’s MAGA Inc. super PAC, has only released a few ads so far.

Those ads do not focus on the midterms so much as on touting Trump’s supposed accomplishments. For example, one of the ads features Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) president Dana White giving immense praise to Trump. However, the ad makes zero mention of congressional candidates, and centers upon the executive branch’s achievements, failing to provide reasons why voters should back Republicans at ballot boxes this fall.

Another ad touts the “One Big Beautiful Bill” that Trump and Republicans passed into law in 2025. But the ad minimizes congressional Republicans’ role in its passage while celebrating executive orders Trump has signed, which have nothing to do with Congress, let alone GOP candidates for office.

Trump’s advisers have told concerned Republican allies that his MAGA Inc. PAC will help them soon. But the process could require time, if Trump decides to make ads for specific candidates, as federal law requires that he approve each one individually.

Sources speaking to The Washington Post with knowledge of Trump’s thinking said that he doesn’t have much interest in spending a significant portion of his $400 million super PAC funds on the midterms. Instead, Trump could spend the money on himself or his future pet projects, including his post-presidential travel, his presidential library (which is set to cost at least $1 billion), or even to influence the next presidential election.

The current round of ads produced by Trump also worry Republican insiders, who view the spots that center on the president as problematic and likely to harm their chances in the midterms rather than help them, as his current approval ratings are some of the lowest he’s ever seen in office.

“They think he’s popular or something. He’s not,” one Republican ad producer told the Post.

Trump has made clear that he wants to be the main focus of this year’s races.

“What I really want you to do is pretend, please, that I’m on the ballot,” he told voters at a campaign rally last month.

But Trump’s approval ratings are indeed dismally low, legitimizing Republicans’ concerns that he could drag them down in key battleground races if those races become about him.

According to an Economist/YouGov poll published on Tuesday, only 36 percent of Americans approve of the job Trump has done as president, while 60 percent disapprove.

Republican candidates in the midterms aren’t faring well either. As of Thursday, according to an aggregate of polling data from FiftyPlusOne, Democrats are the preferred choice of voters over GOP candidates by about 6 percentage points — enough to likely win control of the House of Representatives, and potentially the Senate as well.

author: Stephen Zunes
title: Democratic Voters Say They Want Change, But the Party Just Elevated More Hawks
content:
Party leaders are ignoring the three-quarters of registered Democrats who oppose providing military aid to Israel.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

Despite growing dissatisfaction among Democratic voters with the U.S.’s ongoing military support for Israel, the House Democratic leadership has picked two foreign policy hawks — Debbie Wasserman Schultz (D-Florida) and Wesley Bell (D-Missouri) — to join the House Foreign Affairs Committee (HFAC), while also promoting an even worse hawk, Jared Moskowitz (D-Florida), to become a ranking member of the Middle East and North Africa subcommittee.

Moskowitz is among the most right-wing Democrats in the House regarding Israel. He opposes any conditions on U.S. military aid to the Netanyahu government and was one of only a dozen Democrats who voted for a 2023 Republican supplemental aid package to Israel during the height of the Gaza genocide. He has conflated criticism of Israeli war crimes with antisemitism and he authored an amendment to ban the use of State Department funds to cite official Gaza casualty figures. He opposes Palestinian statehood except on terms agreed to by Israel, despite the fact that Israel’s current government opposes any kind of Palestinian state. And he was among the small minority of Democrats to vote against the War Powers Resolution targeting U.S. support for Israel’s war on Lebanon and supported sanctioning members of the International Criminal Court for investigating war crimes by Israel or any other U.S. ally.

The HFAC’s ranking member and likely next chair Greg Meeks (D-NY) — similarly a hardline supporter of Israel and of autocratic U.S. allies — unsurprisingly praised the new likeminded appointees and expressed positivity about how they will soon “guide the committee as it addresses urgent challenges in national security and diplomacy.”

Moskowitz’s appointment in particular should be of concern to supporters of human rights and international law: It puts him in the position to chair the subcommittee in the likely event that Democrats gain a majority in the House of Representatives after the November elections.

As chair, Moskowitz would have significant influence over the Middle East policy promoted by the Democratic Party, becoming the party’s de facto spokesperson on the House side and allowing him to shape legislation and oversight involving Israel and the Middle East as a whole. Committee and subcommittee chairs have considerable power in determining who gets to testify, thereby enabling Moskowitz to refuse a fair hearing to human rights advocates and others opposed to U.S. support for the Israeli government and Arab dictatorships.

Upon his appointment, Moskowitz — as a sign of his backing of the Trump administration’s support for the Israeli government and autocratic Arab regimes — pledged to use his position “to strengthen America’s relationships with Israel and our Gulf allies.” And he acknowledged the power that he will have, telling Axios, “If Democrats take control of the House, I’ll be in a position to help steer U.S. policy on Israel and the Middle East.”

Moskowitz was one of only a dozen Democrats who voted for a 2023 Republican supplemental aid package to Israel during the height of the Gaza genocide.

Moskowitz, Wasserman Schultz, and Meeks are grossly out of step with Democratic public opinion. Nearly three-quarters of registered Democrats oppose providing additional military or economic aid to Israel. Indeed, eight out of 10 Democrats and Democratic-leading independents view Israel unfavorably and barely 16 percent think favorably of the U.S.-backed Israeli government. Sixty-five percent of Democrats now sympathize more with Palestinians than Israelis, as compared with 17 percent who side with Israel.

Indeed, there is probably no issue where the policies pursued by the Democratic leadership are so out of step with the views of the rank-and-file.
