title: Control mediante las deudas
content:
Control mediante las deudas


Publicado por Contra información el 2 de Septiembre de 2026, 10:10am


https://www.verdadypaciencia.com/2026/09/control-mediante-las-deudas.html


Como dijo James Garfield: «Quien controla la oferta monetaria de una nación, controla la nación».


«Quien controla el suministro de alimentos controla a la gente», dijo Henry Kissinger, aunque negó haberlo dicho.


Y John McCain afirmó en 2008 que «Quien controla el petróleo controla mucho más que el petróleo».


Si bien sería difícil discrepar con cualquiera de estas tres afirmaciones, hay un tema recurrente: el control.


El control es el eje central de todo. Cada guerra, cada pandemia, cada política gubernamental, cada idea descabellada que surge de un grupo de expertos globalistas.


Algunos de sus planes podrían generarles grandes ganancias, adquirir vastas tierras y recursos, e incluso matar a millones de personas para satisfacer momentáneamente su sed de sangre y sufrimiento, pero en el fondo, todo se reduce al control.


Los demonios al mando, tanto en el mundo de los conocidos y reconocibles como en el de las figuras oscuras e invisibles que los rodean, no se preocupan por acumular más dinero, oro y plata. Tienen más que suficiente de esas riquezas para vivir un millón de años.


Simplemente no quieren que tú y yo tengamos nada de eso. Porque, me guste o no, el dinero en el banco hace que uno sea menos controlable. La seguridad del efectivo en la cartera brinda la libertad de elegir y la libertad de decir no.


Para un culto obsesionado con el control, que tan solo una parte de la población pueda decir no es un problema.


Así, en las últimas décadas hemos presenciado una distribución masiva de la riqueza, de muchos a pocos.


Ningún otro periodo histórico ha facilitado tanto esta apropiación indebida de bienes valiosos como el absurdo cierre del planeta en 2020.


El diablo se siente envalentonado, o desesperado. Depende de cómo se mire.


En cualquier caso, las cosas están cambiando.


La presidenta de la UE, Ursula von der Layen, que no fue elegida democráticamente, declaró esta semana la guerra a los ahorros.


En otras palabras, declaró la guerra a la gente que tiene la capacidad financiera de ser menos controlable.


El Reino Unido anunció que las facturas de energía de la nación volverían a dispararse, ya saben, solo para asegurarse de que menos gente tenga unas cuantas libras extra para ahorrar en su fondo para “hacerme menos controlable”.


Estoy seguro de que es una coincidencia que todos estos escenarios se estén desarrollando al mismo tiempo.


Y aquí viene lo mejor.


La misma semana en que ocurrieron estos dos sucesos aparentemente inconexos, todos los medios de comunicación británicos iniciaron sus campañas de portada sobre la inminente guerra con Rusia y el servicio militar obligatorio que se requeriría para combatirla.


Los artículos detallaban minuciosamente cómo los jóvenes británicos debían negarse a luchar por una nación que claramente los odiaba, advirtiéndoles que, de lo contrario, recibirían un «castigo severo» en el futuro.


Ese castigo severo, al parecer, sería económico.


Así que, ¡buenas noticias, muchachos!, ahora pueden comprar su salvación para no ser carne de cañón del complejo militar-industrial, al mismo tiempo que… no tienen dinero.


La pobreza artificial es claramente un arma no solo para controlar su vida cotidiana, sino también para controlar si, de hecho, podrán seguir teniendo una vida cotidiana.


A los pobres los mandan a la guerra.


Una historia tan antigua como el tiempo, por supuesto, pero ahora casi todos son pobres, y casi todos van a la guerra.


Al menos eso es igualdad, supongo.


Esta técnica de hacer que la gente esté demasiado desesperada como para negarse no se limita solo al Reino Unido y Europa.


La semana pasada, The Jerusalem Post publicó un artículo titulado: «La guerra con Irán no se ganará con ataques aéreos, ¿entonces qué queda?». ¿Tropas terrestres, tal vez?


Botas estadounidenses, por supuesto. Puede que sea la guerra de Israel contra Irán, pero no enviarán las suyas. No seas ingenuo.


Es un artículo bastante descabellado que habla de cómo el pueblo estadounidense no quiere ir a la guerra con Irán. Nunca lo han querido, y parte de la razón es que saben que es la guerra de Israel y no están dispuestos a morir por ello. Al menos no otra vez.


Pero AJ Jaff, el autor del artículo, ha encontrado una solución al problema de que «los estadounidenses se niegan a morir …

author: Publicación Abierta
title: Privatización explosiva: la caja eléctrica del poder
content:
PRIVATIZACIÓN AMAÑADA: LOS HERMANOS JUAN Y PATRICIO NEUSS COMPRARON TRANSENER CON LOS FONDOS QUE LA PROPIA EMPRESA TENÍA EN SU HABER.


LA PRIVATIZACIÓN COMO RUIDO DE FONDO


En el aire de la argentina libertaria, de silencios cargados, de pasillos donde el poder se desliza como electricidad invisible, la privatización de Transener parece contaminar la atmósfera densa, viciada de inquietud. En la superficie, los números: 253 mil millones de pesos en dividendos liberados apenas horas después de que los Neuss y sus socios tomaran el control. Pero debajo, lo que late es la sensación de un truco viejo, un eco de los noventa, un capitalismo de amigos que se repite como un mantra.


El 27 de agosto, el directorio de Transener resolvió repartir esa suma monumental mediante la “desafectación parcial de la cuenta de reserva destinada al pago de futuros dividendos”. Al día siguiente, Genneia comunicó a la CNV la perfección de la transferencia de acciones.


La secuencia es precisa, burocrática, casi quirúrgica. Pero en este aire corroído por el tráfico de influencias, importa más la textura que la cronología: el murmullo de las pantallas en las bolsas del mundo, los documentos enviados a la Comisión Nacional de Valores, el zumbido de los servidores que registran la operación. Una coreografía de datos que oculta la simpleza brutal del movimiento: comprar con la caja de la propia empresa.


La privatización de Transener como metáfora de una conexión que une corrupción, amiguismo y deterioro del patrimonio nacional.


Los nuevos dueños —Genneia de Jorge Brito, Edison de los hermanos Neuss, Newsan de Cherñajovsky y Galli, Inverlat de Stanley y Salvai— aparecen como personajes de una novela coral. Cada uno con su biografía de poder, cada uno con su expansión territorial: Patagonia, Tucumán, Jujuy. La electricidad como metáfora de control, como red que atraviesa el país y conecta a los empresarios con el Estado, con los bancos, con los partidos políticos.


En el territorio de los significantes libertarios, la privatización es un escenario donde se cruzan tres notas periodísticas que denuncian lo mismo:


a) El reparto inmediato: los dividendos se liberan apenas consumada la transferencia, como si el tiempo fuera parte del truco.


b) La falla del sistema: durante la licitación, la oferta de los Neuss no aparecía, luego apareció, más alta, más conveniente. El sistema informático como personaje, como sospecha.


c) La caja heredada: los fondos acumulados cuando el Estado aún era socio, convertidos en botín privado.


La narrativa se vuelve paranoica: pantallas que muestran cifras, funcionarios que hablan de “problemas en el sistema”, empresarios que se sientan en directorios con la naturalidad de quien entra en un living. Todo parece normal, todo parece legal. Pero la atmósfera es de conspiración. Como en la novela «

Ruido de fondo

«, lo que importa no es el hecho sino la sensación de que el hecho está rodeado de un ruido que lo vuelve sospechoso.


El Estado, a través del Fondo de Garantía de Sustentabilidad de la ANSES, conserva un 19,6% de las acciones. Ese detalle introduce un matiz: el sistema previsional argentino participa del dividendo, recibe unos 49 mil millones de pesos. Pero la pregunta que flota es otra: ¿qué posición adoptaron los representantes del FGS frente a la decisión de liberar la reserva? ¿Qué análisis hicieron sobre el efecto que esa caja tenía en la valuación de Transener antes de la privatización?


En clave semiótica, la privatización de Transener es un relato sobre la electricidad como metáfora del poder contemporáneo. Líneas de 500 kV que atraviesan el país, como frases largas que atraviesan la novela. Una red invisible que conecta bancos, ministerios, empresas, familias. El reparto de dividendos es menos un movimiento contable que un gesto literario, un signo de cómo el capital se apropia de la energía acumulada, de cómo el poder se alimenta de reservas construidas en otro tiempo.


La escena final es casi cinematográfica: los Neuss, Brito, Carballo, Cherñajovsky, Galli, Salvai. Una mesa de directorio, papeles firmados, cifras que se repiten en pantallas. Afuera, el país con cortes de luz, con un sistema eléctrico que necesita inversiones. Adentro, la caja se abre y el dinero fluye. Como en «Ruido de Fondo», lo que queda es la sensación de que el verdadero escándalo no está en los números, sino en el ruido que los rodea, en la atmósfera de sospecha que convierte la privatización en un relato de poder …

This presentation is about sharing and reusing publicly available FOSS compliance material, as provided by the OSSelot project (

https://www.osselot.org/

), which requires trust in the reliability of the data. Such trust can be fostered by ensuring high quality and consistency of the data through a standardized curation process and strict review of all contributions. Jan will talk about the curation (and reviewing) process for the OSSelot project and present the resulting material as well as several methods for reuse. The presentation is intended to serve as a basis for discussion on how OSSelot can support Debian maintainers with compliance work.

title: Preparations completed for the International Kurdish Cultural Festival in Dortmund on Saturday
content:
The 34th International Kurdish Cultural Festival will be held in Dortmund on September 5. Ahead of the festival, which is expected to draw large crowds from various European cities, preparations for transportation, venue arrangements, the cultural and artistic program, stands and security have been completed.


The festival will bring together various aspects of Kurdish culture, language, art, literature and folklore. Throughout the day, cultural and artistic events will take place alongside stands showcasing the work of various organizations.


This year’s festival has been dedicated by the Congress of Democratic Societies of Kurdistan in Europe (KCDK-E) and the Kurdish Women’s Movement in Europe (TJK-E) to the “Martyrs of Freedom” and will be held under the slogan “Towards a Democratic Society with Free Leader.”


Large turnout expected


Extensive plans have been made across different parts of Europe to facilitate participation in the festival. The Organizing Committee said it expects a large turnout.


In addition to Kurds living in various European countries and cities, members of other communities and different segments of society are also expected to attend the festival.


Aiming to bring together Kurds from different generations, the festival is being organized not only as a cultural event but also as a platform where the social and cultural experience accumulated in Europe over the years can come together.


Culture and art at the heart of the program


A comprehensive program reflecting various aspects of Kurdish culture will be held throughout the festival grounds. In addition to musical performances and folk dance shows, special activities will also be organized for children.


A dedicated tent for children will host a range of cultural and artistic activities. Spaces have also been set up where young people and members of different generations can showcase their work and cultural productions.


Kurdish Culture Market


One of the key sections of the festival will be the Kurdish Culture Market. Cultural products, publications and traditional works from different cities and regions will be brought together in this area.


Alongside programs featuring invited speakers, the festival also aims to showcase works related to Kurdish literature, language, art and social life.


Europe’s cultural heritage comes together


Publishing houses, writers, newspapers, language institutions, women’s and youth organizations, ecological initiatives, Heyva Sor (Kurdish Red Crescent), institutions from Rojhilat and various civil society organizations active in different European cities will set up stands at the festival.


The stands will showcase the organizations’ work, publications and cultural activities.


The festival will also feature the diverse regional traditions of Kurdish cuisine. A variety of dishes will be offered to participants, ranging from Rojava cuisine and traditional home-cooked meals to regional dishes and desserts.


In this way, alongside music and folklore, the festival aims to bring together culinary traditions from different regions, publishing, language initiatives, traditional production and community activities.


Environmental and hygiene measures at festival stands


Dozens of stands will be set up across the festival grounds. In addition to cultural and information stands, measures have been put in place to ensure compliance with environmental and hygiene standards in food areas.


As part of these measures, a decision was made to use biodegradable materials instead of plastic. All stands are expected to be fully set up by Friday evening, ahead of the festival.


Security arrangements


A comprehensive security plan has also been put in place to ensure that the festival takes place in an orderly and safe manner.


In addition to a professional security company, various federations have formed their own internal security teams. KAWA 1, FED GEL G2, Fed MED NRW, FED KURD Berlin, Dem Northern Germany, Belgium, the Netherlands and Northern France organizations will reportedly take part in the festival’s security arrangements.


Two main entrance gates have been designated at the festival grounds. At each entrance, 110 personnel are expected to carry out security checks and control duties in two shifts. Teams will also be assigned to provide stage security and monitor the parking areas and the outer perimeter of the festival grounds.


Mobile internal security teams have also been formed to respond …

author: Unknown
title: YRK commemorates Simko Serhildan
content:
The East Kurdistan Defense Units (YRK) commemorated Simko Serhildan and those who lost their lives in the 2011 Battle of Qandil on the 15th anniversary of his death. “Through his struggle and revolutionary life, Simko shaped the principles of leadership and the direction of the freedom struggle,” the YRK Command stated. “In the person of Simko, we commemorate those who fell in the Battle of Qandil and all those who lost their lives in the revolution, and we pledge to continue their struggle. To fight along the path that Simko illuminated through his revolutionary stance and to carry forward the torch of his resistance is a great honor and responsibility for us.”


From Rojhilat to different parts of Kurdistan


Simko Serhildan, whose real name was Majid Kavian, was born in Bane in Rojhilat (East Kurdistan) in 1982 and joined the Kurdish freedom movement in 1999. The YRK places his decision in the context of the resistance of the people of East Kurdistan against the international plot targeting Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan. According to the YRK, this stance shaped the path he would subsequently follow.


“From the moment he joined the movement until his death, Simko Serhildan sought to develop himself on the basis of Apoist philosophy and to live in accordance with the legacy of the martyrs.”


YRK stated that Simko Serhildan attached great significance to every step of his revolutionary life. Over the years, he assumed various duties and responsibilities in different parts of Kurdistan.


“With his multifaceted personality, Simko embodied all dimensions of Apoist life and fulfilled every responsibility he undertook. Wherever he was active, he brought people together and established close bonds with his comrades. He fought in different parts of Kurdistan and carried out his work with great love and enthusiasm, both within society and among his comrades,” the statement said.


A defining role in the Battle of Qandil


In the final phase of his life, Simko Serhildan focused on guerrilla activities and preparations for the Revolutionary People’s War. He drew on the experience he had gained in these areas during the battle for Qandil in 2011. At the time, Iran’s Revolutionary Guards launched a large-scale offensive against the Medya Defense Zones. Simko Serhildan assumed a leading role in the defense. The YRK particularly recalled his role in shaping tactics involving small units and defensive operations conducted from tunnel systems.


“Ultimately, he combined his invaluable experience with that of his comrades and crowned the resistance against the occupation by the Revolutionary Guards with victory in the Battle of Qandil,” the statement said. Simko Serhildan lost his life during these clashes.


According to the YRK, his stance at the time is not merely part of the memory of the 2011 resistance. “The stance, leadership and command that Simko developed in this battle and throughout his life will serve as the foundation of our struggle and a guiding force for the freedom revolution.”


“Fifteen years later, the guerrilla forces in Rojhilat continue to draw on this legacy. Every fighter and every commander should continually recreate themselves in the reality of the Simkos and further develop the path of the guerrilla of democratic modernity. As the YRK Command, we declare once again that we will always follow in the footsteps of the Simkos and carry forward, without interruption, the torch of struggle of these great fallen comrades,” the statement concluded.

author: mini-DebConf Switzerland
title: State of Technology in Digital Credentialling
content:
by Josef Spillner


At: MiniDebConf Winterthur 2026


https://ch2026.mini.debconf.org/talks/14-state-of-technology-in-digital-credentialling/


On the finish line after many years of school or university? Nothing beats that moment to finally hold the graduation paper in your hands. Except maybe obtaining an additional digital version. But what can you do with it, how open is the ecosystem, and will it run on Debian and its derivatives? When you dive into that topic, you come across micro-credentials and badges and wallets and blockchains and signed documents and even more to know about, and you may be confused rather than in a position to keep everything under control.


Therefore, this talks sheds some light on the recent technology developments, brings everything into order, and gives practical insights from Swiss universities and other deployments. Due to the processing of personal data, the setup and operation of VMs along with the software services on top of them needs to be well planned, and the talk informs about these aspects. Moreover, the presentation singles out bottlenecks in terms of missing alternatives to non-free components, and explains contributions in terms of code and data.


Room: Campo Foyez (Main Track)


Scheduled start: 2026-08-29 18:00:00+02:00

title: Puavo - a Debian derivative for schools
content:
by Arto Teräs


At: MiniDebConf Winterthur 2026


https://ch2026.mini.debconf.org/talks/23-puavo-a-debian-derivative-for-schools/


Puavo is a Debian based GNU/Linux distribution, which is used in several hundred schools in Finland and in over 50 schools in Germany. It is especially tailored for educational use with focus on efficient device and user management, reliable image-based updates and user friendliness.


The presentation includes the following topics:


Overview of the Puavo distribution including the web based management tools and background infrastructure


How is Puavo based on and how it differs from Debian GNU/Linux


Tools for schools: classroom management and exam mode

title: Apesar de proibição, Polymarket promove apostas sobre eleições brasileiras
content:
“Última hora: chances de Flávio vencer a eleição disparam”. A chamada, publicada em 31.ago.2026 no página do Polymarket no Instagram voltada ao público brasileiro, foi feita num carrossel com oito imagens, com uso de conteúdos da imprensa para dar contexto, memes sobre a situação e, no meio, o gráfico de previsões da empresa sobre quem deve ganhar as eleições presidenciais no Brasil.


No final, há um aviso de que as negociações de contratos envolvem riscos, não estão disponíveis em todas as jurisdições e são proibidas para menores de 18 anos. O post foi publicado em collab com a página @opoeteiro, que soma mais de 2,3 milhões de seguidores, e não há indicação se é uma publicidade.


Polymarket é um mercado de previsão baseado em criptomoedas. Na plataforma, os usuários podem apostar sobre o resultado de eventos futuros do mundo real, como eleições, esportes e até guerras e outros eventos geopolíticos. Está proibida de ofertar e divulgar seviços no Brasil desde 24.abr.


Post no Instagram da @polymarketbrasil (agora @polymarketportugues) do dia 31.ago.2026


Esse é um dos posts mais explícitos realizado pelo Polymarket, apesar de a empresa estar proibida de ofertar e divulgar o serviço no Brasil desde 24.abr. 


Mas não é o único. Até 24.ago, o

Núcleo

 levantou 103 publicações com referência às eleições brasileiras que seguiram o mesmo roteiro, sendo parte delas feitas em colaboração (ou marcação via arroba) com páginas de fofoca, de memes ou comentaristas de esportes e de influenciadores.


Há até referências a site vinculado a aliado de blogueiro bolsonarista e site que recebeu dinheiro de agência ligada ao Banco Master para ampliar alcance (leia mais abaixo).


Por que isso importa?


O parágrafo 7 do artigo 6º da Resolução nº 23.735/2024 do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral veda o uso de plataformas digitais que ofereçam ou prometam, gratuita ou mediante pagamento de qualquer valor, “bens, produtos ou propagandas vinculados a candidatas ou a candidatos ou a resultado do pleito eleitoral”. O descumprimento pode configurar crime eleitoral, como abuso de poder econômico e captação ilícita de votos.

A Secretaria de Prêmios e Apostas (SPA), vinculada ao Ministério da Fazenda, determinou o bloqueio do Polymarket e de outros 26 sites de mercados de previsão, por entender que elas não são intermediadoras de investimentos no mercado financeiro e operam com lógica de bets sem autorização.

A SPA solicitou à Anatel a notificação dos bloqueios aos domínios (www.polymarket.com, por exemplo). A pasta também pediu que as páginas nas redes sociais ficassem indisponíveis no Brasil, o que foi feito por meio do acordo de cooperação com o Conselho Digital do Brasil, organização que tem ao menos 10 big techs associadas, como Meta, Google, TikTok e Discord. A página @polymarket está inacessível para brasileiros no Instagram, mas a @polymarketbrasil segue ativa e acessível na mesma plataforma. Por outro lado, o X não integra a entidade e a página principal do Polymarket também está disponível.


A FSB Comunicação, uma das maiores agências de assessoria de imprensa do Brasil, passou a atender o Polymarket neste ano e confirmou ao

Núcleo

 que a página @polymarketbrasil pertence à empresa.


Coincidentemente, logo após os questionamentos da reportagem, a página mudou o nome de usuário para @polymarketportugues na quarta-feira (2.set.2026). 


A assessoria não respondeu objetivamente aos questionamentos da reportagem sobre a operação da página, a relação com sites e outros perfis no Instagram nem sobre os conteúdos publicados.


Em nota, afirmou apenas que o Polymarket não tem equipe no Brasil, apenas prestadores de serviços pontuais e que a empresa “não apoia candidatos, partidos ou correntes ideológicas, não adota posicionamento editorial sobre eleições”. Disse que não vai comentar sobre “parcerias, campanhas, influenciadores e conteúdos específicos”, mas “reforça seu compromisso com práticas de comunicação transparentes e responsáveis” (leia a íntegra ao final do texto).


Pelos dados do Instagram, a página foi criada em 2021 e mudou de nome de usuário agora pela terceira vez, mas não há detalhes sobre quais foram os outros dois nomes anteriores. Em 2025, a página fez apenas quatro publicações (três em maio e uma em junho) em que uma criadora de conteúdo aparece em vídeos para falar sobre acontecimentos relacionados ao time de futebol do Corinthians. Com a virada do ano, as publicações passaram a ser sobre eventos do Polymarket e o …

title: A School's IT based on Debian GNU/Linux
content:
by Andreas B. Mundt


At: MiniDebConf Winterthur 2026


https://ch2026.mini.debconf.org/talks/21-a-schools-it-based-on-debian-gnulinux/


Abstract


Starting with some ideas -- but also requirements -- the talk describes the development and the implementation of a Debian-based IT-solution for a middle-sized technical secondary (occupational) school.


We start with a

linuxmuster.net School-Server

, but replace the imaging-based client by a Debian KDE desktop clients deployed via PXE boot, preseeding and ansible-pull during the installation.


Proprietary, commercial/industrial software is provided by a sophisticated system of VMs. The VMs are synchronized to the local machine on demand using bittorent. Teachers and/or departments are invited to provide their own customized VM image.


The talk describes the technical concepts and a system, where students not only learn about IT, but also about digital sovereignty, collaboration, community and the power of Free and Open Source Software.

Manîsa

Di serdegirtina malan de rêveberê TUAYDERê Mûhlîs Çiftçî, xebatkarê Meclisa Ciwanan a DEM Partiyê yê Tûrgûtlûyê Mahsûm Yilmaz û Endamê Meclîsa Ciwanan a DEM Partiyê Suleyman Yildiz hatin desteserkirin.

author: Kelly Hayes
title: Organizing for Survival in an Era of Climate Chaos
content:
“Whatever you do, it has to be now,” says organizer Alice Liu.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

Our current infrastructure was built for a world that no longer exists. How do we build the power to survive when the systems we depend on fail us? In this episode of Movement Memos, host Kelly Hayes talks with guests Keyante Aytch, Alice Liu, and Brandon Bunt about the tools and relationships that can help make communities resilient — from mesh networks and off-grid solar to neighborhood disaster hubs.

Music: Son Monarcas and Sarah the Illstrumentalist

Note: This a rush transcript and has been lightly edited for clarity. Copy may not be in its final form.

Kelly Hayes: Welcome to “Movement Memos,” a Truthout podcast about organizing, solidarity, and the work of making change. I’m your host, Kelly Hayes.

Today, we’re talking about what it means to build communities that can weather catastrophe — not simply by stockpiling supplies or preparing as individuals, but by creating relationships, skills, and infrastructure that allow people to take care of one another and exercise control over the systems their lives depend on.

My guests are Keyante Aytch, Alice Liu, and Brandon Bunt, three participants in Climate Mobilization Project’s National Climate Survival Incubator. Keyante is a Chicago-based solar installer who is building off-grid energy systems at community gardens and urban farms. Alice works with West Street Recovery in Houston, where neighborhood-based disaster hubs combine material preparedness with community organizing. And Brandon runs Kiau Technologies, an ecological technology studio developing decentralized tools for farmers, including solar-powered soil sensors and communications systems designed around autonomy and data sovereignty.

This conversation was recorded before the severe storms that struck Northwest Indiana on August 11. In Gary, a predominantly Black city, more than 38,000 utility customers lost power, and some residents went nearly two weeks without electricity. The prolonged blackout disrupted access to food, medicine, communications, and other necessities, while creating especially dangerous conditions for people who rely on electricity for medical care. We won’t be discussing that disaster directly in this episode, but I encourage listeners to listen to this conversation while thinking about what the people of Gary endured — and about what forms of preparedness and infrastructure will allow our communities to care for one another when the systems we depend on fail us.

That work is at the heart of what Keyante, Alice, and Brandon are building. In this episode, we talk about neighborhood disaster hubs, community-controlled solar power, food and energy sovereignty, decentralized communications, and what becomes possible when we stop thinking of resilience as an individual responsibility and start treating it as a collective project. Their work also raises a larger political question: What kinds of power can communities build when they have greater control over the systems that sustain everyday life?

All three of my guests will also be featured in an upcoming event that I’m participating in with Climate Mobilization Project Project. On September 17, they’re hosting Before the Storm, a free online national town hall focused on the 2026 Super El Niño, grassroots climate resilience, and movement strategy in an era of escalating climate disruption and authoritarianism. Keyante, Alice, and Brandon will be sharing lessons from the resilience projects they’re building, and I’ll be joining Daniel Aldana Cohen, co-author of A Planet to Win, for a conversation about political power, local ownership, and where movements need to evolve in the years ahead.

The event is September 17 from 7 to 8:30 p.m. Eastern, or 6 to 7:30 Central. You can find the registration link in the show notes.

For now, I hope you’ll sit with what my guests have to say about the infrastructures we inherit, the infrastructures we build, and the kinds of relationships that might help us survive what’s coming while creating something better.

If you appreciate this podcast, and you would like to support “Movement Memos,” you can subscribe to Truthout’s newsletter or make a donation at truthout.org. author: mini-DebConf Switzerland
title: Making Things Happen in Debian: Changelog, Methods, Lessons Learned
content:
by Andreas Tille


At: MiniDebConf Winterthur 2026


https://ch2026.mini.debconf.org/talks/8-making-things-happen-in-debian-changelog-methods-lessons-learned/


This talk reflects on two years as Debian Project Leader and on the experience of helping coordinate a large, global Free Software project built around volunteer contributions and a do-ocratic culture. I will give a brief “DPL changelog”: what I originally set out to do, which topics shaped the two years, and what we managed to accomplish together as a project.


The main focus of the talk is on methods and day-to-day project coordination. I will discuss how communication, decision making, and collaboration work in practice inside Debian, including the role modern tools such as LLMs played in my work as DPL. Rather than presenting AI as a solution in itself, I want to share practical experiences: where these tools helped with communication, structuring information, or handling repetitive tasks, and where their limitations became visible.


The final part covers lessons learned from working in Debian’s highly distributed volunteer environment. I will reflect on what helps collaboration succeed, where friction can arise, and how Debian adapts to technical and social change while staying grounded in its core values. I also want to touch on sustainable team structures — for example how the Debian Med team continued to work successfully while I stepped back during my DPL terms — as well as Debian’s tradition of strong package ownership and how this influences maintenance and collaboration across the project.

author: David Swanson
title: The U.S. Bombed a Wedding in Iran. It’s Not the First Time
content:
By

Medea Benjamin

, September 3, 2026


On September 1, an American missile

slammed

 into a home in the small Iranian fishing town of Kuhestak, along the Strait of Hormuz, where dozens of people had gathered to celebrate the wedding of a fisherman’s daughter.


At least four people were killed, including 4-year-old Amirali Karimi and 16-year-old Mohammad Mallahi. More than 60 people were wounded. Videos from the scene showed a gaping hole in the roof, concrete walls punctured, doors shattered, ceilings collapsed, and women’s and children’s shoes scattered among the debris. The bomb struck the section of the wedding set aside for women, which is why most of those injured are women and children. Iranian media showed terribly wounded children being treated at a hospital in nearby Minab, the same city where the U.S. bombed an elementary school on the first day of the war, killing 168 people, most of them children.


The Iranian Red Crescent Society has

asked

 the International Criminal Court to investigate the U.S. strike, saying that if the wedding venue was civilian and the attack failed to respect the laws of war, it could constitute a war crime.


Questioned about the strike, U.S. Central Command spokesperson Capt. Tim Hawkins responded that: “The US military never targets civilians, unlike the IRGC.” But the US military also insists that it is using precision weapons—weapons supposedly capable of hitting exactly what the military intends to hit.


The U.S. military has yet to explain why its missile hit the wedding party. But we already know something about what went wrong in the bombing of the Minab elementary school. That strike apparently wasn’t a failure of America’s “precision” weaponry. It was a failure of American intelligence: CENTCOM reportedly used outdated targeting data that still treated a school—separated from an IRGC compound for roughly a decade—as a military target.


After the Minab bombing, 46 Democratic senators

demanded

 answers from Defense Secretary Hegseth: What was the intended target? Why did the strike hit the school? Who authorized it? What weapons were used? What intelligence was used to determine what the building was? What precautions were taken to prevent civilian casualties? They gave him a March 18 deadline. He never responded. The Pentagon reportedly completed its own investigation in April, but it still has not released its findings to Congress or the American public.


Now, with a U.S. missile hitting an Iranian wedding just six months later, the same questions about targeting, intelligence and civilian protection are being asked all over again. And the tragedy in Kuhestak is part of an even longer and more disturbing pattern: the United States has repeatedly turned wedding celebrations into scenes of carnage.


In fact, American forces have bombed at least eight other wedding parties or wedding processions since 2001.


A h

istorical review

 published back in 2013 by

The Nation

 identified at least eight U.S. attacks on wedding parties or wedding processions between 2001 and 2013—six in Afghanistan, one in Iraq and one in Yemen. The estimated death toll from those eight attacks approached 300 people.


One of the most notorious attacks occurred in Afghanistan in July 2002, when U.S. aircraft attacked a wedding celebration in Uruzgan province. Afghan officials said dozens of civilians were killed. Another Afghan wedding was devastated in 2008 when an airstrike reportedly killed 47 civilians, including the bride.


The US has also hit wedding parties in Yemen. On December 12, 2013, a U.S. drone fired four Hellfire missiles at an 11-vehicle wedding procession near the city of Rad’a. At least

15 people were killed

 and 15 wounded. The bride herself was struck by shrapnel.


Human Rights Watch investigated the attack extensively. Witnesses described a festive convoy of 50 to 60 people accompanying the newlyweds when missiles suddenly struck the vehicles. One survivor

summed up

 the horror simply: “We were in a wedding, but all of a sudden it became a funeral.”


At the time, CODEPINK launched a campaign to get answers, and to press the U.S. government to apologize to and compensate the victims. We even

staged

 a mock wedding in front of the White House, dressed in wedding clothes, and reenacted a drone strike to show Americans what it meant for a joyous family celebration to suddenly become a scene of carnage.


The U.S. military insists it does not target …

author: David Swanson
title: Book Introduction: NATO: What You Need to Know by Medea Benjamin and David Swanson
content:
Asia, Chapters, East and Southeast Asia, Japan Chapter, NATO, World

By WBW Japan Chapter Co-Coordinator Gerry Yokota, World BEYOND War, September 3, 2026

When the prospect of Ukraine joining NATO became a topic of discussion four years ago, most Japanese people viewed the alliance as irrelevant to Japan. However, there have been large shifts in the global landscape since then. We have seen the establishment of a Japanese government mission to NATO and the participation of Japanese foreign and defense ministers in NATO summits. Furthermore, NATO participated in RIMPAC 2026 this summer, even though the U.S. and Canada are the only two member countries that actually have borders on the Pacific. The depth of Japan’s involvement is undeniable. Is it not essential, then, for us to understand the true nature of NATO? Co-authored by representatives from CODEPINK and World BEYOND War, this book offers crucial insights into NATO’s role in perpetuating wars waged across the globe. It provides abundant evidence to backup the statement that Jeffrey Sachs makes in the Preface: “NATO is a clear and present danger to world peace and a war machine that has run amok, beyond the democratic control of the citizens of its member nations.”

The book comprises the following 11 chapters: 1. When and Why Was NATO Formed? 2. NATO Expansion 3. NATO’s History of Aggression 4. NATO in Ukraine, but No Ukraine in NATO? 5. NATO “Partners” around the Globe 6. Who Makes the Decisions and Who Pays? 7. How Does NATO Relate to the UN and International Law? 8. NATO and Nuclear Weapons 9. What Are the Divisions within NATO? 10. What Are NATO’s Plans 11. What Are the Alternatives? In the following sections, I will highlight interesting points from each chapter to explore the “true nature” of NATO that the authors aim to convey.

In Chapter 1, the authors explain when and why NATO was formed. NATO was established in 1949 by twelve nations. Its first Secretary General, Lord Ismay, wryly described its purpose as “to keep the Soviet Union out, the United States in, and Germany down.” Article 5 of the treaty stipulates that, in the event of an armed attack against a member state, all members agrees to take action to restore the security of the North Atlantic region. The authors point out that this clause has been invoked only once—following the 9/11 terrorist attacks in 2001. Since Afghanistan had not attacked any NATO member state, the application of this clause is viewed as a form of abuse that masked the gap between stated principles and actual motives. In this context, “democratic values”—which the alliance was meant to protect—were conflated with capitalism, while communism and socialism were treated as undemocratic. The authors attribute this perspective to the political climate of postwar Europe, where communist and socialist parties—having played leading roles in the resistance against Nazism and fascism—were garnering significant electoral support. The authors also discuss the role NATO played in prolonging colonialism, citing as an example its support for France during the Algerian War of Independence (1954–1962). They further present numerous cases demonstrating that economic privatization was a key condition for NATO membership. For instance, Joe Biden informed Poland that, to be considered for membership, it would have to privatize its state-owned enterprises. The authors also reveal how NATO has served U.S. economic interests by supporting the American arms industry; notably, the lobbying group known as the “U.S. Committee to Expand NATO” was led by a vice president of Lockheed Martin.

Chapter 1 then surveys the history of the Warsaw Pact, which was formed in 1955 following West Germany’s accession to NATO. Interestingly, a year before the Warsaw Pact was established, the Soviet Union had inquired about the possibility of joining NATO itself. In 1990, East Germany withdrew from the Warsaw Pact in preparation for reunification with West Germany. The Warsaw Pact was formally dissolved on July 1, 1991—just before the collapse of the Soviet Union itself. Many observers had predicted that the demise of the Warsaw Pact would also signal the end of NATO, but that prediction proved incorrect. NATO rejected the “peace dividend” and instead chose to reap the “dividend of power” (the expansion of military superiority).

author: David Swanson
title: 25 Years Ago, 9/11 Triggered a U.S. Crusade of Torture
content:
By Norman Solomon, World BEYOND War, September 3, 2026


A quarter-century has passed since the terrorist attack that killed almost 3,000 people in the United States on Sept. 11, 2001. During the first seven years after that mass atrocity, Pentagon spending

doubled

. The aftermath of 9/11 was also a huge boost for “the intelligence community.” Despite – and because of – their failure to prevent the carnage on that day, the CIA and the National Security Agency as well as 14 smaller spy agencies boomed with

enormous jolts of funds

.


Along the way, some line items paid for torture that persisted during the George W. Bush presidency under the euphemism of “enhanced interrogation techniques.”


The most publicized location was Guantánamo on the island of Cuba. There, “the U.S. opened the offshore detention facility in an attempt to evade the rule of law,” the London-based organization Freedom From Torture

reports

. “In the name of the U.S.’s ‘War on Terror,’ people deemed by the U.S. to be ‘enemy combatants’ were detained at the facility. Many were tortured and denied basic human rights and due process… Since the first detainees arrived in 2002, Guantánamo Bay has imprisoned 780 men and boys from 48 countries…. Yet only 16 detainees have ever been convicted of a crime – just 2 percent.”


Despite public pressure, Bush vetoed a version of the Intelligence Authorization Act in March 2008 that would have required CIA interrogators to adhere to Army Field Manual regulations. As soon as Barack Obama became president, he issued an executive order

rescinding

 the free hand for the CIA director on interrogations that Bush had reaffirmed in a July 2007 order. Obama’s directive removed the CIA’s detention power and required the agency to follow Army Field Manual rules.


Yet five and a half years went by before President Obama

acknowledged

, in his notable words, “We tortured some folks.” He told a news conference: “When we engaged in some of these enhanced interrogation techniques, techniques that I believe and I think any fair-minded person would believe were torture, we crossed a line.”


The acknowledgement came four months before the long-awaited release of a

report

 in December 2014 by the Senate Select Committee on Intelligence. While heavily redacted, it was a political indictment of torture. “CIA personnel, aided by two outside contractors, decided to initiate a program of indefinite secret detention and the use of brutal interrogation techniques in violation of U.S. law, treaty obligations, and our values,” wrote the committee’s chair, Senator Dianne Feinstein. Among the report’s conclusions:


“The CIA’s justification for the use of its enhanced interrogation techniques rested on inaccurate claims of their effectiveness.”


“The interrogations of CIA detainees were brutal and far worse than the CIA represented to policymakers and others.”


“The CIA has actively avoided or impeded congressional oversight of the program.”


“Two contract psychologists devised the CIA’s enhanced interrogation techniques and played a central role in the operation, assessments, and management of the CIA’s Detention and Interrogation Program.”


Months later, the

New England Journal of Medicine


summed up

 aspects of the Senate committee’s findings: “Medical professionals, primarily private contractors, filled four basic roles at the black sites: clearing terrorist suspects as ‘medically fit’ for torture; monitoring torture to prevent death and treat injuries; developing novel torture methods; and actually torturing prisoners. All these actions were taken only after CIA and U.S. Department of Justice attorneys assured the medical professionals that they had immunity from prosecution and would not be held legally responsible for violating U.S. and international law against torture as long as they used the techniques approved in legal memos (since withdrawn) written to justify their actions. Lawyers agreed to provide immunity assurances that specific torture techniques were legal ‘enhanced interrogation’ methods only if the physicians assured them that they would be present to prevent permanent harm to prisoners. The CIA opened more than a dozen black sites around the world after 9/11, in which at least 117 prisoners were held; 39 of these prisoners were subjected to one or more torture techniques.”

title: "Modern-Day Poll Tax": Dem. Texas Commissioner Slams GOP Vote to Close 92 Polling Sites
content:
Ahead of the November midterm elections, Republican officials in the third most populous county of Texas have voted to slash the number of polling sites by nearly one-third. Tarrant County, which includes Fort Worth, will have just 224 polling sites for 1.3 million voters. The change was approved in a party-line vote Tuesday, with all three of the county’s Republican commissioners voting in favor and the two Democrats opposing it. Civil rights groups including the

ACLU

 and

NAACP

 warn the changes will disproportionately affect voters of color.


“The eyes of the nation are on Tarrant County,” says Roderick Miles Jr., a Democratic Tarrant County commissioner, who calls the voting restriction a “modern-day poll tax.”

author: Mosha Folger
title: Nunavut, Nuuk deepsea port companies co-ordinate for better emergency response
content:
Three deepsea port companies in Nunavut and Greenland have signed an agreement to co-ordinate for better response to maritime emergencies, such as groundings and spills.


Qikiqtaaluk AEDC, the proponent of the Qikiqtarjuaq deepsea port, and West Kitikmeot Resources Corp., the proponent of the Grays Bay Road and deepsea port, have been in talks with Sikuki Nuuk Harbour A/S since 2020, said West Kitikmeot’s CEO Brendan Bell in an interview Tuesday.


“Greenland is a great example for us to aspire to,” Bell said by phone from his office in Calgary. “With respect to, more broadly, infrastructure, but certainly on the port side.”


The companies have signed a memorandum of understanding, which is a non-binding document that outlines similar goals and values, to “strengthen co-operation between maritime infrastructure,” said a joint news release from the firms, published Monday.


Serious discussions about making an official agreement occurred over the last year and a half.


“[The ports] are awfully far from each other,” Bell said, “but together their impact can be much greater. Their utility can be much higher if they’re connected and co-ordinated as a series of infrastructure assets in the Arctic.”


For example, he said, in case of an emergency, such as a grounding or a spill, having ships already stationed in the Arctic and ready to deploy means quicker response times.


Bell said that the longer ice-free seasons in the North American Arctic will inevitably lead to more shipping through the Northwest Passage, which means more mishaps.


“This is all motivating our need to get together and have this discussion,” he said. “Before it’s too late … and we aren’t able to respond to spills, or potential shipping disasters, or the need for search and rescue assets to be deployed.”


Representatives from West Kitikmeot Resources Corp. and Qikiqtaaluk AEDC are part of a trade mission to Greenland this week, headed up by Nunavut Tunngavik Inc.


The signatories of Monday’s memorandum of understanding will meet in Nuuk to discuss their next steps, Bell said, adding that he’s eager to learn from Greenland and to apply those lessons to Grays Bay.


Asked what those next steps could be, Bell declined to answer, saying, “I don’t want to scoop myself.”


“We and [Qikiqtaaluk AEDC] are in the planning stage at the moment, and there’s a lot to be learned from Nuuk,” he said. “Things to do, things to avoid, opportunities to take advantage of.”


In a statement to Nunatsiaq News, representatives from Sikuki said they previously spoke about business activities informally with the two Nunavut companies. The memorandum of understanding allows the trio to have a more structured relationship.


“It is a foundation to build on,” the statement reads, adding that the group will explore opportunities for co-ordinated emergency-response, supporting vessels and sharing information on how to operate an Arctic port safely.

author: Joakim
title: Sweden’s Employment Protection Act Is a Joke
content:
Article from Znetwork. Translated from the Swedish union paper Arbetaren. The author is a member of the syndicalist union SAC.

Labor lawyer Rasmus Hästbacka writes about Sweden’s supposedly strong legal protection for workers.

I often find myself in grim negotiations where the employer has already decided to fire workers because they’ve suffered workplace injuries or illnesses – or because they’re union activists or health-and-safety delegates. In such situations, the employer doesn’t care one bit about the Swedish Employment Protection Act, abbreviated LAS. Workers are offered a “voluntary” buyout under the threat of a forced buyout. How does that work?

First, you need to understand that firing people in Sweden has never been difficult – at least not legally, only financially costly in some cases. Under Section 39 of LAS, employers can always dismiss workers and then buy them out against their will. Even if you’re fired in violation of the law, and even if a court rules that the employer broke the law, the employer can simply buy their way out of the verdict by paying the damages specified in Section 39. In short, the law literally states that money stands above the law.

A forced buyout therefore means that you lose your job even if you win in court. The very name of the law – the Employment Protection Act – is therefore somewhat misleading. A more accurate name would be the Law on Employers’ Right to Fire Workers on Any Grounds They Please.

Since all Swedish unions know how Section 39 of LAS works, it’s rarely worth pursuing a legal dispute all the way to a verdict. Instead, it becomes a negotiation over the price of the “voluntary” buyout.

Even when unions are prepared to fight all the way to a verdict, it’s rare that the affected workers can endure the process. Fired workers must find a new job or try to support their families on unemployment benefits (if that’s even possible). Mentally, it can be extremely tough to both fight in court over the old job and try to start a new one. It’s also not uncommon for employers to harass workers and break down their confidence, after which the worker accepts a shamefully low offer.

Thus, buyouts usually end up far lower than the damages workers could have received in court.

Under Section 39 of LAS, dismissed workers are entitled to at least 6 and at most 32 months’ salary, depending on how long they’ve been employed. The last time I sat in one of these grim negotiations, the fired worker received 150,000 Swedish kronor (approximately 15,600 US dollars). In the case before that, we managed to secure 12 months’ salary. And the case after that resulted in 17 months’ salary. That’s unusually good – but still far too low, considering the worker shouldn’t have been fired at all.

In short, the law literally states that money stands above the law.

So, how should unions approach these dirty negotiations? Some syndicalists argue that you should always say NO to buyouts. I understand the sentiment, but employers can still fire and buy people out regardless.

I think we should dispel all illusions that Sweden’s legal system can save people’s jobs. The law can help fired workers “own the narrative” to some extent. More precisely, when workers apply for new jobs and are asked whether they were fired from their previous one, they can answer: “Yes, but the employer violated LAS and paid damages for it.” The law can also provide a band-aid through damages – but saving workers’ jobs requires other methods.

More articles by the author here.

title: "Catastrophic Failure": Postal Service Whistleblower Warns Mail-In Voting Rules Could Derail Election
content:
An anonymous federal whistleblower has warned that the Trump administration’s new system for handling mail ballots through the U.S. Postal Service is untested, fatally flawed and likely to lead to a “catastrophic failure” if it’s implemented ahead of November’s midterm elections. This follows President Trump’s executive order in March directing his administration to create federal lists of citizens and to refuse delivery of mail-in ballots to people not on those lists. The legality of Trump’s executive order is being challenged.


The new hurdles raised by the executive order for mail ballots and the rushed software system built to administer them “create this potential for grave, catastrophic failure,” says David Kligerman from Whistleblower Aid, the organization representing the whistleblower.

title: IPv6 não é só mais IP - DAD e o fim dos endereços duplicados
content:
by Rony Sousa


At: MiniDebConf Campinas 2026


https://campinas.mini.debconf.org/talks/16-ipv6-nao-e-so-mais-ip-dad-e-o-fim-dos-enderecos-duplicados/


Durante décadas, redes IPv4 conviveram com um problema recorrente e estrutural. Endereços IP duplicados, causados por configuração manual, falhas de DHCP ou ambientes híbridos e virtualizados. Ferramentas tradicionais do software livre, como ifconfig, refletiam esse modelo ao permitir a atribuição direta de endereços, sem qualquer mecanismo nativo de verificação de conflitos.


Esta palestra apresenta o IPv6 como uma evolução em usabilidade, indo muito além do simples aumento do espaço de endereços. O foco está no Duplicate Address Detection (DAD), um mecanismo nativo do protocolo que detecta automaticamente conflitos de endereçamento antes que o endereço seja efetivamente utilizado.


A partir da evolução das ferramentas GNU/Linux — do ifconfig ao ip (iproute2) — é demonstrado como o DAD se integra ao kernel Linux por meio do Neighbor Discovery (ICMPv6), permitindo redes mais confiáveis, autônomas e resilientes. A palestra evidencia como o IPv6 resolve, na raiz, um problema histórico do IPv4, tornando-se especialmente adequado para ambientes modernos como virtualização, containers e automação de rede.

title: BitDogLab - Cultura Maker, Software Livre e Sistemas Embarcados na Educação
content:
by Fabiano Fruett


At: MiniDebConf Campinas 2026


https://campinas.mini.debconf.org/talks/40-bitdoglab-cultura-maker-software-livre-e-sistemas-embarcados-na-educacao/


A palestra “BitDogLab - Cultura Maker, Software Livre e Sistemas Embarcados na Educação” apresenta o ecossistema BitDogLab como uma iniciativa de tecnologia aberta voltada à formação de estudantes, professores e comunidades interessadas em programação, eletrônica, robótica e computação física. Mais do que uma placa didática, a BitDogLab é uma plataforma educacional que integra hardware aberto, software livre, documentação compartilhada e práticas pedagógicas mão na massa.


A proposta parte da ideia de que estudantes devem ser não apenas usuários, mas criadores de tecnologia. Nesse contexto, a cultura maker é tratada como abordagem de aprendizagem ativa, baseada em experimentação, criatividade, colaboração e resolução de problemas reais. A palestra destaca como esse modelo favorece maior engajamento e compreensão dos fundamentos dos sistemas digitais e embarcados.


Outro ponto central é o papel do software livre e das tecnologias abertas na democratização do acesso ao conhecimento. Ao utilizar ferramentas abertas e soluções adaptáveis, o ecossistema BitDogLab promove autonomia, redução de custos, transparência tecnológica e maior aderência às necessidades de escolas, universidades e projetos sociais.


A apresentação também mostra como o ensino de sistemas embarcados pode aproximar teoria e prática por meio de atividades com sensores, atuadores, programação e integração entre hardware e software. Por fim, discute-se a importância de construir um verdadeiro ecossistema, envolvendo materiais didáticos, oficinas, repositórios, exemplos de código e colaboração entre diferentes atores.


Assim, a BitDogLab é apresentada como uma contribuição concreta para fortalecer a educação tecnológica aberta, criativa e inclusiva no Brasil.

title: Zülfü Livaneli: We must be advocates for peace
content:
Musician and writer Zülfü Livaneli spoke to ANF and called on the government to take concrete steps to build stronger public support for the Peace and Democratic Society Process.


Livaneli marked 1 September World Peace Day, saying: “I wish a happy Peace Day to all our friends who long for peace, and I hope it will mark a step forward on the path to peace.”


Livaneli stressed the importance of the relationship between culture, art and peace and said: “The relationship between culture and peace is inseparable. Culture is in itself an act of peace. The same is true of work in the field of culture. There can be no understanding of art that incites war or creates a culture of war; we do not regard that as art. Agitating people and sending them to their deaths, sending young people to die, is not art. Art, in all its forms, serves peace, or rather, it should serve peace. If we look at history, it is always the poets, writers and philosophers who stood for peace who have endured in this world; the others have not.”


Artists should be agitators for peace


Livaneli criticised approaches that fuel hatred and said art brings out the sense of goodness within people: “Art means having faith in the human heart. It means recognising that deep within the human heart there are sparks of goodness, even in the worst person. As Yaşar Kemal said, it means seeing that even the worst person carries a seed of goodness in their heart. Art, in a sense, brings that out. As Charlie Chaplin said, ‘I am an agitator for peace,’ art stirs up peace; it awakens feelings of peace and humanity and reminds us what it means to be human.


The first condition of being human is empathy. You feel your own pain, but you must also feel the pain of the person on the other side. If you cannot feel that, it disappears. Yet you do not hear this in the language of the media, nor do you hear it in the language of politicians. Everything is reduced to numbers and interpreted ideologically.


But when artists show you that the person on the other side is also human, that they suffer, think and have a family, something extraordinary happens. A news report saying ‘100,000 people were killed’ does not convey the same thing. But when a powerful work of art shows what happened to one person or one family, everyone feels that pain in their heart.


This is why art and culture are so important. The cultures of all peoples, without exception, are worthy of respect. They have flowed down through hundreds and thousands of years of history. Respecting these cultures and being able to reach people, whatever their culture, through their own culture, language and music may well be our greatest path to salvation in this world.”


Demirtaş must be released


Asked about the role of artists and intellectuals in the Peace and Democratic Society Process, Livaneli also underlined the government’s responsibilities: “Yes, when a country’s intellectuals and artists feel a sense of responsibility, they inevitably become closer to society. As you know, over the years we held many press conferences and organised signature campaigns on these issues. We went to court hearings with Yaşar Kemal, Mehmet Uzun and all our friends who are sadly no longer with us. We carried out a completely different initiative with the Greeks. We did the same with our Armenian friends. In other words, we stood alongside everyone who was oppressed.


That could still be done today, but, of course, the situation is now more complicated. It is more political and more complex. There is a certain amount of confusion in people’s minds. Peace is, of course, something we all wholeheartedly support and want. We want it to come as soon as possible, for the guns to fall silent and for mothers to be reunited with their children. That has been our wish from the very beginning, even our dream.


But there are steps that could reassure all of us and give society confidence. One of those steps is the release of Selahattin Demirtaş. If something like that happens, society will have greater confidence in this process. Because while these talks and measures such as amnesties are being put into practice on the one hand, the fact that a political leader like Demirtaş, who has advocated peace, has been imprisoned for so many years creates a contradiction. These contradictions understandably leave people confused.


Still, peace is peace. There is no more beautiful word in the world than peace. From the bottom of my heart, I want to …

title: DFG: Pressure and legal proceedings against journalists continued in August
content:
The Dicle Fırat Journalists Association (DFG) published its August report on rights violations against journalists in Turkey and Kurdistan. According to the report, three journalists were detained and one was imprisoned in August. Investigations were launched against five journalists, while the trials of four journalists continued in two separate cases.


The report stated that journalists faced legal proceedings over their news reports, interviews and social media posts. The detention of Aydın Denge newspaper employees over a death announcement and the arrest of journalist İrem Delice as part of the same investigation were cited as examples of journalistic activities being subjected to legal sanctions.


Investigations over news reports and social media posts


DFG stated that journalists’ news reports and social media posts were also subject to investigations in August. An investigation was launched against İlke TV reporter Zilan Azad over an interview she conducted, while former Hürriyet Editor-in-Chief Ertuğrul Özkök faced an investigation over remarks he made during a broadcast.


Journalist Can Bursalı was released under judicial control over his news reports and social media posts, while an investigation was launched against journalist Burhan Can Terzi over his sports reporting. İzmir Journalists Association President Dilek Gappi was summoned to give a statement over remarks she made concerning journalists.


Access blocked to numerous news reports and accounts


The report emphasized that digital censorship also constituted a significant dimension of the pressure on press freedom. It stated that access to various news reports and social media accounts was blocked in August.


News reports and social media posts concerning Zülfikarlar Holding, the suspicious death of Rojin Kabaiş and Medipol were subject to access restrictions, along with the social media accounts of various journalists and media outlets.


On the other hand, access to the X accounts of Medya Haber, Etkin News Agency and JINNEWS was blocked, while Mezopotamya Agency’s X accounts were made inaccessible from Turkey and access to Nujin Media’s Instagram account was restricted. JINNEWS’s YouTube channel, which had previously been blocked in Turkey, was shut down entirely in August.


DFG stated that, in addition to journalists facing investigations, detention and imprisonment over their professional activities, restrictions on access to news content directly affect the public’s right to information. The association called for an end to legal proceedings against journalists and restrictions on access to digital content.

title: Girne’deki gemi kazası: Dokuz şüpheli ikinci kez hakim karşısına​​ çıktı
content:
Kuzey Kıbrıs’ın Girne kenti açıklarında 30 Ağustos’ta alabora olan gemi ile ilgili aralarında kaptan, mürettebat ve şirket çalışanlarının da bulunduğu dokuz şüpheli, bugün ikinci kez hakim karşısına çıktı.


Anadolu Ajansı’nın aktardığına göre, toplam 16 kişi hakkındaki soruşturmada dokuz şüphelinin Girne Kaza Mahkemesi’ne getirilişi sırasında polis geniş güvenlik önlemleri aldı.


Filo Jet gemi kazası soruşturması: Dokuz kişi hakkında üç günlük gözaltı kararı


31 Ağustos 2026


Hakimlik gözaltında bulunan kaptan M.Ö’nün yanı sıra ikinci kaptan M.N.S. ve mürettebattan M.G, S.E, V.H, R.İ, Z.Ö. ve K.K. ile şirket çalışanı A.Ö’ye kazayla ilgili sorular sordu.


İfade veren polis memuru, kaza ile ilgili çok sayıda delil, belge ve ifadenin mevcut olduğunu aktarırken, mahkeme dokuz şüphelinin alkol ve uyuşturucu test sonuçlarının henüz kendilerine ulaşmadığını açıkladı.


M.Ö’nün önceki ehliyetinin geçerlilik süresinin sonunda yeni kaptanlık ehliyetini Honduras’tan 3 bin 500 dolara aldığı, bunun KKTC tarafından denk kabul edildiği, bu anlamda bir yasal sorun bulunmadığı kayıtlara girdi.


Girne’deki feribot kazasında kaybolan kişiler hakkında neler biliyoruz?


31 Ağustos 2026


İkinci kaptan: “Sefere çıkılmaması konusunda uyardım”


Geminin ikinci kaptanı M.N.S. ifadesinde, kaza günü kaptanı sefere çıkmaması konusunda uyardığını, kaptanın buna rağmen sefer kararı verdiğini iddia etti.


M.N.S, sefer kararını kaptanın vermesine karşı çıkmasına rağmen yolcu gemisinin limandan çıktığını öne sürdü.


İkinci kaptan, gemi kaptanının geminin su aldığından haberdar olduğunu, buna rağmen sefere engel teşkil etmediği yönündeki değerlendirmesi sonucu hareket ettiği bilgisini de ifadesinde dile getirdi.


Filo Jet gemi kazası raporu ne söylüyor?


31 Ağustos 2026


Bilirkişi raporu: “Gemi hızını kesseydi batmadan limana dönebilirdi”


Mahkeme heyeti, geminin kara kutusunun henüz bulunamamasından dolayı kayıtların kendilerine ulaşmadığını kaydederek, kaptanın gemiden ayrılırken seyir defterini de yanına almadığının belirlendiğini açıkladı.


Gemiden acil yardım çağrısını yapanın ikinci kaptan M.N.S. olduğunu tespit eden mahkeme, geminin geçmişte yaptığı kazalar ve gördüğü onarımlar ile birlikte tüm izinlerinin dosyaya girdiğini belirtti.


Sunulan ilk bilirkişi raporlarında da geminin su almaya başladığı andan itibaren hız kesmesi durumunda batmadan limana dönme ihtimalinin yüksek olduğu değerlendirmesine yer verildi.


Girne’de gemiye çıkış izni veren liman yetkilileri görevden uzaklaştırıldı


31 Ağustos 2026


Sekizer gün ek gözaltı süresi


Soruşturmada dokuz kişinin gözaltı sürelerinin sekizer gün daha uzatılmasına, gerekli ifadelerin alınmasına ve ilgili delillerin toplanmasına hükmedildi.


Ayrıca ikisi liman görevlisi ve üçü şirket çalışanı olmak üzere beş şüphelinin mahkemeye gelmelerine gerek görülmezken polisin sunduğu raporda, aranan iki şüphelinin Kuzey Kıbrıs dışında oldukları bilgisi yer aldı.


KKTC Ulaştırma Bakanı görevden alındı, koalisyon ortağı YDP hükümetten çekildi


Bugün  13:00


Filo Jet gemi kazası


Kuzey Kıbrıs’taki Girne Limanı ile Mersin’deki Taşucu Limanı arasında sefer yapan “Filo Jet” isimli yüksek hızlı yolcu gemisi, 30 Ağustos Pazar günü öğle saatlerinde Girne’den hareket ettikten kısa süre sonra ön kısmından su almaya başlamıştı.


Girne Limanı’na dönmeye çalıştığı sırada alabora olan gemiden 239 kişi kurtarılmış, 9 kişinin cenazesine ulaşılmış, kayıp 19 kişi için arama çalışması başlatılmıştı.


Batan geminin enkazı, Girne açıklarında denizin 550 metre derinliğinde bulunmuştu.


Kayıp kişileri bulmak için arama-kurtarma çalışmaları beşinci gününde (3 Eylül) devam ediyor.

author: Unknown
title: İncelenen 900 okul binasına dair vahim tablo: Binaların 3’te 1’inden fazlası riskliydi ve yıkıldı
content:
Vural Nasuhbeyoğlu [email protected]

Millî Eğitim Bakanlığı (MEB) ile 15 üniversitesi arasında imzalanan eğitim yapılarının afetlere karşı güvenliği için iş birliği protokolü okul binalarının vahim durumunu ortaya koydu. İş birliği protokolünün imza töreninde MEB’in üniversitelerle teknik iş birliğinin ilk uygulamasının 2026’da gerçekleştirildiği ve incelenen 900 okul binasından 396'sı için yıkım kararı verildiği ortaya çıktı. MEB’in verilerine göre incelenen okul binalarının 3’te 1’inden fazlasının riskli olduğunun ortaya çıkması ve yıkım kararı verilmesi dikkat çekti. Veriler, henüz incelenmeyen MEB’e bağlı yaklaşık 60 bin kamu okulu binaları ne durumda sorusunu da gündeme getirdi.

Adıyaman'da yıkılan bir okulun enkazı | Fotoğraf: Şerif Karataş/Evrensel

Adıyaman'da yıkılan bir okulun enkazı | Fotoğraf: Şerif Karataş/Evrensel

Öte yandan depreme dayanıksız olduğu için yıkılan ama yerine yenisi yapılmayan okullar nedeniyle bu eğitim öğretim yılı yine birçok ilde birleştirilmiş okullarda başlayacak. Birçok ilde bir binada 2-3 okul hatta kimi yerlerde 5 okul ve öğrencileri aynı binaya sıkıştırılacak. Bu da temizlik sorunundan ders sürelerinin kısalmasına kadar birçok eşitsizliği beraberinde getirecek.

MEB ile 15 üniversite arasında Mogan Mesleki ve Teknik Anadolu Lisesi Uygulama Otelinde düzenlenen imza töreninde MEB İnşaat ve Emlak Genel Müdürlüğü yetkilileri ile 15 üniversitenin yetkilileri katıldı. Protokolün 81 ili kapsayacağı ve geniş iş birliği kapsamında üniversiteler için çalışma bölgeleri belirleneceği belirtildi. Protokol kapsamında Bakanlığa bağlı her tür ve kademedeki eğitim kurumu binaları ile eklentilerinin afetlere karşı dirençliliğinin artırılması, afet risklerinin tespit edilerek azaltılması ve yapısal güvenliklerinin değerlendirilmesine yönelik çalışmalar yürütülecek.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: TÜİK’in enflasyon verilerine Dersim’den tepki: “Ben et döneri artık rüyamda yiyorum”
content:
Dersim — TÜİK’in, ağustos ayı enflasyonunu aylık yüzde 1,84, yıllık yüzde 31,51 olarak açıklamasına Dersim’deki yurttaşlardan tepki geldi. Bir yurttaş, “Ben et döneri artık rüyamda yiyorum” dedi. Bir diğer yurttaş ise, “TÜİK’in açıkladığı rakamlar değil, benim yaşadığım beni bağlar" dedi.

Türkiye İstatistik Kurumu (TÜİK) ağustos ayı enflasyonunu aylık yüzde 1,84, yıllık yüzde 31,51 olarak açıkladı. Dersim’de yurttaşlar TÜİK’in açıkladığı verilere tepki gösterdi.

TÜİK verilerini inandırıcı bulmadığını ifade eden yurttaş, şunları söyledi; “Vallahi pek fazla inandırıcı bulmuyorum. Çünkü gerçekten günümüz Türkiye'sinde insanların yaşaması çok çok zor. Mesela ben et döneri artık rüyamda yiyorum. Rüyamda tavuklu yemek, güzel yemekler yemeyi görüyorum veyahut da bir pantolon alamıyorum çünkü hep yama atmak zorunda kalıyorum. Peki TÜİK'in verileri böyleyse biz niye kendi ayağımıza, ayakkabı üstümüze pantolon alamıyoruz? Demek ki yalan” dedi.

Bir diğer yurttaş ise “TÜİK’in açıkladığı rakamlar değil, benim yaşadığım, gördüklerim beni bağlar. Yoksa devletin koymuş olduğu rayiç beni bağlamaz ki, o gerçek değil. Hayat iyi değil. Yani ev kirası olmuş 25-30 lira, bir sigortalı alıyor 23 lira, 24 lira, 25 lira... Nasıl oluyor bu, gerçek mi?” ifadesini kullandı.

Bir başka yurttaş ise, “Açıklanan rakamlara inanmıyorum. Mesela çarşı pazar geziyoruz, nasıl olacak? Enflasyon çok daha yüksek. ENAG’dan bile yüksek” dedi.

Bir diğer yurttaş da “Yani her şey belli, görünen ortada. Bizim anlatmamıza gerek yok. Gidip bir çocuğa sorsan çocukcağız bile bilir. Yani 5 yaşındaki çocuğa sorsan çocuk da bunu biliyor. Demek istediğimi anladınız. Yani bu kadar basit. Ben emekliyim. Emekliye 3 bin lira zam vermiş. Bilmem ne kadarını geri alıyor. Yani bu biraz haksızlıktır” şeklinde konuştu.

TÜİK’in açıkladığı verilerin halkın gerçekliğini yansıtmadığını söyleyen bir diğer yurttaş ise "TÜİK'in açıkladığı, enflasyon rakamları, halkın alım gücünün daha altında, ya da kendi yaşamını geçindirmenin daha altında bir şey. Bugün bahsettiği rakam insanların kendi yaşamını sürdürebilmesi için, kendi özel ihtiyaçlarını karşılayabilmesi için çok düşük rakamlar. Bu anlamda TÜİK'in yayınladığı rakamlar halkın gerçekliğini yansıtmayan, gerçeklikten kopuk, sadece belli kesimlere hizmet eden bir rakam olarak tarif ediyorum” diye konuştu.

author: Unknown
title: Matthew Perry’nin hayatı üç bölümlük belgeselle anlatılacak
content:
Matthew Perry’nin hayatı, kariyeri ve kişisel mücadelelerini konu alan üç bölümlük The One About Matthew Perry belgeseli 27 Ekim’de Netflix’te yayınlanacak. Yapımda Perry ailesinin özel arşivinden daha önce yayımlanmamış fotoğraf ve videolara da yer verilecek.

Friends dizisinde canlandırdığı Chandler Bing karakteriyle dünya çapında tanınan Matthew Perry’nin yaşamı ve kariyeri, yeni bir Netflix belgeseliyle izleyici karşısına çıkacak.

The One About Matthew Perry adlı üç bölümlük belgesel, 27 Ekim’de Netflix’te yayınlanacak. Yapımda Perry’nin oyunculuk kariyerinin yanı sıra özel hayatında yaşadığı zorluklar, bağımlılıkla mücadelesi ve geride bıraktığı miras ele alınacak.

Belgeselin ana anlatıcılığını oyuncunun kız kardeşi Mia Perry Bowick üstlenecek. Yapımda ayrıca Perry ailesinin özel arşivinden daha önce yayımlanmamış fotoğraf ve videolar kullanılacak.

Netflix, belgeselin Perry’nin komedi dünyasında yükselişinden Friends dizisinin en tanınan oyuncularından biri haline gelmesine uzanan kariyerini ele alacağını açıkladı.

Yapımda Perry’nin kamuoyunda bilinen Chandler Bing kimliğinin yanı sıra özel hayatındaki mücadelelerine de odaklanılacak. Oyuncunun bağımlılıkla mücadelesini açıkça anlatması ve bu konudaki farkındalığa yaptığı katkı da belgeselin önemli başlıkları arasında yer alacak.

Perry’nin yakın arkadaşları ve birlikte çalıştığı isimlerin anlatımlarına da yer verilecek. Friends dizisinin diğer oyuncularının belgeselde yer alıp almayacağı ise henüz açıklanmadı.

Belgeselin yönetmenliğini ve yönetici yapımcılığını Mary Robertson üstleniyor. Robertson, daha önce Çocuk Programlarının Karanlık Yüzü (Quiet on Set: The Dark Side of Kids TV) belgeseliyle tanınmıştı.

Matthew Perry’nin kız kardeşi Mia Perry Bowick, belgeselin hazırlanma sürecinin kendisi için zaman aldığını söyledi.

Bowick, Perry’nin yalnızca Friends dizisindeki Chandler Bing karakteriyle ya da bağımlılıkla mücadelesiyle tanımlanmasını istemediğini belirterek, izleyicilerin oyuncuyu farklı yönleriyle tanımasını amaçladığını ifade etti.

Kardeşinin kendisini ve hayatını şekillendiren önemli bir figür olduğunu söyleyen Bowick, Perry’nin zor zamanlarında dahi insanları güldüren ve kendilerini değerli hissettiren biri olduğunu dile getirdi.

Belgeselin yönetmeni Mary Robertson da Matthew Perry’nin yalnızca Friends ile özdeşleşen bir oyuncu olmadığını vurguladı.

Robertson, Perry’nin film, televizyon ve tiyatrodaki çalışmalarının yanı sıra Chandler Bing karakteriyle milyonlarca kişiyi güldürdüğünü ve insanları birbirine yakınlaştırdığını belirtti.

Perry’nin bağımlılıkla mücadelesini açık biçimde paylaşmasının da bu konuda farkındalığın artmasına katkı sağladığını ifade eden Robertson, kamuoyunun oyuncunun hayatına ilişkin bildiklerinin hikâyenin yalnızca bir bölümünü oluşturduğunu söyledi.

Belgeselin temel amacının, Perry’yi yakından tanıyan insanların anlatımları üzerinden oyuncunun kamuoyunda bilinen kimliğinin ardındaki yaşamına ışık tutmak olduğu belirtildi.

Matthew Perry, 28 Ekim 2023'te Los Angeles'taki evinde 54 yaşında hayatını kaybetti.

Adli tıp raporunda ölümün başlıca nedeni ketaminin akut etkileri olarak açıklanırken, boğulmanın da ölüme katkıda bulunan etkenlerden biri olduğu belirtildi.

Matthew Perry, Friends dizisinde 10 sezon boyunca Chandler Bing karakterini canlandırarak dünya çapında geniş bir hayran kitlesine ulaşmıştı.
