author: Mag
title: Rückführungskampagne „Insource Now!“ von UNISON und RMT gegen die Profitgier im öffentlichen Dienst und das „Übel“ des Outsourcings in Großbritannien
content:
„

UNISON und die RMT starten gemeinsam eine groß angelegte neue Kampagne, in der sie die Regierung dazu auffordern, die Rückführung öffentlicher Dienstleistungen in die öffentliche Hand zügiger voranzutreiben. (…) Jeder Tag, an dem Dienstleistungen weiterhin ausgelagert werden, ist ein weiterer Tag, an dem öffentliche Gelder den Dienstleistungen an vorderster Front entzogen werden und zu viele Beschäftigte weiterhin unter niedrigeren Löhnen, schlechteren Arbeitsbedingungen und größerer Unsicherheit leiden. Es ist an der Zeit, von Versprechungen zu Taten überzugehen. Aus diesem Grund hat sich UNISON gemeinsam mit der Eisenbahngewerkschaft RMT einer brandneuen Kampagne – „Insource Now!“ – für bessere öffentliche Dienstleistungen angeschlossen

…“ engl.

Pressemitteilung der UNISON vom 24. August 2026


 und mehr Informationen zum Start der Kampagne am 1. September 2026:


Der Ministerpräsident muss die „Plage“ des Outsourcings bekämpfen


„

Die Regierung muss ihr Wahlversprechen einhalten, „die größte Insourcing-Welle seit einer Generation“ zu begleiten. Gewerkschaften fordern, dass der Ministerpräsident das „Übel“ des Outsourcings bekämpft, da die Ausgaben für private Aufträge in die Höhe schnellen. Die Regierung muss ihr Wahlversprechen einlösen, „die größte Insourcing-Welle seit einer Generation“ zu überwachen, da eine neue Analyse zeigt, dass sich die Ausgaben für private Auftragnehmer bei einigen wichtigen öffentlichen Dienstleistungen seit dem Machtantritt der Labour-Partei verdoppelt haben, so die Gewerkschaften heute (Dienstag).


Untersuchungen von UNISON und RMT ergaben, dass der Wert der vergebenen oder verlängerten Outsourcing-Verträge für das „Soft-Facilities“-Management, darunter Reinigung, Verpflegung und Sicherheit, im Jahr 2025* 6,2 Mrd. £ erreichte.


Das ist ein Anstieg gegenüber den 3,5 Mrd. £ im Jahr 2024, als die Labour-Regierung an die Macht kam, und die Zahl für 2026 hat nach Angaben der Gewerkschaften bereits 6,6 Mrd. £ erreicht.


Die Ergebnisse werden veröffentlicht, während UNISON und RMT heute „Insource Now!“ starten – eine gemeinsame Kampagne, die fordert, dass mehr öffentliche Dienstleistungen wieder intern erbracht und nicht an gewinnorientierte Unternehmen vergeben werden. (…)


Die beiden Gewerkschaften erklären, dass die Auslagerung oft zu einem Wettlauf nach unten führt, da Unternehmen versuchen, Dienstleistungen zu geringeren Kosten zu erbringen und ihre Gewinne zu maximieren. Das bedeutet, dass ohnehin schon schlecht bezahlte Beschäftigte oft mit unfairen Löhnen ausgebeutet werden, während sich die Dienstleistungen verschlechtern und die Bürger weniger Leistung für ihr Geld erhalten.


Im Vorfeld der Parlamentswahlen 2024 versprach die Labour-Partei in ihrem Wahlprogramm, die größte Welle der Rückverlagerung öffentlicher Dienstleistungen seit einer Generation einzuleiten, und im Juni erklärten Minister, „das Zeitalter der Auslagerung sei vorbei“. UNISON und RMT weisen jedoch darauf hin, dass Zahlen aus offiziellen Vertragsregistern darauf hindeuten, dass dies nicht geschieht.


Die Gewerkschaften haben eine weitere Analyse in Auftrag gegeben, deren Ergebnisse in einem Bericht zusammengefasst werden sollen, der rechtzeitig zum Parteitag der Labour-Partei Ende dieses Monats vorliegen soll. (…)


Die Kampagne „Insource Now!“  von UNISON und RMT zielt darauf ab, die Rückführung weiterer Aufträge in den öffentlichen Sektor voranzutreiben. Der Start der Kampagne ist zeitlich so abgestimmt, dass er mit der heutigen Rückkehr der Abgeordneten ins Parlament nach der Sommerpause und im Vorfeld der politischen Parteitagssaison zusammenfällt.


Dutzende ausgelagerte Beschäftigte werden an der heutigen Auftaktveranstaltung teilnehmen, wobei viele davon berichten werden, wie sich die Arbeit unter minderwertigen Verträgen auf ihr Leben ausgewirkt hat. Sie werden gemeinsam mit der UNISON-Generalsekretärin Andrea Egan und dem RMT-Generalsekretär Eddie Dempsey auftreten, die die Ziele der Kampagne darlegen werden

…“ engl.

title: Uzaklaştırma kararı aldığı erkek tarafından darbedildi: 'Ölmeden önce sesimi duyun'
content:
İstanbul Bahçeşehir'de yaşayan hemşire Ebru Anik (26), hakkında uzaklaştırma kararı aldırdığı eski sevgilisi Mustafa M. (30) tarafından oturduğu sitenin girişinde darbedildi. İlişkisi boyunca tehdit ve şiddete maruz kaldığını belirten Anik, daha önce burnunun kırıldığını ve darp raporu aldığını söyledi.

DHA'ya konuşan Anik, uzaklaştırma kararına rağmen şiddetin sürdüğünü belirtti ve "Kurtulmaya çok çalıştım. Çok taşındım, çok kaçtım. Her seferinde beni tehditle, şantajla zorla yanında tuttu. Şikayetimi geri çekmezsem eğer beni, ailemi öldürmekle, kardeşimi öldürmekle tehdit ediyordu ve ben bu yüzden şikayetimi korktuğum için geri çekmek zorunda kalıyordum" dedi.

Sitenin girişinde güvenlik görevlilerinin gözü önünde saldırıya uğradığını belirten genç hemşire, "Uzaklaştırma kararına rağmen de 27 Ağustos tarihinde kapıma geldi. Beni sitenin bütün güvenlikleri ve site sakinleri önünde, yani gündüz apaçık, insanların içinde beni darbetti" ifadelerini kullandı.

"Polisler benden sürekli delil istediği için, ben sürekli karakola gidiyorum ve düzenli olarak sürekli zaten şikayette bulunuyorum ama delil istiyorlar. Burnum kırıldı, dediğimde bile 'Burnunuz kırıkken video var mı' diyorlar" diyerek tepkisini dile getiren Anik, saldırganın serbest kalmasını kabul edemediğini belirtti.

Yetkililere gerekli tedbirleri almaları çağrısında bulunan Anik, "Bu adam ne kanundan, ne hukuktan, ne adaletten, ne uzaklaştırma kararından, hiçbir şeyden korkmuyor. Herkesin içinde bana bunu yapan adam, kimsenin olmadığı yerde beni yakaladığında ne yapar? Ben öldükten sonra mı adalet sağlanacak? Ben ölmek istemiyorum. Ölmeden önce sesimi duyursunlar istiyorum. Bu adam beni gördüğü yerde öldürecek" dedi.

TÜİK’in geçtiğimiz mart ayında yayımladığı 2024 yılına dair sınırlı verileri, kadınların en çok tanıdıkları ve en yakın çevrelerindeki erkekler tarafından şiddete maruz bırakıldığını ortaya koymuştu. Araştırmaya göre şiddete uğrayan kadınların yüzde 74,7’si evli olduğu, boşandığı ya da birlikte olduğu erkekler veya ailesinden bir erkek tarafından şiddete uğruyor.

Savcı bıraktı, Nilda’yı öldürdü, mezarında yakalandı

Aynı verilere göre fiziksel şiddete maruz kalan kadınların yüzde 56’sı evli olduğu, boşandığı ya da birlikte olduğu erkekler tarafından şiddete uğrarken, yüzde 33,8’i ise aileden bir erkeğin şiddetine maruz kalıyor.

Geçtiğimiz haftalarda da İstanbul’un en işlek semtlerinden biri olan Şişli’de Nilda Müge Şahin şikayetçi olduğu ve hakkında koruma kararı aldırdığı erkek Nazir Ilgın tarafından öldürülmüş, bu cinayet koruma mekanizmalarının eksikliğini gözler önüne sermişti.

author: Mag
title: Bereits unter „Normalbedingungen“ läuft es vielerorts nicht gut bei der Kindertagesbetreuung
content:
Dossier


„…

Kurz bevor die Kitas (und auch die Kindertagespflege sollte hier ausdrücklich erwähnt werden, wo fast 50.000 Tageseltern unterwegs sind und einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Versorgung leisten) in den Strudel der Coronavirus-Folgen gezogen wurden, gab es mal wieder Zahlen aus der Welt des Mangels (…) Der von Beckmann gegebene Hinweis auf einen „sich selbst verstärkenden Teufelskreis“ – Personalmangel führt zu zusätzlichen Belastungen bei den Erzieherinnen und Erziehern, höhere Krankenstände sind die Folge, das erhöht wiederum die Arbeitsbelastung der verbleibenden Fachkräfte und gefährdet deren Gesundheit zusätzlich

…“

Beitrag vom 16. März 2020 von und bei Stefan Sell

 

, siehe dazu:


Kita-Qualitäts­gesetz: Weniger Kinder, neues Gesetz, gleiche Krise – bestätigt durch den Kita-Bericht 2026 


Kita-Qualitäts­gesetz: Weniger Kinder, neues Gesetz, gleiche Krise


„

Bundeskabinett beschließt Kita-Qualitätsgesetz. Kita-Bericht des Paritätischen bestätigt Fachkräftemangel trotz sinkender Kinderzahl.


Das Bundeskabinett hat am Mittwoch den Entwurf für das sogenannte Startchancen- und Qualitätsentwicklungsgesetz für Kitas beschlossen. Es sei »die entscheidende bildungspolitische Weichenstellung dieser Legislaturperiode«, erklärte Bildungs- und Familienministerin Karin Prien (CDU).


Das neue Kita-Gesetz soll die Bildungschancen erhöhen – beispielsweise durch verpflichtende Sprachtests für Vierjährige. Allerdings verfügen, dem neuen Kita-Bericht des Paritätischen Wohlfahrtsverbands zufolge, bereits über 80 Prozent der Kitas über geeignete Beobachtungs- und Förderinstrumente. Die Umsetzung des sprachlichen Förderbedarfs scheitere vor allem an Zeit- und Personalmängeln.


Das neue Gesetz soll das bisherige bis zum 1. Januar 2027 ablösen. Nach dem im Juli veröffentlichten Entwurf will der Bund für 2027 bis 2034 insgesamt rund 9,25 Milliarden Euro bereitstellen. Das Gesetz sieht eine schrittweise Reduzierung der Bundesmittel über die Jahre vor. »Diese degressive Finanzierung ist politisch und fachlich nicht nachvollziehbar«, kritisiert der Deutsche Gewerkschaftsbund in einer Stellungnahme. Die Maßnahme umfasse neue Aufgaben, die einen weiteren personellen, fachlichen und finanziellen Aufwand erfordern.

content:
ΕΝΑΡΞΗ ΤΗΣ ΣΥΝΕΝΤΕΥΞΗΣ ΤΥΠΟΥ ΑΠΟ ΤΟ 23:45


Συνέντευξη Τύπου για το στρατόπεδο συγκέντρωσης στη Σιντική


To Omnia.tv θα μεταδώσει ζωντανά την Συνέντευξη τύπου, Πέμπτη 3 Σεπτέμβρη 12.30μμ, Δικηγορικός Σύλλογος Αθήνας, Ακαδημίας 60


Να ακουστεί η φωνή των προσφύγων της εξέγερσης στο στρατόπεδο συγκέντρωσης στη Σιντική.


Δικαίωση τώρα! Ελευθερία!


Η εξέγερση των προσφύγων στο στρατόπεδο συγκέντρωσης στη Σιντική Σερρών συνεχίζεται όπως και η καταστολή της. title: Giyotin İş Başında  —  III. Bölüm: Terörün “Hazırlık” Dönemi
content:
Yazan: Grigori Petroviç Maksimov


Çeviren: Scianus


Çevirilen Asıl Metin


Lenin ilk darbesini burjuva basınına indirdi; zamanla bu kategori, Bolşevik ve resmî hükümet yayınları dışında kalan bütün gazeteleri kapsayacak ölçüde genişledi. Lenin, 4 Kasım 1917’de VTsIK’in (Tüm Rusya Sovyetleri Merkez Yürütme Komitesi) oturumunda şöyle diyordu: “Bu gazetelere müsamaha göstermek, sosyalist olmaktan vazgeçmektir.”

1

 Sovyetler henüz iktidarı yeniden ele geçirme girişimleri bastırılmamış Kerenski’ye karşı silahlı mücadele yürütmekte olduğundan, Lenin o sırada açıkça terörist bir siyaset çağrısında bulunmaktan kaçındı; o günlerde istediği şey kelleler değil, burjuva gazetelerinin susturulmasıydı.


21 Kasım’da Lenin, Tüm Rusya Sovyetleri Merkez Yürütme Komitesi’nde Kurucu Meclis üyelerinin geri çağrılması ve yeniden seçilmesi meselesi üzerine konuştu; iktidarın ele geçirilmesinden sonra ilk kez burada örgütlü şiddet fikrini açıkça dile getirdi. “Devlet,” diyordu Lenin, “şiddet uygulamak adına kurulmuş bir kurumdur. Eskiden bu şiddet, bir avuç para babası tarafından bütün halka karşı kullanılıyordu; şimdi ise biz devleti, halkın iradesini yerine getirecek bir şiddet kurumuna dönüştürmek istiyoruz. Biz şiddeti halkın çıkarları doğrultusunda örgütlemek istiyoruz.”

2

 Ertesi gün Tüm Rusya Denizciler Kongresi’nde yaptığı konuşmada ise şunları söyledi: “Bizi terör ve şiddet uygulamakla suçlayan ithamlar durmadan üzerimize yağıyor; lâkin biz buna sükûnetle karşılık veriyoruz. Diyoruz ki: Evet, sağlam bir yönetime, şiddete ve zorlamaya ihtiyacımız var; ancak bunları bir avuç kapitaliste, burjuvaziye karşı yönelteceğiz.”

3


Daha önce de belirttiğimiz üzere, 1 Aralık 1917’de Lenin, Fransız Devrimi’nin önderlerine atıfta bulunarak Kadet Partisi’ni yasakladı. 14 Aralık’ta ise Tüm Rusya Merkez Yürütme Komitesi’ne hitaben, “Ütopyacı sosyalistler dışında hiç kimse, direnişle karşılaşmadan, proletarya diktatörlüğü kurulmadan ve eski dünyanın üzerine demir bir el indirilmeden zafere ulaşılabileceğini hiçbir zaman iddia etmemiştir,”

4

 dedi; ardından da “Bu demir el, yıkarken aynı zamanda yaratır.” diye ekledi.

5


11 Ocak 1918’de, Üçüncü Tüm Rusya Sovyetler Kongresi’nde Halk Komiserleri Konseyi’nin çalışmaları üzerine yaptığı konuşmada Lenin delegelere, “İç savaşın tecrübeleri köylülere açıkça göstermiştir ki, sosyalizme giden başka bir yol yoktur; tek yol proletarya diktatörlüğü ve sömürücülerin egemenliğinin acımasızca bastırılmasıdır.”

6

 Bununla birlikte, “Henüz gerçek anlamda bir terörden uzağız; zira şimdilik onlardan daha güçlüyüz.”

7

 diyordu.


Ertesi gün Lenin, bir önceki konuşmasını özetlerken, kendisine yöneltilen sosyalistlerle mücadele ettiği yönündeki ithama şu sözlerle cevap verdi:


“

Burada bize yöneltilen, ‘sosyalistlerle’ mücadele ettiğimiz suçlamasına vereceğimiz tek cevap şudur: Parlamentarizm çağında bunların sosyalizmle hiçbir ortak yanı kalmamıştır; çürümüş, çağın gerisinde kalmış ve nihayet burjuvazinin safına geçmişlerdir. Uluslararası haydutların emperyalist saiklerle çıkardığı savaş sırasında ‘vatan savunması’ diye haykıran bu ‘sosyalistler’, sosyalist değil, burjuvazinin dalkavukları ve uşaklarıdır

.”

8


Bu cevap açıkça göstermektedir ki sosyalistlerin Bolşeviklerle koalisyon kurma girişimleri Lenin tarafından yalnızca reddedilmekle kalmamış, ki bu ret Komünist Parti Merkez Komitesi’nde ve ilk Bolşevik hükümetinde ciddi bir krize yol açmıştı, aynı zamanda takibatlarla da karşılanmıştır. Bunun böyle olması da şaşırtıcı değildir; zira Lenin daha iktidarı ele geçirmeden önce, “Uzlaşmalar Üzerine” başlıklı makalesinde, “Partimiz, diğer bütün siyasal partiler gibi, siyasal iktidarı kendi adına ele geçirmeyi amaçlamaktadır.”

9

 diye yazmış, ardından da “Olaylar bizi iktidara taşıyabilir; lâkin o iktidarın elimizden kayıp gitmesine asla izin vermeyeceğiz.”

10

 sözleriyle niyetini açıkça ortaya koymuştu.


Unutulmamalıdır ki, ideolojik alanda olduğu kadar iktidar mücadelesinde de Bolşeviklerin başlıca rakipleri burjuvazi değil, sosyalistlerdi. Bunlar arasında en güçlü olanı ise kahramanlıklarla dolu geçmişinin sağladığı itibar sayesinde monarşinin yıkılmasından sonra ülkenin en kuvvetli siyasî gücü hâline gelen Sosyalist-Devrimci Parti idi. Ekim Devrimi’nin hemen ardından Kurucu Meclis’te ezici çoğunluğu elinde bulunduran bu parti, Bolşevik hükümetinin bütün propaganda kararnamelerine rağmen, devrim öncesindeki faaliyetleri ve köylü kooperatiflerinin kurulmasındaki çalışmaları sayesinde köylerde …

title: Mustafa Karasu: The doors of Imralı must be opened - Part Two
content:
KCK Executive Council member Mustafa Karasu spoke to journalist Erdal Er during a special program on Medya Haber, and made important assessments on current developments.


The first part of the interview can be found

here

. 


You constitute an important pillar of the regional security architecture. Both in the mountains of Kurdistan – that is, the presence of the guerrilla – and, consequently, Makhmour and Sinjar [Şengal], are actually discussed and evaluated within the same framework. Regarding Europe – that is, regarding returns – if an agreement is reached, if full consensus is achieved, and if practical steps are taken, will Europe and places like Makhmour be on your agenda? Or will this come later?


These are issues currently under discussion; they are also discussed from time to time at Imrali. So yes, Makhmour is a serious topic. As a result of this war, they were forced to leave their lands and went there. They had villages that were like paradise. And they’ve truly turned the place where they’re staying into a paradise, but their original home is paradise itself. But what is the situation now? Many of their villages have been occupied by village guards. They’ve taken them over. These problems need to be resolved. Also, all of them have received an education in Kurdish. They all read in Kurdish and think in Kurdish. They’ve established education in their mother tongue in this way. How will these issues be resolved? These are also issues that need to be discussed and resolved. Of course, if there is a democratic solution for the people of Makhmour – if they will be free when they return, if they won’t face oppression, and if they can live with their own identity and culture – then naturally they would want to go back to those paradise-like villages. It is their right, and that is the right thing. A process moves forward, and genuine democratization emerges. If the oppression against the Kurds – against their language, identity, and culture – is lifted and a Turkey emerges where such oppression no longer exists, then of course the people of Makhmour might leave – but it won’t happen immediately. If there is significant progress, it can be considered and discussed.


So will the process begin with the guerrilla fighters – if it happens at all – and proceed gradually?


It seems like that’s how it will start. Because the issue is primarily discussed along those lines, that’s where it will begin.


We went to Makhmour, and the people of Makhmour were very clear, that they have their own standing. They also have their conditions for returning. The situation has to develop and they prepared their conditions. But they recognize Rêber Apo as their chief negotiator and if he calls on the people of Makhmour to come, they will come. They’ve made that message very clear.


The guerrillas are also saying that they will come when Rêber Apo calls upon them. They’ll go and organize themselves there. They will engage in democratic politics. Makhmour is a result of this war. Since it is a result of this war, those common causes must be eliminated. The old environment needs to change. Otherwise, why would they go?


Okay, could you briefly comment on Europe? What is the situation there?


There’s a lot going on in Europe, too. Because of this oppression, many people have left. There are mayors and politicians among them. Because engaging in politics in the name of the Kurdish cause has been criminalized. So a countless number of Kurds went to Europe, and politicians went into exile too. Now, of course, they want to return. Yes, not everyone may return. But a significant portion of them wants to come back to Turkey. In particular, a significant portion of those who did not go as workers but went for political reasons and became refugees will also return. If there is to be a democratic political struggle, they will come back and contribute. They will join the political struggle with their experience and expertise. They will become involved in organizing. They will contribute their knowledge and experience to the construction of a democratic society in Kurdistan and to the advancement of democratization.

title: Academics in Kobanê say decree restricting Kurdish-language education must be immediately revoked
content:
With the Rojava Kurdistan Revolution, the Kurdish people in the region realized a dream they had pursued for years by educating their children in their own mother tongue. Mother-tongue education was successfully carried out from the first grade of primary school through the 12th grade and university, and many students graduated.


However, with a decree issued by the Ministry of Education of the Syrian Interim Government, this successful experience in the region has been ignored, and an attempt is being made to reduce mother-tongue education to just three hours of classes per week. This has sparked widespread reactions throughout Rojava Kurdistan. People from all sections of society, particularly students and their families, have been taking to the streets for days and demonstrating that they will not compromise on their right to education in their mother tongue.


Academics and the Co-Presidency of Kobanê University spoke to ANF about the issue and emphasized that the ministry’s decision must be reconsidered.


Kobanê University Co-President Şervan Mislim said that the decision concerning the Kurdish language was highly inadequate for the Kurdish people and needed to be reconsidered. Mislim said: “For years, Kurdish has been taught as a language of science; education has been provided in Kurdish from kindergartens through universities. Therefore, this decision is inadequate both academically and scientifically. A fundamental change must be made to the decision, and the situation of the students must be reconsidered.”


 


Mislim noted that demonstrations initiated by students and their families in defense of Kurdish have continued to this day, saying, “We do not believe that either our people or our students will accept this decision.”


Mislim stated that the situation of Rojava University is currently being discussed and that Kobanê University will be next following the integration process. Pointing out that the university’s primary language of instruction is Kurdish, Mislim said: “Our team and our dossier concerning Kobanê University are ready. We also want to take our place within Syrian higher education as a Syrian university.”


The Co-President of Kobanê University added that its students receive education in Kurdish, Arabic, and English, saying: “At present, the academic standards of Kobanê University are in Kurdish, and education is conducted academically on this basis. It is not possible for a student who has been educated in these languages to suddenly begin receiving education in another language overnight.”


Şivîn Hecî, an academic in Kurdish Language and Literature, stated that the decision concerning the Kurdish language was also having a negative impact on students’ psychological well-being, saying: “Since the beginning of the revolution, Kurdish has been the official language in every field. How can a child who studied in Kurdish in the first grade suddenly study in another language? It is not possible for a child who has built their dreams and hopes around the Kurdish language to study in another language. What will the future of a student who thinks in Kurdish and dreams accordingly look like?”


Şivîn Hecî emphasized that the decision was inappropriate and had been completely rejected by students, stating: “Everyone must hear our voice, and this decision must be reversed. Every nation is recognized by its own language. The Kurdish language must also be officially recognized within Syria.”


Necah Îbrahîm, a teacher of Kurdish Language and Literature, also highlighted the importance of defending the mother tongue, saying: “The decision is completely unacceptable. Our Kurdish language is fundamental to us. The generation of the revolution was raised on the foundation of the Kurdish language. It is absolutely unacceptable for us to abandon our language and study in another language. Just as every nation studies in its own language, the Kurds will also study in their own language.”


Drawing attention to law and legal rights, Necah Îbrahîm stated that every nation can assert its national identity through its own language, saying: “Before the revolution, when we studied in Arabic, it felt like a foreign language to us. But after the revolution, thanks to Kurdish, we were able to achieve our dreams. Now this decision is also affecting people’s mindset. From now on, we must continue to defend our language.”

title: Öcalan’s call for ‘Democratic Unity’ or a repeat of 31 August?
content:
The Middle East is going through one of the most turbulent and uncertain periods in its history, and the question of the Kurds and Kurdistan is once again being reconsidered. The Kurdish and Kurdistan reality, left wounded and fragmented by the construction of the nation-state system, now faces both an opportunity to overcome this fragmentation and the threat of an even deeper existential crisis.


Abdullah Öcalan has summed up the gravity of the current situation with the warning that “all parts of Kurdistan are at risk of becoming another Gaza.” At the same time, he is developing a new strategy for Kurdish existence aimed at resolving the Kurdish question and the question of Kurdistan, which remains a major source of conflict at the heart of the Middle East. Under the current circumstances, the Kurdish question will either be used to deepen the crisis in the Middle East, something hegemonic powers, particularly Britain, are still working towards, or Kurdish identity will cease to be treated as a source of crisis, conflict and war. Abdullah Öcalan’s initiative for “Peace and a Democratic Solution” therefore contains a new strategy for the Kurds and Kurdistan.


Öcalan’s objective is not limited to ending the state of war and conflict between Northern Kurdistan (Bakur) and the Turkish state. His new strategy encompasses all parts of Kurdistan, including Southern Kurdistan (Başur), and seeks to protect the Kurds and their gains amid the conditions of what he describes as the Third World War, while securing their free existence. In his views on democratic integration, Öcalan describes the need for a new strategic approach for the Kurds as follows:


“No strategy has existed until now in the context of Kurdistan and the Kurdish question. Strategy is a matter of power. To speak of strategy in the context of a country and a people, there must be a will and the emergence and existence of political and military power. As a certain social reality and territorial reality centred on the Kurds and Kurdistan have now taken shape, defining and assessing a strategy must also be placed on the agenda.”


Öcalan’s call to Southern Kurdistan


In line with this assessment, Öcalan proposes concrete programmes for Rojava, Southern Kurdistan and Eastern Kurdistan (Rojhilat), calling on Kurdish political forces to overcome their current divisions and develop a common Kurdish vision and strategy amid the conditions of what he describes as the Third World War.


Öcalan warns in particular that the current status of Southern Kurdistan as a constitutionally recognised federal region is also facing risks and that regional states have serious plans concerning Southern Kurdistan. Pointing to the risks created by political divisions and rivalries in the region, and noting the absence of a government capable of managing the current process, Öcalan makes the following call:


“The political forces in Southern Kurdistan should prepare themselves for this. We might call it a Democratic Unity Government… A solution is needed that can meet the needs of the entire people.”


31 August 1996: A historic turning point


Abdullah Öcalan made this historic call shortly before the anniversary of 31 August, one of the major turning points in the history of Kurdistan. On 31 August 1996, the Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP) sought military support from Saddam Hussein, leader of the Baath regime, and Iraqi tanks entered Erbil (Hewlêr), dealing a major blow to Kurdish political and social unity whose repercussions continue to be felt today. The entry into Erbil of forces belonging to Saddam Hussein’s regime, which had carried out the Halabja and Anfal genocides, at the KDP’s request left deep wounds in the conscience and political memory of the Kurdish people that remain difficult to heal.


The incident also became a historic example of how regional powers have exploited divisions among Kurdish forces. Öcalan’s call that “we do not want to see a repeat of 60 years of conflict” also entails overcoming a political approach that has opened the way for external intervention in Kurdish affairs and Kurdistan.


The events of 31 August 1996 were not merely a military confrontation between two parties, the KDP and the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK), competing for power. They represented a historic rupture that deeply undermined the institutionalisation of the administration in Southern Kurdistan, the democratic parliamentary system and the prospect of democratic …

title: To achieve peace
content:
War is a product of power and the state because it seeks to subjugate and exploit others. Those who have no such aims do not wage war; peace prevails among them. Between state powers and forces seeking domination, however, there can only be a ceasefire, in other words, a state of non-conflict. As long as power and the state exist, there can be no genuine peace, only the absence of war, or a ceasefire. Achieving genuine peace therefore requires overcoming the system of power and the state.


1 September is, in fact, the day the Second World War began. The day on which the most devastating war in history began was later designated and declared “World Peace Day” in the hope that war would never happen again. Amid the madness of warfare that marked the 20th century, humanity’s vision and strength extended only far enough to designate one day of the year as a “Day of Peace”. That, of course, left the remaining 364 days as “Days of War”. Such a reality is only fitting for a world dominated by the system of power and the state.


We have already established that war was created and used as an instrument by forces of power and the state. The system of power and the state itself was, of course, created by the “male hunters’ club” and the “caste-based murderous system” that established domination over women. There has been no genuine peace in the world since then, only periods of ceasefire. Before that, genuine peace prevailed among tribes and tribal communities living communally. The socialist slogan “All peoples are brothers and sisters” therefore reflected a genuine reality. Clans and tribal communities living communally truly regarded one another as kin.


Among different peoples throughout history, perhaps the longest-lasting experience of such fraternity was that between Kurds and Turks. Kurdish-Turkish fraternity became one of the longest-lasting bonds between different peoples in history. This relationship developed between Turkic tribes arriving from Central Asia and Kurdish tribes and tribal communities living in Mesopotamia. Kurds and Turks shared the opportunities provided by the same land for a long period and forged a common destiny.


This historical relationship was disrupted in the 19th century by the Ottoman central administration, which was coming under increasing pressure from Britain. Through military campaigns carried out across Kurdistan throughout the century, it sought to weaken the Kurdish principalities and establish a new system of repression and domination over Kurdish society. Under the Committee of Union and Progress government during the First World War, this mentality and policy developed into the genocide of non-Turkish and non-Muslim cultures and peoples. The Kemalist administration, which reached an agreement with Britain and France at Lausanne, continued and deepened the same mentality and policies. Hostility and war thus replaced the Turkish-Kurdish fraternity that could once have been regarded as a historic example of coexistence between peoples.


The Kurdish side experienced the second half of this century-long conflict by organising and struggling within the Kurdistan Workers’ Party (PKK) under the leadership of Abdullah Öcalan. By the early 1990s, the war had in fact opened the way for politics, and conditions had matured for a political solution to the Kurdish question. President Turgut Özal sought a political solution, saying, “We should even discuss federation.” Prime Minister Süleyman Demirel also made a significant political statement when he said, “We recognise the Kurdish reality.” Abdullah Öcalan responded to these developments by declaring a unilateral ceasefire at a press conference on 17 March 1993 “to create an opportunity for a political solution.”


None of these statements or steps, however, succeeded in practice. Intervention by pro-war, nationalist circles with vested interests derailed efforts to find a political solution, leading to a relentless period of war that continued until 1 March 2025. The consequences of the additional 33 years of war were extremely severe for both sides. The historic fraternity between the two peoples was deeply wounded by a century of denial of Kurdish existence and warfare. Fuelled by nationalism on both sides, this relationship increasingly gave way to a form of hostility.


Abdullah Öcalan’s Call for Peace and a Democratic Society of 27 February 2025 seeks to put an end to this situation and re-establish the historic fraternity …

author: Sophia Sheera
title: Polanski to Run in Byelection After Starmer Quits
content:
Green party leader Zack Polanski will run in the Holborn & St Pancras byelection triggered by former prime minister Keir Starmer’s resignation on Tuesday. 


“We know that the Greens can win here, and by electing me, voters will have someone who will always fight their corner – never scared of big donors or the party whip,” he told the Camden New Journal on Thursday. 


“Too often Labour has stood up for corporations and big money. I will stand up for people struggling to pay their bills.”


Polanski had already pledged to stand in a London byelection. If elected, he will become the Green party’s sixth MP. 


“I have lived and worked in this community over many years, I know it well and I love it. It represents so many of the things that make London so special,” he added. 


Andrew Feinstein, the former South African MP who stood as an independent against Starmer in the 2024 general election and won 19% of the vote, has suggested he will not stand against Polanski. 


“

We must ensure that all progressive forces in Holborn & St Pancras unite in order to deliver an MP who represents us and will work for us,” Feinstein wrote on X shortly after news of Starmer’s resignation broke. “An MP who is the antithesis of everything that Starmer stands for.”


The Greens now run four London’s councils following the May elections, but are yet to win a parliamentary seat in the capital, meaning a Polanski victory would be historic for the party. 


Polanski will also be hoping to turn the tide on the decline in the Greens’ favourability ratings, which are at their lowest to date, a

YouGov poll found

.

author: Isabel Seta
title: Terras raras, soberania e eleições nada normais
content:
Em meio a uma corrida eleitoral que já se mostrava tanto crucial para o futuro do país quanto marcada por fatos inéditos, como a interferência dos Estados Unidos no pleito, uma nova avalanche abalou as instituições brasileiras: a divulgação das

mensagens trocadas

 entre Daniel Vorcaro, do Banco Master, e o ministro Alexandre de Moraes. Ainda não se sabe totalmente como será o desenrolar do caso, mas é fato que os danos causados à imagem do ministro ajudam a corroborar as acusações do Governo Trump ao judiciário brasileiro e podem fortalecer as ameaças dos EUA à nossa soberania.


No

Bom dia, fim do mundo

 desta semana, vamos falar sobre soberania brasileira e também sobre a soberania norte-americana, que envolvem conceitos e objetivos diferentes, mas passam pela mesma questão: as terras raras e os

minerais críticos

. Ouça agora.


E MAIS:


Na Trombeta, uma luz no fim do túnel: existem super-heróis lutando contra a extrema-direita. E no quadro “Se é pra falar de economia…”, em que parte das cadeias produtivas queremos estar?

author: Unknown
title: DFG: Di Tebaxê de 4 rojnameger hatin desteserkirin
content:
Komeleya Rojnamegeran a Dîcle Firatê (DFG), rapora binpêkirina mafên rojnamegeran a meha Tebaxê eşkere kir. 


DFGê diyar kir ku di meha Tebaxê de jî mafên rojnamegeran hatin binpêkirin. Her weha DFGê destnîşan kir ku mafê çêkirina nûçeyan yê rojnamegeran û mafê agahîgirtina gel tê astengkirin. 


DFGê di raporê de da zanîn ku li Tirkiyeyê zextên li ser çapemeniyê û rojnamegeran di meha Tebaxê de jî bênavber berdewam kir û di raporê de wiha hate gotin:


”Rojnameger ji ber parvekirinên xwe yên li ser medyaya civakî, nûçeyên ku çêkirine û xebatên rojnamegeriyê hatin desteserkirin, derbarê wan de lêpirsîn hatin vekirin, hatin darizandin û hinek ji wan hatin girtin. 


Di Tebaxê de xebatkarên Rojnameya Aydin Dengeyê jî di navde 4 rojnameger hatin desteserkirin. Rojnamegerek hate girtin, derbarê 5 rojnamegeran de lêpirsîn hat vekirin û ji 2 dosyayan 4 rojnameger hatin darizandin. Ji rojnamegerên hatin desteserkirin, jê Îrem Delice bi şertê kontrola edlî serbest hate berdan. Lê li ser îtiraza dozger, dîsa hat desteserkirin û girtin.”


Lêpirsînên meha Tebaxê


Di berdewama raporê de hat destnîşankirin ku di meha Tebaxê de li nûçe û parvekirinên medya civakî ên rojnamegeran jî lêpirsîn hat destpêkirin û weha hat gotin: 


“Derbarê nûçegîhanê Îlke TV Zîlan Azadê de ji ber hevpeyvîna ku kiribû, derbarê Gerînendeyê Giştî yê berê yê Rojnameya Hurriyetê Ertugrul Ozkok de ji ber ku beşdarî bernameyekê bûye, lêpirsîn hatin vekirin. Rojnameger Can Bursali ji ber nûçe û parvekirinên medyaya civakî bi şertê kontol edlî hat berdan. Derbarê Burhan Can Terzî de jî, ji ber nûçeyên sporê ku çêkiribû lêpirsîn hat vekirin. Seroka Cemîyeta Rojnamegeran a Îzmirê Dilek Gappi ji ber têkildarî rojnamegeran daxuyanî da îfadeya wê hat girtin.”


Sansur


Di raporê de DFGê de bal kişand li ser sansuran û wiha got:


“Piraniya zextên li ser azadiya çapemeniyê ji sansura dijîtal pêk tê. Di Tebaxê de gelek hesabên medya civakî û nûçeyên li ser medyaya civakî hatin parvekirin, asteng kirin. Nûçeyên derbarê Holdînga Zulfikarlaran, kuştina Rojîn Kabaişê û dosyayên lekolînê yên têkildarî Medipolê de bûn sedem ku hesabên wan ên medyaya civakî bên astengkirin. 


Bi taybetî ji ber nûçeyên kuştina Rojin Kabaişê hesabên Rojnameger Oznur Deger û Salih Sertkal ên Xê hatin astengkirin. Li Tirkiyeyê hesabên Xê yên Medya Haber TV, Ajansa Nûçeyan a Etkînê û JINNEWSê hatin astengkirin. Hesabên Ajansa Mezopotamya, rojnameger Nasuh Bektaş û Firat Fistik ên Xê yê li Tirkiyeyê hatin astengkirin. Hesabê înstagramê yê Nujin Medyayê hat astengkirin.”


(AY)

author: Main david channel
title: Morgenstern · Für Dich, Simone
content:
Christian Morgenstern


Die unmögliche Tatsache


Palmström, etwas schon an Jahren,


wird an einer Straßenbeuge


und von einem Kraftfahrzeuge


überfahren.


‚Wie war‘ (spricht er, sich erhebend


und entschlossen weiterlebend)


‚möglich, wie dies Unglück, ja –:


daß es überhaupt geschah?


‚Ist die Staatskunst anzuklagen


in Bezug auf Kraftfahrwagen?


Gab die Polizeivorschrift


hier dem Fahrer freie Trift?


‚Oder war vielmehr verboten,


hier Lebendige zu Toten


umzuwandeln, – kurz und schlicht:


Durfte hier der Kutscher nicht –?‘


Eingehüllt in feuchte Tücher,


prüft er die Gesetzesbücher


und ist alsobald im Klaren:


Wagen durften dort nicht fahren!


Und er kommt zu dem Ergebnis:


Nur ein Traum war das Erlebnis.


Weil, so schließt er messerscharf,


nicht sein kann, was nicht sein darf.

author: CNT Valladolid
title: Convenio del Metal de Valladolid | Por una negociación con transparencia, asambleas y movilización
content:
En este ya avanzado 2026 los trabajadores y trabajadoras del sector del metal de la provincia de Valladolid seguimos rigiéndonos por un agotado convenio colectivo que caducó con el fin del año anterior. Durante los años de vigencia de este convenio (2023-2025) la situación socioeconómica que vivimos y padecemos se ha tornado cada vez más inquietante, con una realidad en la que la clase trabajadora ha sufrido un aumento de la carestía de la vida desorbitado y que no tiene visos de parar (con datos de agosto la variación anual del IPC ha aumentado hasta un preocupante 4,3%).


Sin embargo, esta realidad no es igual para todos. Vemos como la prensa informa de ganancias cada vez mayores para el mundo empresarial. En el sector del Metal de la provincia de Valladolid el año pasado la creación de empresas aumentó considerablemente y la cuantía en subvenciones recibidas por parte de la Junta de Castilla y León ascendía a cifra millonarias.


Es en este contexto en el que se nos presenta la negociación del nuevo convenio colectivo. No fue hasta el mes de abril cuando se constituyó la mesa negociadora entre Vametal -la patronal del sector-, y la pareja de sindicatos negociadores CCOO-UGT. Desde entonces, según informan en sus webs, han mantenido una decena de reuniones con la patronal en las que no solo no ha habido avances para los trabajadores sino que la patronal ha planteado retrocesos mientras exhibía su actitud más chulesca.


De estos comunicados, se extrae la tabla reivindicativa defendida por los sindicatos negociadores, que creemos podría completarse con más propuestas, si bien las que se plantean nos parecen lógicas y adecuadas:


Subidas salariales del 5% anual con cláusula de revisión según el IPC real.


Jornada anual de 1728 horas (16 horas menos). Llevamos con 1744 horas desde 2010.


Reconocimiento del tiempo del bocadillo como tiempo efectivo de trabajo.


Desarrollo de medidas que garanticen el derecho a la desconexión digital.


Actualización y mejora de pluses (nocturnidad, festivos, peligrosidad, desplazamientos), así como adecuación de las pagas extraordinarias.


Ampliación y mejora de permisos y licencias, la protección en caso de enfermedad o cuidados familiares y adaptación del convenio a la normativa vigente en igualdad, conciliación y violencia de género.


Propuestas sobre condiciones de desplazamiento y dietas, regulación de las guardias, formación como tiempo efectivo de trabajo, y refuerzo de políticas de igualdad, salud laboral y medio ambiente.


Regular de forma más estricta el uso de ETTs.


Por parte de Vametal nos encontramos con las siguientes perlas encaminadas a empeorar las condiciones relativas a los siguientes aspectos:


Antigüedad: eliminación de nuevos quinquenios y transformación de los existentes en un complemento personal consolidado.


Incapacidad temporal (IT): modificación del actual sistema de complementos económicos durante las situaciones de baja médica, incorporando nuevos requisitos para su percepción y cambios en las coberturas actualmente existentes.


Ceses y preavisos: modificación de los plazos actuales para determinados supuestos de extinción voluntaria de la relación laboral.


Contratación: regulación de los contratos por circunstancias de la producción, contratos de sustitución y contratos fijos discontinuos, incluyendo cuestiones sobre llamamientos, preavisos y contratación a tiempo parcial.


La actitud de la patronal va acorde a los nuevos tiempos, en los que sus valedores de la derecha y ultraderecha han perdido todo complejo y decoro. Así, amparados en el actual ambiente político y mediático, plantean un escenario de pérdida de salario y derechos sin ninguna vergüenza: “son lentejas y si no nos gusta a jodernos”.


Después de una decena de reuniones y de la reunión en el SERLA el 10 de agosto, las negociaciones están bloqueadas y los sindicatos negociadores se plantean realizar movilizaciones comenzando por una concentración el lunes 31 de agosto a las 12:00h. Aquí hay algo que a los trabajadores de la CNT nos choca… ¿a quién va destinada esta convocatoria? Obviamente en ese horario no va destinada al conjunto de trabajadores afectados por el convenio, ni siquiera a sus propios afiliados, es una convocatoria pensada para los delegados liberados de CCOO y UGT.


Por otro lado, si bien estos sindicatos han colgado comunicados en sus webs, la difusión de información en los centros de trabajo suponemos que, en el mejor de los casos, estará siendo escasa. Sin …

author: infolibre
title: Συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης στους αγωνιζόμενους μετανάστες της Σιντικής Σερρών, Πέμπτη 3/9, στις 19.00, στη συμβολή Τσιμισκή με Ναυαρίνου
content:
Από

Ανάρες, ομάδα δράσης & αλληλεγγύης:


Στις 22/08, στο καμπ μεταναστών Σιντικής Σερρών, οι κρατούμενοι ως ένδειξη διαμαρτυρίας στις άθλιες συνθήκες ζωής τους εκεί,προχώρησαν σε πετροπόλεμο με τις αστυνομικές δυνάμεις και απόδραση απο το κολαστήριο της Σιντικής. Τα ΜΜΕ και τα social media δεν άργησαν να γεμίσουν από ρατσιστικά άρθρα, ποστ και σχόλια που στοχοποιούν τις μετανάστριες, τις απανθρωποποιούν και αναπαράγουν την ρητορική μίσους που εξασφαλίζει την κοινωνική συναίνεση για την εξόντωσή τους. Αυτή δεν είναι η πρώτη φορά που οι κρατούμενοι/ες της δομής αντιστέκονται για την κράτησή τους και τις άθλιές συνθήκες εκεί με μοναδικό λογο την “παράνομη είσοδό”τους στη χώρα. 


Στις 12/11,επίσης,οι κρατούμενοι/ες ξεσηκώθηκαν, έκοψαν τα συρματοπλέγματα και προσπαθησαν να αποδράσουν. Οι δυνάμεις της ΕΛΑΣ κατέφθασαν άμεσα στο σημείο, κατέστειλαν την κίνηση των μεταναστριών και συλλαμβάνουν 30 εξ’ αυτών. Την επόμενη, οι συλληφθέντες/ φθείσες, με ορισμένη από το δικαστήριο προφανώς υπεράσπιση, κατέληξαν να καταδικάζονται με την πρωτοφανή ποινή των 3 ετών, ενώ μάλιστα ένας εξ’αυτών καταδικάζεται σε 3 έτη και 7 μήνες χωρίς αναστολή. Αυτή μάλιστα, δεν ήταν η πρώτη προσπάθεια απόδρασης των μεταναστών από το συγκεκριμένο καμπ, αφού στα μέσα Αυγούστου του περασμένου καλοκαιριού, οι άνθρωποι εκεί είχαν επιχειρήσει νέα προσπάθεια απόδρασης μην αντέχοντας να ζουν υπό άθλιες συνθήκες διαβίωσης. Η προσπάθεια τους αυτή είχε πέσει και πάλι στο τείχος της καταστολής, αφού οι κρατούμενοι/ες ξυλοκοπήθηκαν από τα σκουπίδια της ΕΛΑΣ. Αντανακλαστικά τότε, είχαν απαντήσει με απεργία πείνας, τα αιτήματα της οποίας δεν ικανοποιήθηκαν από την διοίκηση του κέντρου. Τον Μάρτιο του 2026 αρχίζουν νέες κινητοποιήσεις καθώς δεν λύθηκε κανένα από τα προβλήματα τα οποία αντιμετωπίζουν μέσα στο κολαστήριο της Σιντικής, ενώ προστίθεται και το αίτημα της ενημέρωσης τους γύρω από τις διαδικασίες για τις αιτήσεις ασύλου και την περίοδο κράτησης.


Στις 4/5 οι μετανάστ(ρι)ες εξεγέρθηκαν και συγκρούστηκαν με την αστυνομία και το εκδικητικό αποτέλεσμα του κρατικού μηχανισμού ήταν η καταδίκη τεσσάρων σε ποινή φυλάκισης δύο ετών. Στις 11/5 κάποιοι προχώρησαν σε τετραήμερη απεργία πείνας με ορισμένους να αρνούνται και το νερό, ενώ βασικά αιτήματα των κινητοποιήσεων αποτελεί η ελευθερία και η δικαιοσύνη για όλους. Για τους 30 μετανάστες που οδηγήθηκαν στη φυλακή πρωτόδικα, έπειτα από την εξέγερση τον Νοέμβρη του 2025 στο καμπ της Σιντικής, ορίστηκε το εφετείο στις Σέρρες στις 26 Ιουνίου του 2026.


Οι κινητοποιήσεις, οι διαμαρτυρίες και οι εξεγέρσεις στα σημερινά κολαστήρια που αποκαλούνται κέντρα κράτησης μεταναστών δεν είναι παρά το φυσικό επακόλουθο και η τελευταία λύση για όλους τους ανθρώπους που διαμένουν σε αυτά. Άνθρωποι που ξεριζώθηκαν από τα σπίτια τους και τις περιοχές τους, στην αναζήτηση ενός καλύτερου και πιο ανθρώπινου μέλλοντος, έχουν βρεθεί κρατούμενοι/ες από το ελληνικό κράτος. Καθολικός εγκλεισμός, άθλιες συνθήκες διαβίωσης, υγιεινής, ελλειπείς μερίδες φαγητού, στιβαγμένοι υπεράριθμοι μετανάστες/ριες σε κοντέινερ, γελοία ιατρική περίθαλψη, αυστηρός έλεγχος από τις διοικήσεις και την φύλαξη των κέντρων (ενίοτε και από την ίδια την ΕΛΑΣ) είναι μόνο κάποια από τα χαρακτηριστικά της καθημερινότητας των ανθρώπων εκεί, όσο διαρκούν οι ατέρμονες γραφειοκρατικές διαδικασίες έκδοσης ασύλου τους, που τελικά δεν ξέρουν ποτέ και αν θα πάρουν. Δεν είναι παρά μόνο λίγους μήνες πριν, όταν ακούγαμε, τον υπουργό μεταναστευτικής πολιτικής και γνωστό κάθαρμα, Θάνο Πλεύρη, να εξαγγέλλει με ύφος καρδηναλίων ότι πρόκειται να χειροτερέψουν ακόμα περισσότερο οι συνθήκες διαβίωσης στα κέντρα, σε μια προσπάθεια να καταστήσει σαφές στους ανθρώπους που περιφέρονται με βάρκες στις θάλασσες ή στα σύνορα των χωρών, ότι η Ελλάδα δεν θα πρέπει να αποτελεί καν επιλογή ή σκέψη για είσοδο σε αυτήν.


Ανάμεσα σε αυτά τα προαναφερθέντα κολαστήρια λοιπόν, υπάρχει ένα, αυτό της Σιντικής, που αποτελεί το πλέον χειρότερο και μάλλον, σύμφωνα με τις εξαγγελίες του ίδιου του ελληνικού κράτους, το παράδειγμα προς μίμηση για όλα τα υπόλοιπα κέντρα κράτησης μεταναστριών. Σε αυτό το καμπ λοιπόν η καθημερινότητα των κρατουμένων συνοδεύεται από συνθήκες που είναι δύσκολο για έναν άνθρωπο να τις φανταστεί, δεν γίνεται λόγος για το να τις βιώσει: Έλλειψη τροφής και γευμάτων, ολοκληρωτική απαγόρευση εξόδου, διαρκής αστυνόμευση, μηδενική επικοινωνία με τον “έξω κόσμο”, έλλειψη ιατροφαρμακευτικής περίθαλψης και ρουχισμού,ξυλοδαρμοί και βασανισμοί από τους μπάτσους σε δωμάτια απομόνωσης,εξαφάνιση …

author: Unknown
title: Asher - What Queerness Means To Me
content:
Author

: Asher

Title

: What Queerness Means To Me

Date

: July 7, 2011

Notes

: retrieved via the internet archive from

https://web.archive.org/web/20150228140452/http://www.tranarchism.com/2011/07/07/what-queerness-means-to-me/index.html

Source

: Retrieved on 28 Feb 2015 from

http://www.tranarchism.com/2011/07/07/what-queerness-means-to-me/index.html


 I remember playing pretend games with my brother when he was really little. For a happy ending to one epic struggle of good versus evil, he wanted all the dolls/“action figures” to “all get married together”—boys, girls, witches, dragons, demons, whatever, united in a big happy pansexual polygamous clusterfuck. I remember explaining to him that you couldn’t do that, that marriage was between two people, usually a man and a woman.


 Forgive me. I was twelve, I didn’t know any better. On the other hand he was about five, and apparently he already did.


 The innocence of children with regard to love, romance, gender, friendship and relationships is truly beautiful. They are basically open to all kinds of gender expressions and all sorts of relationships, including the queer, the polyamorous, the platonic. Best friends in preschool get engaged and even married all the time, regardless of gender (or prior mock-marital status). I remember that innocence.


 I lost it. First I was a girl, then I was heterosexual, then I was bisexual, then I was wondering if maybe I wasn’t kind of just a lesbian. Then I was polyamorous, then I was kinky, then I was pansexual. I was submissive, then a switch. Then I was gender questioning, then FTM, and gay. I was a transman, and then a trans man. I was homoflexible, or just a faggot. I was transsexual then transgender then transsexual again and finally just trans. Today I’m a trans fem/androgynous male who uses he/him/his pronouns and doesn’t like being called a man but guesses it’s better than being called a boy by strangers and who isn’t really genderqueer. I think. I may be something else tomorrow. And if you think that sounds complicated you should talk to some of my friends.


 But my own angsty odyssey of identity isn’t really what I want to talk about. I want to talk about the word queer and the world of possibility it represents to me. Queer is a term which for me recaptures the unconstrained innocence of childhood, when best friends could all get married together and we could all be fairy princesses one day and firefighters the next.


 Isn’t it weird that we’re all supposed to feel one way about friends, another about family, and another about lovers? Isn’t it strange that family is only determined by biology or sanctified by marriage and sealed with reproduction? Isn’t it odd that romance is supposed to be doomed without sex, and sex is considered pointless without romance? Isn’t it strange that we’re only supposed to feel one way about one person until death do us part?


 Queerness, to me, is about far more than homosexual attraction. It’s about a willingness to see all other taboos broken down. Sure, many of us start on this path when we first feel “same sex” or “same gender” attraction (though what is sex? And what is gender? And does anyone really have the same sex or gender as anyone else?). But queerness doesn’t stop there.


 This is a somewhat controversial stance, but to me queer means something completely different than “gay” or “lesbian” or “bisexual.” A queer person is usually someone who has come to a non-binary view of gender, who recognizes the validity of all trans identities, and who, given this understanding of infinite gender possibilities, finds it hard to define their sexuality any longer in a gender-based way. Queer people understand and support non-monogamy even if they do not engage in it themselves. They can grok being asexual or aromantic. (What does sex have to do with love, or love with sex, necessarily?) A queer can view promiscuous (protected) public bathhouse sex with strangers and complete abstinence as equally healthy.


 Queers understand that people have different relationships to their bodies. We get what it means to be stone. We know what body dysphoria is about. We understand that not everyone likes to get touched the same way or to get touched at all. We realize that people with disabilities may have different sexual needs, and that people with survivor histories often have sexual triggers. We can negotiate safe and creative ways to be intimate with people with HIV/AIDs and other …

author: Unknown
title: Assemblée ouverte de la caisse de solidarité Kaliméro
content:
Kaliméro est une caisse et une assemblée solidaire des prisonnier·e·s de la guerre sociale. La prochaine aura lieu le jeudi 10 septembre à 18h et se tiendra au 19, rue burnouf à Paris (19

e

).


La prison est un des rouages de ce système basé sur l'exploitation et la domination que nous voulons raser au sol, c'est pourquoi nous envoyons des mandats à celles et ceux accusé·e·s d'actes de révolte dont nous sommes solidaires.


Une caisse de solidarité a besoin de continuité. Nous n'avons ni sponsor, ni mécène, aussi avons-nous convenu d'un rendez-vous par mois pour collecter des sous pour alimenter la caisse. Ces rencontres sont également l'occasion d'échanger sur nos pratiques face à la répression, d'assurer le suivi des différentes histoires et de discuter des situations qui se présentent. Elle est également un moment de discussion autour des possibles moyens d'esquive, de résistance et d'auto-organisation offensive contre la machine judiciaire et carcérale.


Dans un souci de régularité, ces rencards ont été fixés le 2

e

 jeudi de chaque mois.


Pour envoyer de l'argent, pour demander des informations, ou pour être tenu·e·s au courant des prochains rendez-vous de la caisse et être inscrit·e·s sur la mailing-list de Kaliméro, écrivez à kalimeroparis(at)riseup.net

author: Unknown
title: L'été n'est pas fini. Appel à une assemblée pour s'organiser après cette période de canicules et d'incendies
content:
«

 

L'été n'est pas fini et pourtant on sent poindre le retour à la normale inhérent à la rentrée du métro boulot dodo. Plutôt que d'oublier cette rage qui nous a saisie, pour combattre la canicule des années à venir, nous proposons de nous retrouver le 21 septembre à 18h30, Aux Buttes-Chaumont, sur la pelouse proche de l'entrée face à la mairie du 19

e

.

 

»


Nous avons suffoqué tout l'été et nous savons que ça va recommencer. Pour celleux qui auraient estivé dans les catacombes ou fait l'autruche la tête dans le sable, faisons le décompte : 4 vagues de chaleur, 5 canicules, 10

 

% de la forêt de Fontainebleau qui flambe et en tout 119 000 ha de forêt partis en fumée en France depuis le début de l'année.


Et puis les records absolus qui tombent : juillet 2026 deuxième mois le plus chaud jamais enregistré à l'échelle mondiale, le Rhin et le Danube à leur niveau le plus bas jamais mesuré, 43% des petits cours d'eau français en rupture d'écoulement voire d'assecs (du jamais vu également).


Au-delà de ces tristes records, il y a aussi celleux qui ont perdu leurs maisons au Porge lorsque les pompiers protégeaient celles des millionnaires sur la presqu'île du cap Ferret, celleux qui ont perdu la vie dans les canicules extrêmes en Allemagne, en France, en Espagne, en Tunisie, et enfin les milliers d'animaux non-humains morts brûlés dans les énormes incendies en Andalousie, au Canada, en Algérie, dans le Bordelais. On ressent et on parle déjà d'autres types d'impacts. Sur nos facultés mentales, notre paresse, les maladies, pour penser et faire quoi que ce soit. Sur nos moments de sociabilité et de rencontres dans des espaces, extérieurs comme intérieurs, de plus en plus irrespirables. Pour sortir du désespoir et de la peur, alors que la rage bouillonne comme nos corps dans nos passoires thermiques.


L'État et celleux qui le font fonctionner cherchent des coupables. Outre les personnes ayant mis le feu volontairement pour différentes raisons (conflits d'usage, de voisinage, pyromanie), des personnes se sont retrouvées poursuivies pour incendie involontaire. En Île-de-France, la justice met en examen et place sous contrôle judiciaire deux ouvriers à l'origine du départ de feu dans la forêt de Fontainebleau. Leur tort

 

? S'être fait exploiter sous 40 degrés sur les travaux de l'autoroute A6 et avoir provoqué des étincelles avec une disqueuse pour couper des glissières de sécurité. Cette chasse au responsable tout trouvé a comme un goût de foutage de gueule... Ce qui créé les conditions pour que le feu se propage c'est le système capitaliste dans lequel nous vivons, ses industries polluantes dont nous dépendons et grâce auxquelles des patrons s'enrichissent au détriment des quelques espaces sauvages restants, des animaux, des arbres, de notre santé

 

; en somme, du vivant et de notre autonomie à tous.tes.


Il est vain d'attendre d'un gouvernement quel qu'il soit de changer radicalement la donne sur le processus en cours, de s'épuiser à lui exercer une pression ou de s'engager soi-même en espérant changer la politique de l'intérieur. D'ailleurs, ces vagues ont touché tellement de gens que des questions urgentes apparaissent encore plus clairement : Quels coups peut-on porter à ce désastre qu'ils appellent «

 

progrès

 

»

 

? Comment mettre la machine hors d'usage et vivre sans elle

 

? Certain.es n'ont pas attendu l'intervention de l'État pour agir en solidarité avec celleux touché.es par les dernières «

 

catastrophes

 

». À ce titre, on peut s'inspirer notamment des actions des habitant.es de Valence et alentours lors des inondations en 2024, des compagnon.nes grec.ques qui s'organisent de manière autonome depuis des années pour lutter contre les incendies, des personnes qui se sont bougées cet été pour aller porter leur aide aux animaux des forêts en flammes.


L'été n'est pas fini et pourtant on sent poindre le retour à la normale inhérent à la rentrée du métro boulot dodo. Plutôt que d'oublier cette rage qui nous a saisie, pour combattre la canicule des années à venir, nous proposons de nous retrouver le 21 septembre à 18h30, Aux Buttes-Chaumont, sur la pelouse proche de l'entrée face à la mairie du 19

e

. On pourra discuter de nos envies d'actions pour lutter contre les responsables du ravage de la planète et les profiteurs de canicules, se partager des expériences d'auto-organisation et de solidarité face aux désastres climatiques, se demander comment se décaler de notre propre …

author: Aaron Ernest Cruz
title: Declining poverty stats far from reality amid flooding, high prices
content:
Urban groups protest for the right to livelihood and to hold Marcos Jr. accountable. (Photo by Aaron Ernest Cruz/Bulatlat)

Marcos Jr. administration relies on unrealistic standards defining who is poor.

MANILA – Did poverty decline in the country? For Kadamay, an alliance of the urban poor, Filipinos are still struggling every day to survive.

Last week, the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) reported that poverty incidence in all regions declined from 2023 to 2025. Filipinos classified as poor are said to have dropped from 15.5 percent in 2023 to 9.7 percent in 2025, or from roughly 17.5 million to 11.1 million poor people.

The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) said that this shows the impact of the Marcos administration’s poverty alleviation programs.

Kadamay stressed that the statistics do not represent the collective experience of the urban poor “where they suffer from high prices of electricity, food, commodities, and oil while earning low salaries.”

On August 28, Kadamay and other groups held a national day of accountability after parts of Luzon suffered from severe flooding following a series southwest monsoon rains.

“Where did the government get those statistics? Is the lower poverty threshold of 97 pesos [$1.56] per day enough for Filipinos? There’s no legitimate measure of poverty rather than the lived experience of urban poor communities who are starving due to lack of access to their basic needs,” Mimi Doringo, Kadamay secretary-general, said.

Despite the rains, the groups pushed through with the mobilization in Mendiola and denounced the Marcos Jr. administration for showcasing recent statistics despite lack of accountability to hold those who are implicated in the anomalous flood-control projects.

Elvira Hiangan, 62, said that she did not feel that their lives were better in the past years as prices of goods remain high. She said that her four children stopped their education due to financial constraints and lack of opportunity.

Hiangan is a housewife who also looks after her six grandchildren as some of her children are single-handedly raising their kids.

“The taxes we pay are so high, but his [Marcos Jr.] programs for the poor are not sustainable and just trap us further in poverty,” Hiangan told Bulatlat.

Hiangan’s husband who works as a construction worker is not paid enough to cover their basic needs. She said that they even skip meals because of her husband’s insufficient salary.

“He is only earning a salary ranging from P500 to P700 ($8 – $11.30). Due to rainy weather, he can’t go to work.”

Hiangan’s family also experienced severe flooding for many years living in Sitio Bakal, Barangay Silangan, Quezon City.

“We are having a hard time sleeping when it continuously rains at night because our area is easily flooded,” she said.

Hiangan is one of the many people living in urban areas who are affected by botched or ghost flood-control projects.

The Center for Women’s Resources (CWR) said that the government’s figures represent a serious distortion of the extent of poverty in the Philippines. “By relying on a poverty threshold that does not adequately reflect the real cost of living or the income required for families to meet their basic needs and live with dignity, the government effectively narrows the definition of who is considered poor. This makes poverty appear smaller on paper than it is in people’s everyday lives.”

The group said that there may be millions of Filipinos classified as non-poor because their income falls slightly higher than the official poverty threshold. But CWR said that they continue to struggle to afford adequate food, housing, healthcare, education and other basic needs.

“The government is celebrating how many people have crossed the poverty line, but it is not asking the more important question: What kind of life can a Filipino family actually afford after crossing that line?” CWR Executive Director Cham Perez said in a statement.

Ibon Foundation said that the Marcos Jr. administration relies on unrealistic standards defining who is poor because their methodology uses the least-cost basket. This means that they only use cheaper goods to compute whether a Filipino household can afford it. The non-food needs are not considered in the computation.

“Poverty reduction should not mean merely keeping people barely above a statistical line. The government must create the conditions for sustained and broad-based improvements in living …

author: Unknown
title: 10 drones shot down over Erbil
content:
Following the US attack on Iran, the Iranian regime also bombed the Gulf countries of Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain, as well as the Kurdistan Region.

The KDP Counter-Terrorism Unit issued a statement regarding the attacks carried out in the early hours of the morning within the borders of Erbil (Hewlêr).

The statement said that Coalition Forces shot down 10 suicide drones over Erbil Governorate between 1:13 a.m. and 3:31 a.m.

According to the statement, there were no casualties as a result of the attacks.

Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps had also announced that it had targeted several areas in Erbil.

author: Unknown
title: Uber'de yeniden yapılanmanın faturası emekçilere: 3 bin 300 çalışan işten çıkarılacak
content:
Uber, yeniden yapılanma kapsamında dünya genelindeki çalışanlarının yaklaşık yüzde 10’una denk gelen 3 bin 300 kişiyi işten çıkaracak. Şirket, yönetici sayısını da yüzde 20 azaltırken ekipleri birleştirerek daha az çalışanla faaliyetlerini sürdürmeyi planlıyor.

Uber Technologies, dünya genelinde 3 bin 300 çalışanını işten çıkarma kararı aldı. İşten çıkarmalar şirketin toplam çalışanlarının yaklaşık yüzde 10'unu kapsıyor.

Bloomberg News’in haberine göre Uber CEO'su Dara Khosrowshahi, işten çıkarma ve yeniden yapılanma kararını çalışanlara gönderdiği e-postayla duyurdu.

Khosrowshahi, Uber’in son yıllardaki büyümesinin şirket içinde daha fazla yönetim kademesi, koordinasyon ihtiyacı ve parçalı bir işleyiş ortaya çıkardığını savundu. Mevcut organizasyon yapısının şirketin bugünkü ölçeğine uygun olmadığını ileri süren Khosrowshahi, yeniden yapılanmayla Uber'i “daha basit ve daha hızlı” hale getirmeyi amaçladıklarını belirtti.

Şirket sözcüsünün verdiği bilgiye göre işten çıkarmalarla birlikte Uber'deki yönetici sayısı yüzde 20 azaltılacak. Bazı yöneticiler ise yönetici olmayan pozisyonlara geçirilecek. Şirket, yöneticilerin ne kadarının işten çıkarılacağına ilişkin ayrıntı paylaşmadı. İşten çıkarmaların yönetici olmayan çalışanları da kapsayacağı belirtildi.

Yeniden yapılanma kapsamında yalnızca bir ya da iki çalışandan oluşan ekiplerin sayısının yaklaşık yarıya indirildiğini belirten Khosrowshahi, alt kademelerdeki çalışan sayısının da azaltıldığını açıkladı.

Uber, restoran, perakende ve teslimat hizmetlerindeki üç operasyon ekibini birleştirecek. Şirketin mühendislik, bilim ve teslimat alanlarındaki ekipleri de yeniden yapılandırılacak.

Şirket ayrıca çalışanların ofislere dönüşünü artırmayı planlıyor. Bu kapsamda uzaktan çalışma uygulamasının önemli ölçüde sınırlandırılacağı, çalışanların yaklaşık yüzde 1'inin tamamen uzaktan çalışmaya devam edeceği bildirildi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Doktor Özlem Gültekin'in ölüm nedeni belli oldu: Kanında yüksek miktarda propofol tespit edildi
content:
Fotoğraf: Özlem Gültekin'in kişisel arşivi

İzmir'de kendi kliniğinde şüpheli biçimde yaşamını yitiren Kadın Hastalıkları ve Doğum Uzmanı Op. Dr. Özlem Gültekin'in ölümüne ilişkin yürütülen soruşturmada adli tıp kurumu raporu tamamlandı. Raporda, 48 yaşındaki doktorun kesin ölüm nedeninin anestezide kullanılan propofol maddesine bağlı zehirlenme sonucu gerçekleştiği belirtildi.

Sabah'tan Huzeyfe Atıcı'nın haberine göre, toksikolojik incelemeler neticesinde hazırlanan raporda; Özlem Gültekin'in kanında, iç organlarında ve mide içeriğinde yüksek miktarda propofol tespit edilirken, yapılan analizlerde herhangi bir alkol veya uçucu madde bulgusuna rastlanmadığı bildirildi. Raporda ayrıca, Doktor Gültekin'in kliniğinde serum ve propofol uygulaması yapıldığı sırada kalbinin durduğu ve tüm müdahalelere rağmen hayatını kaybettiği vurgulandı.

Otopsi raporunda, Gültekin'in vücudunda tespit edilen morluk ve kaburga kırıklarının, duran kalbi yeniden çalıştırmak amacıyla uygulanan canlandırma (CPR) müdahaleleri sırasında oluştuğu değerlendirmesine yer verildi.

Gültekin'in şüpheli ölümüne ilişkin başlatılan adli soruşturma kapsamında, klinik çalışanları ve olaya müdahale eden 112 Acil Servis personelinin de aralarında yer aldığı altı kişinin "bilgi sahibi" sıfatıyla ifadesi alındı. Güvenlik kamerası kayıtlarına el konulan klinikteki incelemeler ve adli süreç sürüyor.

İzmir'de Kadın Hastalıkları ve Doğum Uzmanı Op. Dr. Özlem Gültekin (48), kendi özel kliniğinde serum uygulaması esnasında kalbinin durması sonucu şüpheli şekilde yaşamını yitirmişti. Haber spikeri Erhan Çelik ile boşanma sürecinde olduğu öğrenilen Gültekin'in ölümü üzerine soruşturma başlatılmış; kesin ölüm sebebinin tespiti için otopsi ve adli tıp kurumu incelemesi talep edilerek kliniğe ait güvenlik kamerası kayıtlarına el konulmuştu.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Trump'tan İran itirafı: Saldırıları İsrail'e yardım için yapıyoruz
content:
ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, İran'a yönelik saldırıları ve ekonomik yaptırımları, İsrail'e ve Ortadoğu'ya yardım etmek amacıyla yaptıklarını savundu.

AA'da yer alan habere göre Trump, Beyaz Saray'da düzenlenen bir akşam yemeğinde İran gündemine ilişkin konuştu. İran'a yönelik saldırıların ve ekonomik yaptırımların ardından İran'ın ekonomisinin "tamamen çöktüğünü" öne süren Trump, "Bütün bunları yüzde 99 oranla Ortadoğu'ya yardım etmek için yapıyoruz. İsrail'e yardım etmek için yapıyoruz. Bunu kendimize yardım etmek için yapıyoruz. Çünkü İsrail'i yok ettikten sonra ki bunu çok memnuniyetle yaparlardı, Ortadoğu'ya sonra da Avrupa'ya ve bazı şehirlerimize saldıracaklar. Çünkü (ABD) onları yok etmeden önce birkaç şehri yok edebilirlerdi" ifadelerini kullandı.

Trump, ABD'nin Hürmüz Boğazı'nı kontrol ettiğini savunarak, petrol yüklü gemilerin oradan geçtiğini ifade etti.

Trump, daha önceki açıklamasında İran'a "istedikleri zaman" yeniden saldırılar düzenlemeye hazır olduklarını belirtmiş, Hürmüz Boğazı'nın tamamen ABD'nin kontrolünde olduğunu savunmuştu.
