author: Franck Dick Rosete
title: Lianga Massacre and the Lumad struggle
content:
BULATLAT FILE PHOTO. A Sandugo protest in front of Camp Aguinaldo in Quezon City in September 2016 (Photo by Carlo Manalansan/Bulatlat)

More than a decade has passed but justice remains elusive.

CAGAYAN DE ORO — The 2015 Lianga Massacre reflects the continuing struggle of Lumad communities.

The Kalipunan ng Katutubong Mamamayan ng Pilipinas (Katribu), an alliance of Indigenous peoples organizations, stressed this point as various groups commemorated on September 1 the killing of Emerito Samarca, executive director of the Alternative Learning Center for Agricultural and Livelihood Development Incorporated (Alcadev), as well as Lumad leaders Dionel Campos and Datu Juvello Sinzo in Sitio Han-ayan, Barangay Diatagon, Lianga, Surigao del Sur, 11 years ago.

More than a decade has passed but justice remains elusive for the victims of the massacre allegedly perpetrated by paramilitary group Magahat-Bagani with the alleged knowledge of the Philippine military operating in the area.

Read: ‘Soldiers watched as paramilitary attacked us’

Three leaders of Magahat-Bagani were identified as primary suspects, namely Bobby Tejero, Loloy Tejero, and Margarito Layno. Twenty-three other members of the said paramilitary group were also reportedly implicated.

In 2022, one of the Tejero brothers accused of killing the Alcadev executive director was reportedly arrested by authorities. In an Inquirer report, the leader of Magahat-Bagani who allegedly led the September 1, 2015, attack in Lianga, Surigao del Sur, also surrendered to the authorities.

Former Bayan Muna Rep. Eufemia Cullamat who witnessed the incident said that Army officials and personnel allegedly involved should also be held accountable. “It is very clear to us that their killings were due to our efforts to improve our lives and communities while protecting and defending our ancestral lands.”

Cullamat is a cousin of Campos and a niece of Datu Sinzo. She was at the wake of her deceased father when armed paramilitary forces entered the area and ordered them to leave, prompting them to settle in a basketball court. Her cousin Campos was allegedly shot in front of many people.

“Katribu demands accountability for the perpetrators of the Lianga Massacre and all killings of Indigenous Peoples,” the group said in a statement.

Concerned groups said that human rights violations against the Lumad continue despite calls to stop Lumad killings following the bloody 2015 massacre, recounting the killing of Willy Rodriguez, Lenie Rivas, and 12-year-old Angel Rivas—also known as the 2021 Lianga Massacre—who were tagged by the military as members of the New People’s Army (NPA).

They also recalled the case of Lumad youth Obello Bay-ao and Elioterio Ugking who were allegedly killed by members of the Citizen Armed Force Geographical Unit (Cafgu), an auxiliary force of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), in 2017 and 2025, respectively.

In June, Lumad woman Nenita Buscada was killed by members of the Philippine Army’s 88th Infantry Battalion in Malaybalay City, Bukidnon, after they mistook her and her husband as NPA members. The couple reportedly went to a forested area to gather wood and sell it to buy school supplies for their children.

The Lumad struggle for their rights to their ancestral lands also continues, as in the case of the Gulinsao clan that has kept asserting ownership of the land within a government property in Malaybalay City, Bukidnon, as well as the pushback of the Kirinteken-Ilentungen Menuvu against the establishment of a perimeter fence by a banana plantation company within what they claimed as part of their ancestral domain in Don Carlos town, also in Bukidnon.

Katribu said that the repression against the Lumad extends to those who stand with them. The group called for justice for the killing of Lumad school teachers Chad Booc and Gelejurain Ngujo II—part of the New Bataan 5 allegedly massacred in Davao de Oro—and criticized the conviction of former lawmakers Satur Ocampo and France Castro, as well as Lumad volunteer teachers, following their humanitarian mission in 2018 that aimed to rescue Lumad students who allegedly faced harassment by a paramilitary group in Talaingod, Davao del Norte.

Castro said that the 2015 Lianga Massacre is a precursor to the attacks on Lumad schools, of which more than 200 were closed during the Rodrigo Duterte administration, according to the Save Our Schools (SOS) Network, a coalition of various organizations advocating for …

author: Dulce Amor Rodriguez
title: Indigenous communities, advocates launch network opposing Pax Silica
content:
Participants put their signatures signifying their opposition to the Pax Silica Initiative during the launching of the Network Opposed to Pax Silica (NO to Pax Silica) on August 31, 2026. By Dulce Amor Rodriguez/Bulatlat

“We must prioritize the people, not foreign profits.”

MANILA — Indigenous peoples, farmers, scientists, environmental advocates, faith leaders, students, and progressive organizations launched the Network Opposed to Pax Silica (NO to Pax Silica) on Aug. 31, warning that the Marcos, Jr. administration’s participation in the United States-led initiative could threaten ancestral lands, food security, environment, and national sovereignty.

The coalition was launched at the Mary Hill School of Theology in Quezon City amid growing public debate over Pax Silica and the proposed Economic Security Zone (ESZ) in New Clark City, Tarlac.

The network described its formation as the beginning of a nationwide campaign to scrutinize the project and mobilize communities that may be affected by its implementation.

The launch came weeks after government agencies intensified efforts to promote Pax Silica as a flagship industrial and technology initiative linked to artificial intelligence (AI), semiconductors, advanced manufacturing, and critical minerals under the Luzon Economic Corridor. Government officials said the project could attract billions of dollars in investments and generate more than 130,000 jobs.

The Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA) identified a site in New Clark City for what it describes as an AI-native industrial acceleration and manufacturing hub under the Pax Silica framework.

The coalition questioned whether the project would benefit ordinary Filipinos or primarily serve foreign strategic and corporate interests.

“Pax Silica: Development for whom?” became the central question raised throughout the program.

Representatives of Indigenous communities said that they learned about Pax Silica through social media rather than through direct consultations.

Apung Petronila Capiz-Muñoz, chieftain of Sitio Sapang Kawayan in Capas, Tarlac, said that government authorities have yet to explain the project to affected communities.

She also recounted experiences of military red-tagging directed at Indigenous residents who raised concerns about the project.

Capiz-Muñoz said that many Aetas fear the possible loss of ancestral lands and livelihoods.

“How about us Indigenous peoples and fellow farmers?” she asked. “We all know that the land is our life. What will happen to our livelihood?”

She said that the uncertainty surrounding the project deepened anxiety among communities that depend on farming and ancestral lands for survival.

“I cannot accept it,” she said. “I hope Pax Silica will not push through. What will happen to the next generations?”

The coalition said that the proposed Economic Security Zone could affect approximately 1,620 hectares of agricultural and ancestral lands in Capas, Tarlac.

It warned that industrial expansion and land conversion could displace farming families and Indigenous communities while weakening local food production.

Environmental advocates challenged the lack of transparency surrounding the project.

Beauty queen and environmental advocate Beatrice Millan-Windorski said that no publicly available Environmental Impact Assessment has been released for Pax Silica.

“As one of the world’s 18 megabiodiverse countries, we should not bear the brunt of a development with no transparency or clear data on environmental impact,” she said.

Millan-Windorski said that communities deserve access to information before the government proceeds with large-scale industrial projects.

She warned that hyperscale data centers and related infrastructure could place additional pressure on water, energy, and land resources.

“What we do know is that data centers generate a heat island effect and consume immense amounts of energy, water, and resources,” she said.

She also cited reports that farmers in Barangay O’Donnell had been asked to leave lands they had cultivated for generations and warned that hundreds of families could face displacement if the project proceeds.

Antonio Dizon of Ban Toxics raised similar concerns. He warned that the country could become a dumping ground for electronic waste generated by high-technology industries.

author: Federacja Anarchistyczna Wrocław
title: Narodziny Wszystkiego - David Graeber. Anarchistyczna antropologia.
content:
David Graeber (ur. 12.02. 1961 w Nowym Jorku zm. 02.09.2020 w Wenecji) – amerykański antropolog, działacz anarchistyczny i autor wielu książek. Był profesorem antropologii w London School of Economics.


"Narodziny wszystkiego. Nowa historia ludzkości." to książka archeologa Davida Wengrowa oraz Davida Graebera, której napisanie zajęło im ponad 10 lat.


Wśród wielu wywołuje oburzenie, bo podważa dogmaty oraz przymusza do krytycznego spojrzenia na historię, którą znamy.


Historia, której jesteśmy uczeni w państwowej szkole, jest pełna opisów hierarchicznych form społeczeństw. Uczeni domagają się dokładnych dowodów na to, by uznać jakieś społeczności za wolnościowe, jednak z lekką ręką inne uznają za społeczności z wyraźną władzą.


Tak w historii, jak i w dziełach Sci-Fi ciężko znaleźć opisy świata, w którym żyje się lepiej, niż dziś.


Film podzielony jest na kilka części.


00:04 - 10:30 Wstęp


10:33 - 13:05 Spis treści z opisem rozdziałów


13:22 -  31:58 Co podważymy dzięki tej książce?


O rynkach, zwyczajach, handlu i grobach. O zbieraczach i rolnictwie, o demokracji i krytyce anarchii. O początkach cywilizacji i o tym, że nie istniało coś takiego, jak rewolucja agrarna. O stworzeniu państwa.


32:12 - 43:26 Kolonizacja Ameryki.


O zderzeniu cywilizacji i ogromie nauki, którą Europejczycy odebrali od Ludów Pierwotnych, ale również o strachu przed tym, by wartości takie jak wzajemna troska, równość czy faktyczna demokracja, trafiły do krajów, gdzie rządzi siła. O rasizmie, określeniach oraz ekonomii oraz o wzajemnym porywaniu dzieci.


Pan, przykazanie, posłuszeństwo - bardzo trudno było znaleźć takie określenia w języku Ludów Rdzennych - żalili się europejscy jezuici.


Pomysł własności prywatnej był nie do zrozumienia dla mieszkańców Ameryki.


Części, o których nie udało się powiedzieć:


5. Unikanie państwowości.


6. Ignorancja "Zachodu"


Recenzja książki została wygłoszona w trakcie Autonomous Bookfair Wrocław 2023.


Dziś, w 6.rocznicę śmierci Graebera, wrzucamy nagranie.


#antropologia #davidgraeber #davidwengrow #anarchistycznaantropologia #narodzinywszystkiego

author: newsroom
title: Τα Προσφυγικά υποδέχονται σήμερα τον Αριστοτέλη Χαντζή που ολοκληρώνει τη νοσηλεία του
content:
Σύνδεσμος δημοσίευσης:

Τα Προσφυγικά υποδέχονται σήμερα τον Αριστοτέλη Χαντζή που ολοκληρώνει τη νοσηλεία του


Κάλεσμα σε συγκέντρωση υποδοχής του Αριστοτέλη Χαντζή, απεργού πείνας των Προσφυγικών.


01/09/2026


Μετά από 73 μέρες νοσηλείας, εκ των οποίων οι 58 στη ΜΕΘ, ο σύντροφός μας Αριστοτέλης Χαντζής παίρνει εξιτήριο αύριο, Τετάρτη 2/9, από την πνευμονολογική κλινική του Ευαγγελισμού κι επιστρέφει στη γειτονιά των Προσφυγικών.


Η μεγάλη νίκη του αγώνα της Κοινότητας των Κατειλημμένων Προσφυγικών και της απεργίας πείνας μέχρι θανάτου του Αριστοτέλη Χαντζή και της Suzon Doppagne είναι μια πολυσήμαντη νίκη, που επιβεβαιώνει πως μόνος δρόμος είναι εκείνος της αντίστασης.Ο σύντροφός μας Αρίστος βρέθηκε στην αιχμή αυτού του αγώνα, με την απεργία πείνας μέχρι θανάτου, για να υπερασπιστεί όλα όσα οραματιζόμαστε και διεκδικούμε χτίζοντας τον κόσμο μας από τα κάτω.


Καλούμε όλους τους ανθρώπους που στάθηκαν από κάθε μετερίζι αυτού του αγώνα στη συγκέντρωση υποδοχής στη γειτονιά των Προσφυγικών, την Τετάρτη 2/9 στις 18:30, για να γιορτάσουμε μαζί την επιστροφή του συντρόφου μας.


Η συγκέντρωση θα πραγματοποιηθεί στο πρώτο μπλοκ επί της Λ. Αλεξάνδρας μπροστά στο Συλλογικό Καφενείο των Προσφυγικών.


Ή θα νικήσουμε ή θα νικήσουμε / Either we will win or we will win,


Συνέλευση Κατειλημμένων Προσφυγικών (ΣΥ.ΚΑ.ΠΡΟ.) / Assembly of Squatted Prosfygika (SY.KA.PRO.)


Η Κοινότητα των Προσφυγικών έχει δημοσιεύσει επίσης τον ακόλουθο χαιρετισμό για την έξοδο του Α. Χαντζή από τη ΜΕΘ:


31/08/2026: ΧΑΙΡΕΤΙΖΟΥΜΕ ΤΗΝ ΕΠΙΣΤΡΟΦΗ ΤΟΥ ΣΥΝΤΡΟΦΟΥ ΜΑΣ ΑΡΙΣΤΟΥ – ΣΥΝΕΧΙΖΟΥΜΕ ΝΑ ΥΦΑΙΝΟΥΜΕ ΤΟ ΝΗΜΑ ΤΗΣ ΖΩΗΣ


Η ζωή πρέπει να ‘ναι τόσο σοβαρή


που έτσι, να πούμε, ακουμπισμένος σ’ έναν τοίχο


με τα χέρια σου δεμένα,


ή μέσα στ’ αργαστήρι,


με λευκή μπλούζα και μεγάλα ματογυάλια,


θε να πεθάνεις, για να ζήσουνε οι άνθρωποι,


οι άνθρωποι που ποτέ δε θα ‘χεις δει το πρόσωπό τους


και θα πεθάνεις ξέροντας καλά


πως τίποτα πιο ωραίο, πως τίποτα πιο αληθινό


απ’ τη ζωή δεν είναι.


Τόσο μά τόσο σοβαρά


που ακόμα και στα εβδομήντα σου, για παράδειγμα,


θα φυτεύεις ελιές,


κι όχι έτσι για τους γιους σου,


μήτε γιατί δεν πίστευες στο θάνατο,


μα γιατί η ζωή


θε να βαραίνει πιότερο στη ζυγαριά


Ναζίμ Χικμέτ, Για τη ζωή


Η έξοδος του συντρόφου μας Αριστοτέλη Χαντζή από τη ΜΕΘ του Ευαγγελισμού την Παρασκευή 21/8, σηματοδοτεί τη μετάβαση σε έναν επόμενο κύκλο αγώνα. Στην ήδη υπάρχουσα νίκη της ίδιας της απεργίας πείνας, έρχεται τώρα και προστίθεται η χαρά και η συγκίνηση της επιστροφής του Αρίστου και του χαιρετισμού της νίκης κι από τον ίδιο.


Λίγες ώρες μετά το ψήφισμα του Δήμου Αθηναίων – το οποίο, μετά τις τεράστιες πιέσεις από τα κάτω, κάλυψε σε μεγάλο βαθμό τα αιτήματα της απεργίας πείνας και αναγνώρισε την Κοινότητα ως φυσικό συνομιλητή – η υγεία του Αρίστου επιδεινώθηκε ραγδαία, οδηγώντας στη νοσηλεία του στη ΜΕΘ και τελικά στη διασωλήνωσή του.


Μετά από 58 μέρες νοσηλείας στη ΜΕΘ, η πορεία της υγείας του έχει ξεπεράσει κάθε προσδοκία. Κι αυτό το οφείλουμε στην υπεράνθρωπη προσπάθεια των υγειονομικών και όλων των εργαζομένων της Παθολογικής κλινικής του «Γ. Γεννηματάς», της ΜΕΘ του Γεννηματάς, της ΜΕΘ του Ευαγγελισμού και της Πνευμονολογικής κλινικής του Ευαγγελισμού. Θέλουμε να ευχαριστήσουμε έναν έναν αυτούς τους ανθρώπους, ιδιαίτερα εκείνους της ΜΕΘ του Ευαγγελισμού, όπου ο σύντροφός μας έμεινε και το μεγαλύτερο διάστημα, οι οποίοι κλήθηκαν – καθώς δεν υπήρχε αντίστοιχη βιβλιογραφία – να “εφεύρουν” τον τρόπο θεραπείας ενός απεργού πείνας μακράς διαρκείας, που έχει βρεθεί ένα βήμα πριν τον θάνατο. Φρόντισαν, δε, τον Αρίστο με ιδιαίτερο ενδιαφέρον, ακολουθώντας υποδειγματικά την ιατρική δεοντολογία και στάθηκαν αλληλέγγυοι, ακόμα και στις πιο δύσκολες συνθήκες, κάνοντας τα αδύνατα δυνατά. Είναι η δική τους επίμονη και καθημερινή προσπάθεια, η οποία από κοινού με την αποφασιστικότητα και τον αγώνα για ζωή του ίδιου του Αρίστου, έκαναν τον σύντροφό μας να ξανααναπνεύσει, να ξαναδεί, να ξανακαταπιεί, να ξαναμιλήσει, να ξανακινηθεί, να ξαναπερπατήσει.


Θέλουμε, επίσης, να ευχαριστήσουμε για ακόμη μια φορά όλους τους αλληλέγγυους ανθρώπους που στάθηκαν μαζί με την Κοινότητα για ολόκληρα εικοσιτετράωρα έξω από τα νοσοκομεία και όλους όσοι έσπευσαν να δώσουν αιμοπετάλια την κρίσιμη στιγμή προκειμένου να επιβιώσει ο Αρίστος.


Από την πρώτη στιγμή της έναρξης της απεργίας πείνας του μέχρι και σήμερα, η πίστη του συντρόφου μας στον συλλογικό σκοπό, η ισχυρή ιδεολογικοπολιτική του συγκρότηση και το αίσθημα της ευθύνης απέναντι στη ζωή …

author: CMI Argentina
title: Se cumplen 4 años del atentado a Cristina y la justicia no avanzó hacia los ideólogos y financiadores
content:
En el juicio oral que finalizó el año pasado fueron condenados el autor material Fernando Sabag Montiel a 10 años de prisión y su novia Brenda Uliarte a 8 años.


Sin embargo, no se avanzó hacia los autores intelectuales: el celular de Sabag Montiel fue reseteado y sus datos borrados cuando ya estaba bajo custodia de la policía y la causa a cargo de la jueza Ana María Capuchetti.


También fueron borrados los dato de los celulares de las secretarias de ex diputado y colaborador de Patricia Bullrich, Gerardo Milman, a quien un testigo escuchó decir que cuando mataran a Cristina él estaría viajando a la costa.


Tampoco se avanzó sobre los pago que recibió el grupo Revolución Federal de la firma Caputo Hermanos (de la familia del actual ministro de Economía) para supuestos trabajos de carpintería. Durante el juicio oral por el atentado la propia ex presidenta planteó que faltaban los autores intelectuales y los financiadores.


El diputado nacional Juan Grabois difundió un mensaje en sus redes a cuatro años del atentado a Cristina. Allí opinó los motivos por los que en su opinión la quisieron matar y luego la condenaron e inhabilitaron.

author: Kay Pacha / Equipo Pueblos Originarios del SERPAJ
title: Las Warmis de Jujuy y su caminata reivindicando derechos
content:
La segunda caminata en defensa de la Pachamama y los territorios ancestrales de las Warmikuna (mujeres del Kollasuyo) salió el 3 de agosto desde Rinconada, Provincia de Jujuy. Son siete mujeres caminantes, lideradas por Florencia Solís,  que desde la Puna de Jujuy, bajaron a San Salvador, pasaron por Salta, Tucumán, Santiago del Estero, Córdoba y Santa Fe, llegando a Buenos Aires el domingo 30 del mismo mes.


https://argentina.indymedia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Las-Warmis-de-Jujuy.mp3


https://argentina.indymedia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Las-Warmis-de-Jujuy.mp3


Descargr audio


Cabe destacar que hicieron paradas en distintas ciudades por donde pasaron y recibieron el apoyo de mucha gente que se solidarizó con sus reclamos.


 


Y cuáles son sus reclamos? En primer lugar, denuncian la contaminación ambiental y el despojo territorial. Hablan de la grave contaminación en la Laguna de Pozuelos por la actividad minera (como el caso de Mina Pan de Azúcar, Mina Pirquitas, Mina Chinchillas y minas abandonadas sin remediar).


También dicen que los pedimentos mineros que abarcan la Puna, Quebrada y Valles De Jujuy, amenazan con el desalojo de comunidades de sus tierras ancestrales.


Otro tema es la Violación de derechos y tratados internacionales, como el incumplimiento sistemático de la Consulta Previa, Libre e Informada (Convenio 169 de la OIT) y del Acuerdo de Escazú (Ley 27.566) en cuanto al acceso a la información y justicia ambiental.


 


Están decididas a interpelar al Congreso, ya que  si las comunidades originarias son tratadas verdaderamente como sujetos de derecho colectivo, porqué se favorece al extractivismo por encima del bienestar de las comunidades.Los reclamos que ellas traen, son en general, los mismos que trajeron los hermanos y hermanas del Tercer Malón de la Paz, y como no son escuchadas por las autoridades de su propia provincia, decidieron venir al centro social, político y administrativo como es la ciudad de Buenos Aires. Así que a su paso recogieron el apoyo solidario de quienes comparten sus reclamos y las vienen acompañando de acuerdo a sus posibilidades


Entonces vamos a escuchar ahora algunas de sus intervenciones en los distintos escenarios donde se presentaron, por ejemplo en la ciudad de Rosario, donde fueron recibidas por un funcionario municipal y al llegar a Buenos Aires. Como siempre agradecemos a las hermanas de Telesisa, que vienen acompañando a estas valientes mujeres por una parte de este material y a Uniendo Fronteras RTV de Rosario.


El Micro Kay Pacha se realiza con el apoyo de la organización Otto per Mille-Chiessa Valdense

title: "Went to Sea and Never Came Back": Families of Fishermen Seek Answers After Deadly U.S. Boat Strikes
content:
A year ago today, the United States bombed a small boat in the Caribbean, killing nine people on board. Two survivors clung to the wreckage for 45 minutes, reportedly waving for help, before a second “double-tap” strike killed them, too. President Trump posted a video of the first attack on social media, announcing that 11 terrorists had been killed in a military operation that would be called “Operation Southern Spear.” The second video, showing the killing of the survivors, has never been released. The bombings have continued for a year, killing at least 227 people in nearly 70 separate strikes. The Pentagon often accuses the boats it targets of narcotrafficking.


In a new documentary, the investigative team at Al Jazeera’s

Fault Lines

 traveled to St. Lucia and Colombia to speak with two families who believe their loved ones, both fishermen, were killed at sea by U.S. airstrikes. “They describe it as a war. They describe these people as enemy combatants that are attacking America,” says Josh Rushing, a senior correspondent for

Fault Lines

 who worked on the documentary. In reality, “it’s unclear, really, if the U.S. government knows who they’re killing … They’ve never named anyone in any of the strikes.”


“We had the 'war on drugs,' the 'war on terror.' This is kind of the worst of both,” says Rushing.

author: Daron Letts
title: Man involved in 16-hour Iqaluit standoff sentenced 21 months
content:
A man who fired an air rifle at Iqaluit RCMP during a 16-hour

standoff

 last September is “lucky” to be alive to serve jail time, said an Iqaluit judge.


Police escort a man and a woman from an apartment on Tasilik Street, where police spent 16 hours in a standoff after responding to a call that shots had been fired. Jayko Kownirk was sentenced for four charges on Aug. 20 related to the incident. (Photo by Daron Letts)


Justice Mark Mossey sentenced Jayco Kownirk on Aug. 20 to two years, eight months and six days in jail for four of the 15 offences he faced. The other 11 were dropped.


Of this sentence, Kownirk still has four months to serve after Mossey gave him 492 days’ credit for the 328 days he has already spent in custody since his arrest.


“The near fatal result of mixing alcohol with poor decision making and a firearm, could easily have cost him his life,” Mossey wrote in his decision.


On the afternoon of Sept. 27, 2025, police responded to reports of shots fired in an apartment on Tasilik Street in the city’s Lake Subdivision. The RCMP deployed a drone and used crisis negotiators during the resulting standoff.


Police issued a shelter-in-place order emergency alert after 1 a.m.


There were about 20 officers dressed in camouflage tactical uniforms on scene at the height of the incident.


Officers remained on scene until the

standoff ended

 around 4 p.m. Sept. 28 when officers deployed tear gas into the residence to coax Kownirk outside, where he eventually surrendered.


The stand-off “paralyzed” the neighbourhood, Mossey said.


Kownirk pleaded guilty to firing the air rifle while committing mischief, uttering death threats against officers and breaching an existing probation order to keep the peace.


The mischief charge was among those withdrawn.


Kownirk also pleaded guilty to theft under $5,000, committed 10 days before the incident, which contributed to mitigating his sentence.


Mossey took into account systemic issues that contributed to Kownirk’s long list of property crimes that escalated to violent offences but added it was unnecessary to detail them in his ruling.


Kownirk is banned from owning a firearm for life, except for the purpose of sustenance hunting.

title: KOMAW calls for participation in Kurdish Culture Festival on Saturday
content:
The Association of Martyrs’ Families (KOMAW) called for participation in the Kurdish Culture Festival, which will be held in Dortmund, Germany, on 5 September.


KOMAW said in a statement that the festival was not merely an event celebrating and preserving Kurdish culture, language, art and social values.  The statement said, “It is also an important gathering where the Kurdish people will strongly demonstrate their commitment to peace, democracy, freedom and coexistence.”


The statement said the suffering, losses and heavy sacrifices endured by the Kurdish people throughout history demonstrated the devastating consequences of war and conflict for societies. As families of the fallen, KOMAW said they wanted no other family to experience such suffering, no mother to lose her child, and the future of peoples to be shaped not by wars but through peace and democratic solutions.


KOMAW said its work was rooted in respect for human life, peace, democracy, justice and the free will of peoples. The statement said, “We have stood for peace, not war; for a democratic solution, not conflict; and for fraternity among peoples, not hostility.”


The statement said the process initiated by Abdullah Öcalan and centred on the pursuit of peace and a democratic solution was important not only for the Kurdish people but also for the future of the region and all its peoples. KOMAW therefore stressed the need to support every effort towards a democratic solution and lasting peace.


KOMAW expressed hope that the Kurdish Culture Festival in Dortmund would become a powerful voice for this vision. The statement called for a message to rise from the festival grounds saying: “Yes to peace, not war; to dialogue, not conflict; to democracy, not denial; and to fraternity among peoples, not division.”


The statement stressed that keeping Kurdish culture, art, language and social values alive also meant strengthening a culture of peace, adding that the ability of different peoples and cultures to express themselves freely was one of the most important indicators of a democratic and peaceful society.


KOMAW called on everyone committed to the values of the Kurdish people, particularly families of the fallen, as well as friends, democratic institutions, civil society organisations and all those who stand for peace, to attend the festival in Dortmund on 5 September.


The statement said, “Come, let us make this festival not only a celebration of culture and art, but also a festival of peace, democracy, fraternity and the will to live together.”


KOMAW stressed that the memory of those who lost their lives should be kept alive not through the continuation of wars, but through the building of peace and a democratic future. The statement concluded: “Let the Kurdish Culture Festival be the voice of peace, democracy and fraternity among peoples. Let it be the voice of hope for a free and democratic future. We invite all our people to come together in Dortmund on 5 September 2026.”

author: Wanessa Celina
title: Resgates de pessoas em condição de escravidão caem no Brasil, mas disparam em SP, diz CPT
content:
O Estado de São Paulo já teve mais resgates de trabalhadores sujeitos a trabalho análogo à escravidão no campo nos seis primeiros meses do ano do que em todo o ano de 2025. É o que revelam dados do relatório de Conflitos no Campo, com dados parciais de 2026, divulgado nesta quarta-feira (2), pela Comissão Pastoral da Terra (CPT). O número nacional total de resgatados de condições degradantes de trabalho, por outro lado, diminuiu.


Ao todo, 148 trabalhadores foram resgatados no primeiro semestre deste ano em São Paulo. A marca já é superior aos 142 de 2025. A maior parte desses profissionais trabalhava no plantio e corte de cana-de-açúcar.


Para a coordenadora do CPT, Cecília Gomes, o aumento de casos pode ser visto pela característica do tipo de trabalho nos campos, incluindo lavoureiros e operários de construções. Entretanto, Gomes também avalia que o aumento da tecnologia pode influenciar nessa conta.


“Aquela história de que levar a tecnologia para o campo vai diminuir a mão de obra e o trabalho escravo, essa hipótese cai por terra. Porque, quando a gente olha, quanto mais tecnológico é o ambiente, maior a probabilidade ou a possibilidade de ter trabalho escravo. Essa é uma característica que tanto está no Sul, no Sudeste, no Centro-Oeste, está em todas as regiões brasileiras”, afirma a coordenadora.


No país, 355 trabalhadores foram resgatados em 30 casos registrados entre janeiro e junho. Em 2025, essa marca foi de 842 pessoas. Mesmo com as subnotificações das denúncias, Gomes afirma que o trabalho da CPT em conjunto com o Ministério do Trabalho mostra que existe uma necessidade de um olhar mais atento nas áreas mais tecnológicas.


A CPT também identificou que os casos mais graves de violência são praticados, em sua maioria, por fazendeiros (305 casos) e empresários (102 casos), que respondem por dois terços dos assassinatos e 61,4% dos episódios de violência contra ocupação e posse no primeiro semestre de 2026.


Para Gomes, a crescente violência no campo é possibilitada pela impunidade dos agentes causadores. “Pouco desses casos são apurados e os poucos que são apurados são pouco punidos”, explica a coordenadora da CPT.


Cresce a contaminação violenta de cidadãos


Violência mais praticada no campo em 2026, a contaminação por minérios atingiu 195 ocorrências. Para a CPT, o cenário é possível devido à priorização do “lucro em detrimento à vida” e da falta de fiscalizações mais rígidas de mineradoras.


Também houve 169 casos de contaminação por agrotóxicos, o que passa longe de ser por acaso, já que a organização vem identificando o uso intencional dessas substâncias como um tipo prático de arma química. “Não é só a contaminação das águas, esse agrotóxico é colocado para atingir os povos, para atingir as comunidades, como uma forma de expulsão”, denuncia Gomes.


E a contaminação por agrotóxico é venenosa porque as pessoas não conseguem produzir nem reproduzir o seu jeito, o seu modo de ser. Eles [a comunidade camponesa] têm uma cultura do plantio, da colheita, da alimentação e da diversidade. Mas não vão conseguir ter essa diversidade na produção, porque, como a água está contaminada, vai queimar as lavouras, vai danificar as lavouras”


Cecília Gomes


Coordenadora da CPT


Em 2025, o Brasil bateu recorde de agrotóxicos liberados. Foram 750 registros concedidos pelo Ministério da Agricultura, Pecuária e Abastecimento (Mapa).

title: Kürtler'e yönelik nefret söylemlerinde bulunan şahıs gözaltına alındı
content:
Maç çıkışı Trabzon taraftarlarını taşıyan otobüste çekilen ve sosyal medyada tepkilere neden olan görüntülerdeki nefret söyleminde bulunan şahıs gözaltına alındı.


Sosyal medyaya yansıyan videoda söz konusu şahsın Kürt yurttaşlara yönelik, "Kürtlerin en iyisi ölüp mezara girendir. Toplanıp Kürtçe konuşuyorlar, konuşturmayacaksın. Bunlara acımayacaksın, tekmeyi vuracaksın" şeklindeki ifadeler büyük tepki topladı.


AKP ve HÜDA PAR tepki gösterdi


Görüntülerin yayılmasının ardından Amedsporlu Hukukçular Derneği suç duyurusunda bulunurken, AKP ve HÜDA PAR'dan da tepki açıklamaları geldi.


AKP'li Mehmet Metiner, "'En iyi Kürt ölü Kürt’tür!' diyebilecek kadar nefret kusan bir ırkçı zihin hem akidemiz, hem devletimizin bekası hem de toplumsal barışımız için çok ciddi bir tehdittir. Bu düpedüz bir ağır suçtur" diyerek soruşturma açılması çağrısında bulundu.


HÜDA PAR Milletvekili Faruk Dinç de "Kürt halkına yönelik ağza alınmayacak hakaretlerde bulunan bu densiz ve etrafındaki şakşakçılar hakkında derhal yasal işlem başlatılmalıdır. Bu alçak cezalandırılmadığı her saniye toplumun adalete olan güvenini sarsacaktır" dedi. 


Gözaltı kararı


Gelişmelerin ardından AKP'li Mehmet Metiner ikinci bir paylaşım yaparak, Adalet Bakanı Akın Gürlek'in talimatıyla söz konusu şahsın gözaltına alındığını duyurdu.


31 Ağustos'ta Diyarbakır'da oynanan müsabakanın ardından Ergani ilçesinde taraftar otobüslerinden vatandaşlara yönelik saldırılar gerçekleştiği ve stadyumunda büyük çaplı maddi hasar meydana geldiği de basına yansımıştı.

title: İBB Spor Okulları 2026-2027 sezonu başlıyor: Kayıt tarihleri ve branşlar açıklandı
content:
Hasan Can Bilici [email protected]

İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi (İBB) Spor Okulları’nda 2026-2027 sezonu başladı. 3-13 yaş grubundaki çocuklara spor alışkanlığı kazandırmayı hedefleyen program kapsamında 45 tesiste 16 farklı branşta eğitim verilecek. Yeni sezonun ilk dönemi için kayıtlar 2 Eylül’de başladı ve 23 Eylül’e kadar devam edecek.

İBB Gençlik ve Spor Dairesi Başkanlığı ile Spor İstanbul iş birliğinde düzenlenen İBB Spor Okulları’nda eğitimler, ikişer aylık 6 dönem halinde gerçekleştirilecek. Yeni sezonun ilk dersleri 7 Eylül’de başlayacak ve ilk eğitim dönemi 1 Kasım’a kadar sürecek.

İBB Spor Okulları’nın 2026-2027 sezonunda dönemlik kayıt ücreti 300 TL olarak belirlendi.

Kayıt ve kontenjanlarla ilgili ayrıntılı bilgilere Spor İstanbul’un internet sitesi üzerinden ulaşılabilecek.

Yeni sezonda çocuklara farklı yaş gruplarına yönelik 16 branşta eğitim verilecek.

Programda yer alan branşlar ve yaş aralıkları şöyle:

2026-2027 sezonunda İBB Spor Okulları için kayıt ve eğitim dönemleri şöyle:

Dönem Kayıt tarihleri Eğitim dönemi

1. Dönem 2 Eylül - 23 Eylül 2026 7 Eylül - 1 Kasım 2026

2. Dönem 28 Ekim - 18 Kasım 2026 2 Kasım - 27 Aralık 2026

3. Dönem 23 Aralık 2026 - 13 Ocak 2027 28 Aralık 2026 - 21 Şubat 2027

4. Dönem 17 Şubat - 10 Mart 2027 22 Şubat - 18 Nisan 2027

5. Dönem 14 Nisan - 12 Mayıs 2027 19 Nisan - 25 Haziran 2027

6. Dönem 23 Haziran - 25 Ağustos 2027 28 Haziran - 3 Eylül 2027

İBB Spor Okulları’nda temel spor eğitiminin yanı sıra çocukların fiziksel ve motor gelişimlerinin takip edilmesi de hedefleniyor.

Program kapsamında eğitmenler, çocukların güvenli ve sağlıklı bir ortamda spor yapabilmeleri amacıyla Çocuk Koruma Eğitiminden geçiriliyor.

Minik sporcuların fiziksel ve motor gelişimleri, belirli aralıklarla gerçekleştirilen bilimsel testlerle ölçülüyor. Elde edilen sonuçlar doğrultusunda çocuklar için sporcu gelişim karnesi hazırlanırken, yatkın oldukları branşlara yönlendirilmeleri de amaçlanıyor.

İBB Spor Okulları, çocuklara temel spor eğitimi vermenin yanı sıra yeni yeteneklerin keşfedilmesine de katkı sağlamayı hedefliyor.

Branşlarında öne çıkan çocuklar gelişim gruplarına dahil edilerek Gelişim Ligi Finalleri’nde mücadele etme fırsatı buluyor. Kulüp gözlemcilerinin takip ettiği organizasyonlar aracılığıyla başarılı sporcuların profesyonel ve amatör kulüplerin altyapılarına kazandırılması amaçlanıyor.

2026-2027 sezonunun ilk eğitim dönemi için kayıtlar 2 Eylül’de başladı. İlk dönem kayıtları 23 Eylül 2026’da sona erecek.

İlk dersler ise 7 Eylül 2026’da başlayacak ve eğitim dönemi 1 Kasım 2026’ya kadar devam edecek.

İBB Spor Okulları’nın kayıt ve kontenjan bilgilerine Spor İstanbul üzerinden ulaşılabilecek.

title: İzmir’de akıma kapılan 2 kişinin ölümüne ilişkin davada yeni bilirkişi raporu: “Olay tek bir ani hatayla meydana gelmedi”
content:
İzmir — İzmir'de sağanak sırasında sokakta elektrik akımına kapılan İnanç Öktemay (44) ile Özge Ceren Deniz'in (23) ölümüne ilişkin İzmir Bölge Adliye Mahkemesi 14'üncü Ceza Dairesi'nde görülen davada, 3'üncü bilirkişi raporu dosyaya girdi. Raporda, olayın tek bir ani hata sonucu meydana gelmediği, 2015-2024 yılları arasına yayılan bir süreçte oluşan altyapı ve müdahale eksikliklerinin etkili olduğu belirtildi.

Kentte 12 Temmuz 2024'te saat 18.00 sıralarında başlayan sağanak nedeniyle birçok ilçede sokaklar suyla doldu. Sağanaktan korunmak isteyen İzmir Demokrasi Üniversitesi Tıp Fakültesi öğrencisi Özge Ceren Deniz, suyla dolan yolda elektrik akımına kapıldı. Deniz'i kurtarmak isteyen ikinci el eşya satışı işiyle uğraşan İnanç Öktemay da akıma kapılıp, bir anda yığıldı. Deniz ve Öktemay, kaldırıldığı hastanede yaşamını yitirdi. İnanç Öktemay İzmir'de, Özge Ceren Deniz ise Osmaniye'de toprağa verildi. Olayın ardından başlatılan soruşturma kapsamında 42 kişi hakkında 'Taksirle öldürme' suçundan 15'er yıla kadar hapis cezası istendi. Suçun bilinçli taksirle işlenmesi nedeniyle TCK'nın 22/3'ün maddesi gereğince sanıklara verilecek cezanın yarı oranında artırılarak 22 yıl 6'şar aya çıkarılması talep edildi. title: Tarımdan sorumlu Bakan Yumaklı, fidanı plastik saksısıyla gömmeye kalktı
content:
Tarım ve Orman Bakanı İbrahim Yumaklı, 31 Ağustos'ta Aydın'da bulunan İncir Araştırma Enstitüsü Müdürlüğü bahçesinde düzenlenen fidan dikim etkinliğine katılmıştı. Tarımdan sorumlu Bakan Yumaklı, buradaki dikim sırasında dikkat çeken bir hataya imza attı.

Sözcü'den Berfin Açıkbaş'ın haberine göre, çukura yerleştirdiği fidan için "Böylece Aydın'da bir dikili ağacım olmuş oldu" ifadelerini kullanan Tarımdan sorumlu Bakan Yumaklı'nın dikim işlemi sırasındaki acemiliği gözlerden kaçmadı. Yumaklı, elindeki fidanı köklerini saran plastik saksısından çıkarmadan, doğrudan açılan çukura koyarak toprağa gömmeye çalıştı. O anlara tanıklık eden yurttaşlar duruma hemen müdahale etti. Etraftakilerden birinin olayı fark edip uyarıda bulunmasıyla hata son anda düzeltildi ve fidan saksısından çıkarılarak usulüne uygun şekilde toprakla buluşturuldu.

Etkinlik sırasında Yumaklı'ya CHP'den AKP'ye geçen Aydın Büyükşehir Belediye Başkanı Özlem Çerçioğlu da eşlik etmişti.

title: Alîgirê Trabzonsporê yê nijadperest hat desteserkirin
content:
Di 31ê Tebaxê de Amedsporê di hefteya sêyemîn a Lîga Super de mazûvaniya Trabzonsporê kir û 2-1 bi ser ket.


Piştî maçê alîgirên Trabzonsporê bi otobusan ber bi bajarê xwe ve bi rê ketin. Kesekî di nav otobusê de heqaretê li Kurdan dike û li dijî Kurdan gotinên nijadperest bikar tîne.


Wî nijadperestî di axaftina xwe ya di nav otobusê de weha gotibû:


"Kurdê herî baş ew e ku bimire û bikeve gorê. Li hev kom dibin û bi Kurdî diaxivin, divê hûn nedin axaftin. Hûn dê rehmê li wan nekin, hûn dê bi pehînan li wan bixin."


Belavbûna van dîmenan a li ser medyaya civakî di demeke kurt de bû sedema bertekên mezin.


Komeleya Hiqûqnasan a Amedsporê ji ber van gotinên qirêj û nijadperest ên li dijî Kurdan giliyê wî alîgirê Trabzonsporê kir.


Piştî bertekên tund ên li ser medyaya civakî, ew provokatorê nijadperest hat desteserkirin.

title: Amedspor maçı sonrası nefret söylemlerinde bulunan şahıs gözaltına alındı
content:
Süper Lig’in 3'üncü haftasında Diyarbakır’da oynanan ve Amedspor’un Trabzonspor’u 2-1 mağlup ettiği müsabakanın ardından yaşanan nefret söylemi skandalında yeni bir gelişme yaşandı.

Maç çıkışı Trabzon taraftarlarını taşıyan otobüste çekilen ve sosyal medyada tepkilere neden olan görüntülerdeki nefret söyleminde bulunan şahıs gözaltına alındı.

Sosyal medyaya yansıyan videoda söz konusu şahsın Kürt yurttaşlara yönelik, "Kürtlerin en iyisi ölüp mezara girendir. Toplanıp Kürtçe konuşuyorlar, konuşturmayacaksın. Bunlara acımayacaksın, tekmeyi vuracaksın" şeklindeki ifadeler büyük tepki topladı.

Amedspor-Trabzonspor maçında yaşananlar Meclis gündeminde

Görüntülerin yayılmasının ardından Amedsporlu Hukukçular Derneği suç duyurusunda bulunurken, AKP ve HÜDA PAR'dan da tepki açıklamaları geldi.

AKP'li Mehmet Metiner, "'En iyi Kürt ölü Kürt’tür!' diyebilecek kadar nefret kusan bir ırkçı zihin hem akidemiz, hem devletimizin bekası hem de toplumsal barışımız için çok ciddi bir tehdittir. Bu düpedüz bir ağır suçtur" diyerek soruşturma açılması çağrısında bulundu.

HÜDA PAR Milletvekili Faruk Dinç de "Kürt halkına yönelik ağza alınmayacak hakaretlerde bulunan bu densiz ve etrafındaki şakşakçılar hakkında derhal yasal işlem başlatılmalıdır. Bu alçak cezalandırılmadığı her saniye toplumun adalete olan güvenini sarsacaktır" dedi.

Trabzonspor taraftarlarını taşıyan otobüse taşlı saldırı: 7 kişi gözaltına alındı

Gelişmelerin ardından AKP'li Mehmet Metiner ikinci bir paylaşım yaparak, Adalet Bakanı Akın Gürlek'in talimatıyla söz konusu şahsın gözaltına alındığını duyurdu.

31 Ağustos'ta Diyarbakır'da oynanan müsabakanın ardından Ergani ilçesinde taraftar otobüslerinden vatandaşlara yönelik saldırılar gerçekleştiği ve stadyumunda büyük çaplı maddi hasar meydana geldiği de basına yansımıştı.

author: anred
title: ¿La Libertad Avanza? Un balance marxista a casi tres años de la presidencia de Milei
content:
Javier Milei y Luis Caputo | Agencia Na


Para consolidar una hegemonía política duradera, cualquier gobierno necesita garantizar un ciclo de crecimiento económico de mediano plazo. A casi tres años de gestión de Javier Milei, el gran dilema radica justamente en la forma que asume ese crecimiento y las importantes dificultades que tiene el gobierno libertario para establecer un consenso social de largo plazo. La desaceleración de la inflación fue y es el objetivo central del gobierno, y fue avanzando hacia dicho objetivo a costa de un severo de ajuste fiscal, apertura comercial, tipo de cambio pisado, tasas de interés reales positivas y techos paritarios. Sin embargo, este esquema consolidó una economía dual: mientras sectores que ocupan poca mano de obra como el agro, la energía, la minería y las finanzas empujan un tenue crecimiento general, la economía orientada al mercado interno (aquella que ocupa gente) cae fuerte.

Por Cristian Caracoche.


El ajuste impactó de manera directa en el mundo del trabajo y licuó los salarios reales. Si tomamos los datos del INDEC, se observa una baja del 4% en el salario privado registrado y una pérdida del 17% en el sector público. No obstante, la caída sería mayor si se utilizara el IPC 2018 (que Milei descartó) para medir el verdadero costo de vida.


En relación a la ocupación, se destruyeron más de 300 mil puestos de trabajo privado registrado y cerraron más de 27 mil empresas privadas. La degradación laboral no solo empujó la tasa de asalariados informales al 37,9%, sino que disparó del 12,5% al 15,3% la suma de desocupados y subocupados demandantes.


En tanto que la burguesía (como clase) se muestra ganadora del mileismo (ya que obtiene cierta estabilidad para su acumulación a la par que el gobierno disciplina a la clase trabajadora), aparecen entre los heridos del modelo las fracciones mercado internistas del empresariado, lo que empieza a generar fisuras entre el capital. Frente a esto, la clase trabajadora no solo pierde salario y ocupación, sino que también caen fuerte las condiciones laborales.


Ante a esta situación, el escenario social presenta una llamativa parálisis de la protesta, registrándose un retroceso en los conflictos laborales y una baja sostenida en los piquetes. No obstante, este apaciguamiento no implica un consenso social ya cerrado, ya que aparece una resistencia pasiva que se procesa puertas adentro, y que se expresa en la sostenida tendencia a la baja del Índice de Confianza en el Gobierno (ICG).


Todo esto deja una gran incógnita a mediano plazo (la cual se empezará a develar en la elección presidencial de 2027): si la sociedad tolerará pasivamente esta transición histórica hacia una Argentina primarizada y con una fuerza de trabajo débil y precarizada, o si aquellas resistencias pondrán un límite a esta transición (y de poner ese límite, cual será la configuración resultante).

title: Since ‘two sides shouting about rocky horror without listening to each other’ seems to be a thing…
content:
Since ‘two sides shouting about rocky horror without listening to each other’ seems to be a thing again in queer circles, here’s two things that would help run this conversation more smoothly:

If you love rocky horror:

 don’t change the facts of the script to back up your views. Most importantly: admit that Dr. Frank-N-Furter rapes Brad and Janet in the 'bedroom scenes’. Pretending to be someone’s partner to get in their pants is rape, period. Dr. Frank-N-Furter isn’t meant to be a moral character. He murders and cooks a guy. Movies about immoral queer characters can still be good movies. Defend the movie based on those facts.

If you hate rocky horror:

 don’t change the facts of the script to back up your views. Most importantly: Don’t call Dr. Frank-N-Furter a trans woman. He’s clearly not. He self-identifies as a transvestite. He uses he/him pronouns and the honorary 'master’. Dr. Frank-N-Furter is 'from the planet Transsexual’, sure, but so are plenty of other characters. That doesn’t make him a trans woman. You can still view the depiction of  Dr. Frank-N-Furter as transmisogynist. A portrayal of a transvestite can be transmisogynist. Condemn the movie based on those facts.

And both sides:

don’t pretend that the people who agree with you are one demographic and the people who disagree with you are another.

People who hate rocky horror aren’t ’ allprudish anti-sex gen z’s’.

People who love rocky horror aren’t 'exclusively TME’.

You’ve got a much better chance of actually understanding each other better if you stick to the facts of the script and stick to your arguments about the movie (and its history) instead of characterizations of the people who disagree with you.

title: Tödliche Waldbrandsaison 2026 in Frankreich: Feuerwehrleute am Limit – ein Beruf am Ende seiner Kräfte
content:
Dossier


„

Seit Beginn des Sommers sind drei Kollegen im Einsatz ums Leben gekommen. Vor Ort macht sich in den Feuerwachen zunehmende Erschöpfung breit, während die Behörden selbst mittlerweile das beispiellose Ausmaß der Krise anerkennen. Die CFDT SDIS weist darauf hin, dass Würdigungen nicht mehr ausreichen: Es werden Mittel benötigt. Zwei 34-jährige Feuerwehrleute sind am 21. Juli ums Leben gekommen, als sie bei der Bekämpfung eines besonders heftigen Kiefernwaldbrands in der Nähe des Flughafens von Bordeaux in ihrem Tankwagen eingeschlossen wurden. Ein dritter Kollege ist seit Beginn des Sommers ums Leben gekommen. Im Zuge dieser erneuten Tragödie haben sich sowohl Berufs- als auch Freiwillige Feuerwehrleute in der Presse zu Wort gemeldet: Erschöpfung, Personalmangel, unzureichende Ausrüstung

…“ franz.

Meldung der Cfdt Sdis (Feuerwehr- und Rettungsdienste) vom 24. Juli 2026


 (maschinenübersetzt) mit Video – siehe mehr zum gar nicht so neuen Problem:


Genug der Versprechungen, wir wollen Taten! Feuerwehrgewerkschaften kündigen landesweite Proteste einschließlich Streiks vom 8. September bis zum 20. Oktober an


„

Waldbrände, Naturkatastrophen, steigende Einsatzanforderungen, Personalmangel und eine Finanzlage der Feuerwehr- und Rettungsdienste, die am Rande des Zusammenbruchs steht: Nach einem besonders anstrengenden Sommer 2026 erwarten die Mitarbeiter der Feuerwehr- und Rettungsdienste nun mehr als nur Versprechungen.


Vom 8. September bis zum 20. Oktober 2026 ruft der Gewerkschaftsverbund zur Mobilisierung auf.


Für Sébastien Bouvier, CFDT-Bundessekretär mit Zuständigkeit für die Feuerwehr- und Rettungsdienste, ist diese Mobilisierung notwendig geworden: „Das ist die einzige Möglichkeit, die wir haben, um uns Gehör zu verschaffen.“ (…)


Eine landesweite Streikankündigung vom 8. September bis zum 20. Oktober


Der Gewerkschaftsverband der Mitarbeiter der Feuerwehr- und Rettungsdienste hat daher beim Innenminister eine Streikankündigung eingereicht, die sich auf das gesamte Personal der SIS bezieht, unabhängig von deren Status, Laufbahn, Beschäftigungsgruppe oder Dienstgrad. Die Ankündigung gilt für den Zeitraum vom 8. September bis einschließlich 20. Oktober 2026, jeweils von 0:00 Uhr bis 23:59 Uhr.


Sie ermöglicht jede Form des Protests, einschließlich der Arbeitsniederlegung.


Ziel ist es, konkrete Zusagen in drei wesentlichen Bereichen zu erreichen: dem Gesetz zur Modernisierung des Zivilschutzes, dem Haushaltsgesetz für 2027 und einer Vereinbarung über Gesundheit, Sicherheit und den Berufsfeuerwehrdienst

…“ franz.

Meldung der Cfdt Sdis (Feuerwehr- und Rettungsdienste) vom 28.8.2026


 (maschinenübersetzt). Siehe auch:


Die Wut der Feuerwehrleute


„

Frankreich brennt. Doch Präsident Emmanuel Macron brettert mit dem Jet-Ski über die Wellen. Jetzt regt sich Widerstand.


29 Tage kämpften 1000 Feuerwehrleute bis zur Erschöpfung, um die Dörfer der Provence zwischen Aix und Draguignan vor den Flammen zu retten. Das gelang nicht überall, und sie riskierten dabei Kopf und Kragen: In einem kritischen Moment umzingelte springendes Feuer rund vier Dutzend der roten Camions und ihre Crews. Ein Wasserbombardement aus der Luft rettete sie in letzter Minute.


Präsident Brumm-Brumm


Derweil raste Präsident Emmanuel Macron in Geruchweite der Brandschwaden mit einem Jet-Ski-Boliden über die Wellen des Mittelmeers, in Macho-Pose und Pilotenlook, für ein Foto auf der Titelseite von «Paris Match». Diese Maschinen verbrennen 60 bis 80 Liter Sprit pro Stunde. Macron liebt solche Provokationen. Wir Erfolgreiche, signalisiert er damit, machen, was immer wir wollen. Auch wenn wir damit die Welt in Brand setzen. (…)


Ihrem Zorn lautstark Luft machen die erschöpften Feuerwehrleute. Vier von ihnen sind in den Bränden umgekommen. Die 250 ’000 Pompiers Frankreichs (20 Prozent Frauen) sind in neun Gewerkschaften organisiert. Zum ersten Mal haben sie sich jetzt zusammengerauft. Per Warnstreik erzwangen sie eine Aussprache mit der Regierung am 13.  August. Sie kamen mit einem dicken Pack Beschwerden: Zu wenig Personal. Keine sichere Schutzkleidung. Fehlende Löschfahrzeuge, obschon die Grossbrände (mehr als 30 Hektaren) in 20 Jahren um 3000 Prozent zugenommen haben. Sozialdumping: Profi-Retterinnen, die im Süden helfen wollten, wurden angehalten, Ferien zu nehmen und sich als «Freiwllige» zu melden. Denn die kosten nur 7 Franken die Stunde (ein Gewerkschafter: «Und dafür sollen wir unser Leben riskieren?»).


Vor allem …

author: Andrés
title: Ante el derrame de violencia libertaria, oponemos organización
content:
Las palabras sientan las bases para la acción: señalan, amplían y preparan el campo. El poder despliega su discurso para tantear. Luego espera y observa. Si no hay oposición, avanza. Las prácticas de la actual gestión no se diferencian en nada de las tácticas más primitivas para perpetrar el poder: “entonces usted tiene terroristas disfrazados de estudiantes, terroristas disfrazados de periodistas, terroristas disfrazados de profesores, terroristas disfrazados de investigadores”, vocifera Milei en entrevista con Majul (2/08/26). ¿Y qué hace el periodista? Servil como de costumbre, esquiva la repregunta y, por supuesto, ni se le ocurre mencionar que esa fue la hipótesis que la dictadura esgrimió para hacer lo que hizo. ¿Y qué decir del cierre de la sala de prensa de Casa Rosada el pasado 23 de abril y durante 10 días, luego de lo cual quedó la llave en manos de la Casa Militar? ¿Y qué del acoso que los colegas reciben allí, ahora que los revisan y le han esmerilado ventanas para que no puedan ver? ¿O qué decir del modo en que encontraron la sala el lunes 31 de agosto, con cajones revueltos y algunos objetos robados? ¿Y qué de la violencia desplegada por las fuerzas en la calle contra los periodistas en cada manifestación? Los insultos, las agresiones verbales, los epítetos, las patadas, los palos, los gases y el hidrante no son desbordes; no son hechos aislados. Cada arma que acciona una institución depende de órdenes tomadas y ratificadas con firmas, en oficinas y despachos. Las amenazas y mensajes intimidatorios que vienen recibiendo los fotorreporteros en redes no escapan a este círculo vicioso en el cual pensar distinto te convierte en adversario y por lo tanto en enemigo al que hay que destruir. La forma siempre es parte del fondo, parte del mensaje. Porque toda violencia es política. Este miércoles 02/09 a las 16, todos al Congreso.

Por Andrés Manrique (ANRed).

author: Unknown
title: Défendons Autistici/Inventati avant le 25 septembre
content:
Les États-Unis attaquent Autistici/Inventati (un équivalent italien de Riseup et hébergeur de noblogs.org) en les qualifiant d'organisation terroriste internationale.


Ce 26 août 2026, l'administration des États-Unis d'Amérique a désigné comme terroriste l'association en charge des serveurs informatiques Autistici/Inventati (A/I). Derrière ce nom, ce sont 25 ans de mémoire et d'outils des luttes sociales, d'autogestion numérique qui se voient attaquées.


A/I, c'est un peu le Riseup italien. Iels hébergent des milliers de boite mails, listes mails ainsi que tous les sites en .noblogs.org. Des milliers de comptes, services et sites webs militants se voient donc censurés ou menacés. Cette décision, dont les premières conséquences commencent à apparaître, sera pleinement effective le 25 septembre 2026. D'ici-là, la communauté hacker internationale appelle à une large mobilisation de solidarité antifasciste pour la défense de nos infrastructures et pour l'autonomie de nos réseaux numériques alternatifs.


Paranoia

, la première machine de ce qui deviendra plus tard A/I, est née à Milan (Italie) en 2001, dans un contexte foisonnant de luttes sociales et d'expérimentations technologiques populaires entremêlées. Cette initiative antifasciste, anticapitaliste et antimilitariste, reposant sur des logiciels libres et maniant la cryptographie comme technique d'autodéfense numérique, s'est poursuivie par l'installation de toute une infrastructure visant à garantir le pseudonymat et la libre circulation des informations, de la connaissance et de la culture.


Là où les prestataires de services en ligne commerciaux utilisent l'argent comme barrière d'entrée, A/I fait partie de ces collectifs qui conditionnent l'utilisation de leurs services à un critère d'affinité politique. Sous cette condition, la liberté d'expression permise au travers de cette infrastructure n'a cependant jamais garanti de responsabilité collective à l'égard de toutes les publications ou communications qui y circulent. Et pourtant, l'administration états-unienne justifie aujourd'hui la censure de l'intégralité des services d'A/I dans un excès de zèle fasciste qu'on lui connaît particulièrement de nos jours.


Depuis 2001 et jusqu'à la catastrophe que représente cette dernière actualité, l'histoire d'A/I est émaillée de plusieurs événements parfois rocambolesques, mettant en lumière toute l'ironie et l'absurdité des institutions politiques et du capitalisme de surveillance. Lors de l'affaire

Trenitalia

, A/I avait créé un site web satirique pour dénoncer le transport d'équipements militaires pour l'invasion états-unienne de l'Irak en 2003. En 2005, une enquête contre une cellule italienne de l'

Anarchist Black Cross

, dont les emails étaient hébergés par A/I, a révélé l'installation clandestine d'un dispositif de surveillance du serveur.


À la suite de cette affaire, le collectif a initié un chantier titanesque de mesures anti-répression de l'infrastructure, le plan R*. Un plan qui permit en 2007 aux serveurs de résister aux tentatives de censure d'un jeu-vidéo dénonçant la pédocriminalité au sein de l'Église catholique. Puis en 2010, c'est face à la police norvégienne, en complicité avec une cour de Justice italienne, que le plan R* s'est montré efficace pour permettre la survie de l'infrastructure grâce à plusieurs relais à travers le monde.


Toutes ces attaques et perquisitions ayant exposé des milliers de boîtes mail, A/I a toujours insisté sur la nécessité d'une prudence à l'égard de sa propre confidentialité. Aucune infrastructure numérique ne sera jamais indemne de vulnérabilité, à l'instar des humains eux-mêmes. Pourtant, on peut retenir que la participation du collectif aux luttes sociales a notamment permis au mouvement Indymedia de naître, à partir des mobilisations contre le G8 de Gênes. Elle a également permis à d'innombrables mailing-lists d'émerger et à des dizaines d'ateliers et discussions à travers le monde de diffuser les savoir-faires d'autodéfense numérique et les expériences du collectif à d'autres communautés en lutte.


De fait, A/I fait aujourd'hui partie des collectifs de référence dans les communautés hacker anti-autoritaires et internationalistes, tant pour tout son historique et l'exigence technique acquise que pour son approche anti-élitiste qui permet à toustes d'utiliser ses services et d'apprendre à les répliquer ailleurs. Il est donc urgent de se mobiliser, avant le 25 septembre, en défense d'A/I, de plusieurs …

author: Unknown
title: L’effetto isola di calore dei data center
content:
The data heat island effect: quantifying the impact of AI data centers in a warming world

 di Andrea Marinoni, Pietro Lio’, Erik Cambria, Luca Dal Zilio, Weisi Lin, Mauro Dalla Mura, Jocelyn Chanussot, Edoardo Ragusa, Gianmarco Mengaldo, Chi Yan Tso, Yihao Zhu, Benjamin Horton

marzo 2026 – 13 pp.


Ripubblichiamo i risultati di questo lavoro di ricerca utile per approfondire il tema dei data center e analizzarne uno degli impatti quale le isole di calore, il contributo è stato ripreso da

la Bottega del Barbieri

.


Abstract


ll forte e continuo aumento dei servizi basati sull’intelligenza artificiale (IA) porta alla costante proliferazione dei data center dedicati all’IA in tutto il mondo, con l’inevitabile aumento del loro consumo energetico. Non è ancora chiaro quale impatto avrà questa domanda energetica a fini computazionali sull’ambiente circostante.

In questo articolo concentriamo la nostra attenzione sulla dissipazione del calore generata dagli hyperscaler [le grandi compagnie dei cloud,] dell’IA. Sfruttando le misurazioni della temperatura della superficie terrestre acquisite dalle piattaforme di telerilevamento negli ultimi decenni, siamo in grado di ottenere una valutazione attendibile dell’aumento di temperatura registrato nelle aree circostanti i data center di IA a livello globale.

Stimiamo che la temperatura della superficie terrestre aumenti in media di 2 °C dopo l’avvio delle operazioni di un data center di IA, determinando la formazione di zone microclimatiche locali, che chiamiamo «effetto isola di calore dei dati». Valutiamo l’impatto sulle comunità, quantificando che oltre 340 milioni di persone potrebbero essere colpite da questo aumento di temperatura. I nostri risultati mostrano che l’effetto “isola di calore dei dati” potrebbe avere un’influenza notevole sulle comunità e sul benessere regionale in futuro, entrando così a far parte del dibattito sull’IA ambientalmente sostenibile a livello mondiale.


Introduzione


Nel valutare l’impatto delle attività antropiche sui cambiamenti climatici e sul riscaldamento globale negli ultimi decenni, l’effetto “isola di calore urbana” (urban heat island, UHI) riveste un ruolo fondamentale. L’UHI deriva dalla concentrazione delle attività industriali e dall’uso massiccio di materiali da costruzione sintetici, nonché dal notevole aumento del consumo energetico nelle aree urbane densamente popolate.

Quando si discute degli effetti dell’UHI, è fondamentale considerare l’impatto che questi hanno sulle comunità locali e sul benessere regionale. A questo riguardo, è stato studiato e dimostrato in che modo l’UHI influirebbe sull’assistenza sanitaria, sul consumo energetico, sulla qualità dell’aria e sulla qualità dell’acqua. È quindi cruciale comprenderne le cause.


Nello specifico, i principali fattori che determinano l’UHI sono classificati in base alla geometria degli spazi antropici (ad esempio, i “canyon urbani” determinano la concentrazione di particolato); alla mancanza di vegetazione e di corpi idrici; alla generazione di inquinanti atmosferici e di vapore acqueo; alla ritenzione di calore ed agli edifici a basso albedo.

Oltre a queste categorie, il tipo di attività umane insediate e operative influenza in modo determinante l’impatto dell’UHI sull’ambiente e sulle comunità. Queste attività antropiche sono caratterizzate dalla loro concentrazione spaziale, dalla tipologia funzionale (ad esempio, residenziale, industriale), dai requisiti di raffreddamento, dalle fonti di combustibile e dall’efficienza termica.

Con i volumi globali di dati in rapida crescita, si prevede che i data center rappresenteranno una delle attività con il maggior consumo energetico nel prossimo decennio. Infatti, è stato stimato che tra 3 e 5 anni il consumo energetico per l’elaborazione dei dati supererà quello previsto per il settore manifatturiero.

Di conseguenza, è lecito prevedere che l’impatto delle attività dei data center e degli hyperscaler dell’intelligenza artificiale sul clima potrebbe non essere trascurabile, ed essere addirittura ulteriormente aggravato dall’uso dell’intelligenza artificiale nei prossimi decenni.


Nei fatti, la stragrande maggioranza dei data center dedicati all’IA si affida all’uso di combustibili fossili. Pertanto, la forte crescita dell’addestramento e dell’utilizzo dell’IA per varie applicazioni si tradurrebbe direttamente in un elevato impatto netto sulle emissioni. Inoltre, le inefficienze e le imperfezioni delle operazioni degli …

author: Unknown
title: Autistici sotto attacco!
content:
Il 26 agosto 

il segretario di Stato Marco Rubio 

ha annunciato di aver deciso di applicare sanzioni antiterrorismo nei confronti del 

collettivo Autistici/Inventati, 

che ha sede in Italia.


da

Radio Blackout


La legge federale americana conferisce al Dipartimento del Tesoro ampia discrezionalità nell’attribuire l’etichetta di “organizzazione terroristica” a gruppi stranieri. Nel medesimo pacchetto di misure restrittive, applicate nell’ambito di una strategia più ampia contro il dissenso radicale, oltre ad A/I rientrano sigle internazionali come Palestine Action e Masar Badil. La base legale è 

l’Executive Order 13224

, firmato dopo l’11 settembre 2001, che consente di colpire chiunque abbia “materialmente assistito, sponsorizzato o fornito supporto finanziario, materiale o tecnologico” a un atto di terrorismo. 

La formula “supporto tecnologico” è il perno di tutta la vicenda

, perché è quella che permette di trattare un provider di servizi come un fiancheggiatore.


La pratica di designare una piattaforma Internet e un fornitore di servizi come gruppo terroristico ha implicazioni “enormi” per il futuro della libertà di espressione su Internet, ed è per questo che

 è importante supportare il collettivo A/I.


Il dipartimento di stato Usa ha dato un mese di tempo a privati e imprese statunitensi per rompere i rapporti con il collettivo Autistici/Inventati accusato di terrorismo. Ma, 

a sole ventiquattr’ore dal provvedimento, le caselle mail ospitate da A/I e i blog noblogs non erano raggiungibili

. Tutta colpa del Public Interest Registry (Pir), l’ente che da Washington governa l’accessibilità ai domini «.org» utilizzati abitualmente da gruppi e associazioni no profit. Il Pir ha voluto obbedire per primo all’ordine di Trump e Rubio rendendo irraggiungibile il server. 

In una mezza giornata, lx tecnicx del collettivo hanno rimediato al problema. I dati sono stati trasferiti a un altro indirizzo web, lx utenti di autistici.org hanno recuperato le loro email e i blog sono tornati visibili su .noblogs.org

.


Ne abbiamo parlato con un compagno dell’Hacklab torinese. Ascolta l’approfondimento.


Pubblichiamo quanto condiviso direttamente da A/I rispetto all’uso delle caselle mail:


Se hai un indirizzo @autistici.org

 stiamo lavorando per trasferire la tua casella su un nuovo dominio (su questo seguiranno presto aggiornamenti!). Nel frattempo non potrai inviare o ricevere nuove mail, ma potrai comunque accedere al tuo account. Una volta dentro, troverai tutto il tuo archivio di posta.


Se hai un indirizzo di posta sui nostri server con qualsiasi altro dominio

, puoi nuovamente accedere alla tua casella e spedire e ricevere mail usando la webmail o il tuo solito client di posta.


Per accedere alla webmail, apri la nostra home all’indirizzo 

https://www.inventati.org

 e clicca Login in alto a sinistra. Poi inserisci il tuo nome utente e la tua password per accedere al tuo account.


Se preferisci usare un client di posta (per esempio Thunderbird), non devi fare altro che cambiare l’indirizzo del server da mail.autistici.org a mail.inventati.org (per la posta in entrata) e da smtp.autistici.org a smtp.inventati.org (per la posta in uscita). A quel punto potrai usare il tuo account email come al solito.


Stiamo cercando di fare del nostro meglio per sopravvivere a questa apocalisse. Tieni duro e abbi fiducia! Continueremo a pubblicare aggiornamenti via via che ne abbiamo.


Per rimanere aggiornatx, e approfondire, consigliamo di controllare le seguenti pagine:

Sito: 

https://inventati.org

 (dove trovate una trovate una spiegazione completa della vicenda, e i comunicati e la solidarietà espressa)

Blog: 

https://cavallette.noblogs.org

Social: 

https://mastodon.bida.im/@cavallette

link per scaricare “+KAOS”,

diretta e gli approfondimenti dedicati alla vicenda da 

Radio Onda d’Urto

 e 

Radio Onda Rossa

, e dal 

Ponte Radio

author: Shams Eddin Essam
title: Future of Egypt to take over subsidized fertilizer system
content:
Management of the subsidized fertilizer system in five governorates has been handed over to the Future of Egypt for Sustainable Development Authority, paving way for the authority to take over the system nationwide starting in October and changing the way that farming is organized in the country, an official in the cooperatives sector of the Agriculture Ministry told Mada Masr. He added that farming cooperatives, which play a key role in the distribution system, “will largely disappear from the scene in the coming years.” 


Fertilizer management adds a new portfolio to a set of national supply and distribution activities, previously managed by various state entities, that the

Future of Egypt

 authority has acquired in recent years.


Since the beginning of August, Future of Egypt has been responsible for managing the delivery of fertilizer from factories to agricultural associations in villages across Daqahlia, Sharqiya, Beheira, Port Said and Ismailia. It has also been given full responsibility for the distribution of fertilizer allocations for crops, checking them against agricultural census records, the official said.


“Starting with five governorates serves as a trial that will be rolled out across the rest from October,” the official said, which “means cooperatives will largely disappear from the agricultural scene in the coming years,” explaining that cooperatives’ main role was to organize and coordinate the fertilizer portfolio, delivering products in coordination with the Agriculture Ministry from fertilizer factories to the village-level agricultural associations that deal directly with farmers.


The move expands Future of Egypt’s role in fertilizer distribution. In July, the authority

began

managing part of the supply of unsubsidized fertilizer in cooperation with agricultural cooperatives. Under that arrangement, Future of Egypt procures fertilizer from manufacturers and supplies it to the cooperatives, which sell it to farmers on its behalf at prices the authority has set — currently below market rates. A sack of unsubsidized urea is sold for LE1,000 and ammonium nitrate for LE975, compared with the open-market rates of between LE1,400 and LE1,600 per sack.


Agricultural association managers and ministry sources who spoke to Mada Masr acknowledged that corruption is widespread in the fertilizer distribution system and described the authority’s takeover as aiming to tighten oversight and control. But they also pointed out that the change leaves intact the structure that allows such corruption to occur. It is therefore likely to continue, they said, albeit under new management.


Agricultural associations are responsible for distributing government-subsidized fertilizer to farmers under a decades-old scheme backed by the Agriculture Ministry.


Under the scheme, associations in each village survey all farmland and the crops being grown. Those figures are then used to determine the amount of fertilizer needed, which is supplied through the cooperatives operating under the Agriculture Ministry’s branch of the General Cooperatives Federation.


The new system under Future of Egypt effectively replaces the cooperatives federation in supplying fertilizer, as well as taking over the distribution function handled by agricultural associations. The associations will continue to conduct the agricultural surveys.


The main agricultural administration in each of the five governorates has instructed village-level agricultural associations to survey their fertilizer stocks and record the capacity of all their warehouses, a manager of one of Beheira’s associations told Mada Masr. The administration has informed them that Future of Egypt will assume overall responsibility for the fertilizer portfolio from October, they said.


The trial began in Beheira at the start of August, the manager said. Associations were grouped around centralized distribution points, replacing the previous system in which each association had its own distribution warehouse. Associations with larger storage facilities will be selected to serve as storage and distribution centers, with fertilizer allocated to farmers according to the surveys conducted by the associations themselves, with Future of Egypt-appointed personnel handling the distribution, the manager explained.

author: Unknown
title: Release of prisoner Gülşen Adet postponed for sixth time
content:
The release of Gülşen Adet, who has been imprisoned in Sincan Women’s Closed Prison for 32 years, has been postponed for the sixth time by the Administration and Observation Board. Adet, whose release has been blocked since 2024, will remain in prison for another year. Her next review by the Administration and Observation Board has been scheduled for 26 August 2027.


Her sister, Nuriye Adet, who has also been imprisoned for 32 years and is being held in Sincan Prison, had her release postponed for another year for the sixth time on 19 August.

author: Unknown
title: Taşdemir: Women’s participation in democratic politics is essential
content:
Politician Dilan Dirayet Taşdemir said that the struggle of the Kurdish Women’s Movement in Turkey and Kurdistan has overturned conventional patterns of politics, stressing that genuine local democracy cannot exist in a system where women are excluded from decision-making mechanisms. The experience of the Kurdish Women’s Movement has brought questions of class and social transformation to the fore. Dilan Taşdemir, a sociologist, Kurdish women’s movement activist and former member of parliament for the Peoples’ Democratic Party (HDP), spoke to ANF about the co-chair system, equal representation and debates surrounding local autonomy.


You have been involved for many years in both local and national politics in Turkey, as well as in women’s organising. Based on this experience, do you think local democracy is possible without equal representation of women? If so, how? If not, why not?


As the Kurdish Women’s Movement, we seek to transform the existing position of women in Turkey and Kurdistan and ensure their equal participation in politics. We define the women’s question as a question of freedom; therefore, the question of women’s freedom is, in one sense, a question of participation. In other words, it concerns women’s participation in decision-making mechanisms and the extent to which they have a say, are effective and can act as a transformative force in decisions concerning their own living spaces.


In this context, women’s participation in democratic politics and, more broadly, in every sphere of life is both a serious challenge and a fundamental necessity. Unfortunately, women face similar problems across the world. Nowhere in the world have women yet achieved full and equal participation or inclusion in politics, economic life and society as a whole.


Turkey’s prevailing political culture, mindset and practices place men, the wealthy, and certain religious and identity groups at the centre. For this reason, women’s participation in politics, their ability to articulate their own voice and to become a transformative force pose a serious challenge to the established political order in Turkey. This has also become a major field of struggle within our own political tradition.


Although women make up half of the world’s population, they remain excluded from decision-making mechanisms, are unable to participate equally in economic life and do not enjoy equal opportunities. Budgeting processes are not shaped around women’s demands and needs. Women produce and contribute their labour, yet we are confronted with a social order in which they do not benefit equally from what they produce and do not have an equal say.


This social reality, in which women are excluded, has created a landscape where wars, massacres and injustice are deepening. If we are to make the world equal and just again, that process can only begin with the participation of women. We set out with this driving force. Although we have made significant progress, we still have a long way to go.


The Kurdish Women’s Movement succeeded in introducing women’s quotas and the co-chair system in both local administrations and political parties. In terms of the co-chair system and women’s equal representation, what have local and central administrations gained from this process?


There is a long history of immense effort and struggle behind the fact that women’s co-chairmanship and equal representation are being discussed today. Women did not gain these rights overnight; they are the result of 40 to 50 years of struggle marked by tremendous sacrifices. Thousands of women contributed to the journey from the demand for a 40 per cent quota in the 1990s to equal representation today. Women were imprisoned, lost their lives and were forced into exile for this cause. Despite all the difficulties and repression, the women’s movement continued to grow and transform.


Women’s participation in local government has not simply been a matter of representation; it has also brought about a transformation in the social mindset. In the early days of the co-chair system, we went through a period when, out in the community, the man was seen as the mayor and the woman as his deputy, or when the prevailing attitude was, ‘Can women govern too?’ Over time, the idea that women can engage in politics, make decisions and take the lead became rooted in society.


This transformation affected not only Kurdish society but Turkish politics as a whole. Our co-chair system and …

title: Kurt: Families unable to mourn before now ask to hold condolences
content:
Commemoration and condolence gatherings continue across Turkey and Kurdistan for guerrillas who lost their lives at different times and in different places during the Kurdish freedom struggle. The gatherings are being organised under the leadership of the Association for Assistance, Solidarity, Unity and Culture for Families Who Lost Relatives in the Cradle of Civilisations (MEBYA-DER).


Commemoration and condolence gatherings that began in Istanbul on 22 August are continuing in different districts of the city. Thousands of people have attended the gatherings to offer their condolences to the families of those who lost their lives in the freedom struggle.


MEBYA-DER Co-chair Ilhami Kurt spoke to ANF about the condolence gatherings in Istanbul and the public response.


Our condolence gatherings continue across the districts


Kurt said the condolence gatherings in Istanbul began on 22 August and were subsequently organised in different areas in response to requests from families. He added: “First of all, I offer my condolences to the entire Kurdish people and their friends. On Sunday, 22 August, a condolence and commemoration gathering was held in Sancaktepe for 19 of our comrades. On the same day, a commemoration was held simultaneously in Bağcılar for 22 of our comrades. Following the commemorations, families approached us with requests to hold condolence gatherings. We are therefore organising them in each area in line with requests from the districts. In some places they are held for four people, in others for two. Our condolence gatherings are currently continuing across all our districts.”


We support our families


Kurt said that following the condolence gatherings for the recently announced fallen guerrillas, families of guerrillas who lost their lives particularly in the 1990s had also approached MEBYA-DER. Many of these families had been unable to hold condolence gatherings at the time because of the conditions they faced.


Kurt also said: “The condolence gatherings will continue. Families who were unable to hold them in 1993 or 1994, when conditions were difficult, are now asking to do so. The families want to hold condolence gatherings for their loved ones. As MEBYA-DER, we support families in organising them. These gatherings will continue.”


Families who could not hold condolences are now coming to us


Kurt said many families had been unable to hold condolence gatherings during the most intense periods of the conflict and had instead commemorated their fallen relatives in secret at home. He said that after seeing the large condolence gatherings held in Kurdistan and Istanbul and the Kurdish people openly embracing the memory of those who lost their lives, families had begun approaching MEBYA-DER with requests to hold their own gatherings.


He continued: “Some of our families held their condolences at home in the 1990s, the 2000s and in 2014 because of the difficult conditions at the time. They gathered in a single room, where no one could hear or see them. The conditions of those years forced them to hold their condolences privately at home.


But in this latest period, particularly with the beginning of the peace process, families want larger condolence gatherings that people can attend and where photographs can be displayed. We are organising these gatherings under the leadership of MEBYA-DER. Families have gained courage and strength. As the process continues, we are now holding condolence gatherings for comrades whose families were unable to do so at the time and who now want to commemorate them openly.”


Families say: Let there be peace, let our children be the last to fall


Kurt said one of their greatest concerns when visiting families to inform them of the deaths of their relatives had been how the families would react. He said, however, that the families had received the news with dignity and expressed their support for the process.


He also said: “At the beginning of this process, we actually thought MEBYA-DER would be one of the institutions facing the greatest difficulties. We were concerned about how we would approach the families and how they would react. But once these condolence gatherings began, our mothers in particular said, ‘Let this war end. Let our children be the last to fall.’


The families support peace with this approach, and all the mothers and families are always present at the condolence gatherings, giving us strength. In fact, it is the mothers who console us …
